paper.title: FOVEA: Focused On-Demand Visual Evidence Adaptation for Cache-Friendly Multimodal Speculative Decoding
paper.abstract: Multimodal speculative decoding accelerates vision-language models by allowing a lightweight draft model to propose candidate tokens for parallel verification by a larger target model. Existing methods typically condition the drafter on a fixed visual interface, such as a predefined visual-token budget or a static compressed representation. However, our controlled visual-budget analysis shows that visual demand varies substantially across tasks and decoding stages, which means more visual input

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作解决的是多模态 speculative decoding 里的一个具体瓶颈：草稿模型既要便宜，又要拿到足够的视觉证据来提出可被大模型接受的 token；但视觉证据需求并不是固定的。现有方法通常给 drafter 一个固定视觉接口，要么固定视觉 token 预算，要么固定压缩表示。作者指出这两种做法都不合适，因为不同样本、不同解码阶段、甚至同一棵 draft tree 的不同分支，对视觉信息的需求都不同，而且“更多视觉输入”并不总是更好。
summary.importance: 这篇论文主要属于推理效率，而不是预训练。但它对做基座模型的人仍有两层启发。第一，它揭示了多模态生成中视觉依赖的强烈状态性和非单调性：某些 token 预测几乎不需要图像，某些则需要细粒度 OCR 或局部区域，这说明统一的视觉-语言接口在训练和推理阶段都可能过于僵硬。第二，作者提出的 cache-friendly 外部视觉记忆机制，提供了一种“不改自回归上下文、只改当前打分表示”的融合思路，这对未来设计更灵活的多模态条件化模块有参考价值。
summary.technical_approach:
论文先做了一个很关键的诊断实验：控制 drafter 可见的视觉预算，从无视觉、低预算到全视觉，观察 accept length 的变化。结论不是简单的“视觉越多越好”，而是最优预算随状态变化且明显非单调。作者把 preferred budget 定义为“达到最大 accept length 的最小预算”，而不是最高 token 概率或最低单步延迟。这个定义很合理，因为 speculative decoding 的核心目标是提高端到端吞吐，而 accept length 比局部概率更直接对应系统收益。实验里 25% 视觉预算在 56.0% 的状态上最优，而 full access 只在 2.9% 的状态上最优，说明固定全量视觉输入既浪费算力，也可能干扰草稿质量。

基于这个观察，作者提出 FOVEA。整体结构分三步。第一，先用 target model 的视觉编码器和 projector 对图像编码一次，得到 projected visual tokens，并构建每张图像的外部 visual memory。这样后续 draft 过程不需要反复处理整张图。第二，在 draft-tree 解码时，每个节点的 hidden state 作为 query 去检索这块 memory，选出与当前状态最相关的视觉证据，而且检索数量是动态的，不是固定 top-k。作者强调 dynamic cardinality，因为不同状态需要的证据量不同。第三，检索到的视觉证据不插入自回归 token 序列，而是通过一个 lightweight gated residual module 融合到当前节点的表示里，只影响当前 token scoring。这样做的关键好处是不会改变历史上下文，因此不会破坏已有 KV cache。

这里的方法取舍很清楚。若把检索到的视觉 token 真正拼回上下文，理论上表达能力更强，但历史 cache 会失效，推理加速收益会被重算吞掉。FOVEA 选择“外部记忆 + 当前状态修正”这条路，牺牲一部分深层交互，换取 cache reuse 和系统可实现性。对 speculative decoding 来说，这是合理的工程-算法折中。

从文中描述看，visual memory 至少包含用于检索的 key 表示和用于融合的 value/update 表示，先经 layer norm 和线性投影构建。每个 draft hidden state 对 memory 做相关性检索，得到 state-conditioned visual readout，再经门控残差注入当前表示。门控设计的意义在于：当当前 token 几乎不依赖视觉时，模型可以接近退化为纯文本 drafter；当需要视觉证据时，再有选择地放大视觉修正。
summary.experiments:
实验覆盖三个 vision-language backbone 和九个多模态 benchmark，重点看两个指标：draft acceptance，以及端到端 decoding speed。主结果是 FOVEA 相比强基线能同时提高 acceptance 和整体速度，最高达到相对普通 autoregressive decoding 2.13× 的加速。

更有意思的是诊断实验。作者发现视觉预算敏感性不仅跨任务变化，也在同一图像的不同生成阶段变化，尤其 OCR-heavy 任务在后期 token 更依赖细粒度视觉证据。这解释了为什么固定压缩视觉表示常常在某些阶段有效、某些阶段失灵。论文还指出高视觉预算并不稳定占优，75% 和 full access 很少是最优选择；这说明额外视觉上下文除了增加计算，还可能给 drafter 带来噪声或分散注意力。

虽然给出的全文片段没有列出所有具体 benchmark 数字，但从作者强调的结果结构看，FOVEA 的收益来自两端：一端是更高 accept length，减少 target model 回退频率；另一端是避免为每个 draft state 重跑视觉编码或重建 cache，因此系统开销可控。若看消融，最值得关注的应是：固定预算 vs 动态预算、直接插入上下文 vs gated residual 融合、是否使用外部 visual memory、不同任务上的预算偏好分布。这些实验共同支撑了作者的核心论点，而不是只展示一个速度数字。
summary.reading_guide:
泛读时先看 introduction 里的 visual-budget diagnostic，这部分决定了论文是否成立：如果最优视觉预算真是状态相关且非单调，那么固定视觉接口就确实有问题。然后看方法图，重点理解 external visual memory、dynamic retrieval cardinality、gated residual correction 这三件事如何配合，以及为什么这样做不会破坏 KV cache。接着看主表，确认收益是否同时体现在 acceptance 和 wall-clock speed，而不是只优化其中一个。最后看消融和 OCR/图表类任务结果，因为这些场景最能体现按需视觉证据的价值。

预计阅读时间 25 分钟左右。若只关心系统思路，看诊断实验、方法总览和主结果即可；若想把类似机制迁移到训练期的多模态条件化模块，需要更细看 memory 构造、检索开销和门控融合实现。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper targets a specific bottleneck in multimodal speculative decoding: the draft model must stay cheap, yet still access enough visual evidence to propose tokens that the larger target model will accept. Existing methods usually expose the drafter to a fixed visual interface—either a fixed visual-token budget or a static compressed representation. The authors argue that this is fundamentally mismatched to the problem, because visual demand varies across samples, decoding stages, and even branches within the same draft tree. More visual input is not always better.
summary_en.importance: This is primarily an inference-efficiency paper rather than a pretraining paper. Still, it carries two useful lessons for foundation-model research. First, it makes the state-dependence of visual grounding very explicit: some next-token decisions need almost no image evidence, while others require fine-grained OCR or local spatial details. That suggests the standard fixed visual-language interface may be too rigid not only at inference time but potentially during training as well. Second, the cache-friendly external-memory design offers a clean way to condition on visual evidence without rewriting the autoregressive context. That separation—preserve history, adapt current scoring—could be relevant for future multimodal conditioning modules beyond decoding acceleration.
summary_en.technical_approach:
The paper starts with a strong diagnostic. It varies the visual budget available to the drafter, from no visual input to full visual access, and measures accept length. The result is not monotonic: the preferred budget changes by state, and larger visual access is often suboptimal. The authors define preferred budget as the smallest tested budget that achieves the maximum accept length, rather than the budget with the highest token probability or lowest isolated latency. That choice is sensible because speculative decoding is ultimately about end-to-end throughput, and accept length is more directly tied to system gain. In their analysis, a 25% visual budget is optimal for 56.0% of evaluated states, while full access is optimal for only 2.9%, which already undermines the fixed-interface assumption.

Based on this observation, they propose FOVEA. The method has three main steps. First, the image is encoded once by the target-side visual encoder and multimodal projector, producing projected visual tokens that are stored in a reusable per-image visual memory. This avoids repeated full-image processing during drafting. Second, during draft-tree decoding, each draft hidden state acts as a query into that memory and retrieves the visual evidence most relevant to the current state. Importantly, retrieval cardinality is dynamic rather than fixed, because different states need different amounts of evidence. Third, the retrieved evidence is not inserted into the autoregressive token context. Instead, it is fused into the current node representation through a lightweight gated residual module, affecting only current-token scoring.

That design choice is the core systems insight. If the retrieved visual tokens were appended to the context, the historical KV cache would become inconsistent and would need recomputation, erasing much of the speculative speedup. FOVEA instead uses an external memory plus hidden-state correction, preserving cache reuse while still allowing state-conditioned visual adaptation. It is a deliberate trade-off: somewhat less expressive than rewriting the full context, but much more compatible with practical decoding.

From the method description, the visual memory contains at least retrieval-oriented key representations and fusion-oriented value/update representations, built from normalized projected visual tokens through learned projections. Each draft hidden state retrieves a state-conditioned visual readout, which is then injected via a gate. The gate matters because many decoding states are effectively text-dominant; in those cases the drafter should remain close to a text-only model, and only amplify visual correction when needed.
summary_en.experiments:
Experiments span three vision-language backbones and nine multimodal benchmarks. The main outcomes are improved draft acceptance and improved end-to-end decoding speed relative to strong baselines, with up to 2.13× speedup over standard autoregressive decoding.

The diagnostic results are arguably even more informative than the headline speed number. Visual-budget sensitivity varies not only across tasks but also across generation stages within the same sample. The effect is especially pronounced on OCR-heavy tasks, where later tokens often need finer-grained visual evidence. This explains why static compressed visual interfaces can work in some phases and fail in others. The paper also shows that high visual budgets are rarely optimal: 75% and full access seldom win. That means excess visual context is not just computationally expensive; it can also hurt drafting quality by adding irrelevant evidence.

The full excerpt does not list every benchmark number, but the mechanism behind the gains is clear. FOVEA improves average accept length, reducing target-model fallback, while also avoiding repeated visual recomputation and cache invalidation. The most important ablations to inspect are likely fixed budget vs dynamic budget, context insertion vs gated residual fusion, with vs without external visual memory, and task-wise budget preference distributions. Those are the experiments that validate the paper’s central claim rather than merely reporting a speedup.
summary_en.reading_guide:
For a quick pass, start with the visual-budget diagnostic in the introduction. That section establishes whether the paper’s premise is real: if optimal visual access is state-dependent and non-monotonic, then a fixed visual interface is indeed the wrong abstraction. Next, read the method overview carefully, focusing on the interaction among external visual memory, dynamic retrieval cardinality, and gated residual correction, and why this preserves KV-cache reuse. Then inspect the main result tables to verify that gains appear in both acceptance and wall-clock speed, not just one of them. Finally, look at the ablations and OCR/chart-heavy tasks, where on-demand visual evidence should matter the most.

Estimated reading time is about 25 minutes. If the goal is only to understand the systems idea, the diagnostic section, method figure, and main tables are enough. If the goal is to adapt similar mechanisms to training-time multimodal conditioning, spend more time on memory construction, retrieval overhead, and the exact fusion design.

recommendation.zh: VLM 推测解码的工程优化，核心 insight 是 drafter 不需要看全图，按需检索视觉特征能提速，做 VLM serving 的可以看看。
recommendation.en: Engineering optimization for VLM speculative decoding. The core insight is that the drafter doesn't need the full image; on-demand visual feature retrieval speeds up inference. Good for VLM serving engineers.

paper.title: Learning to Look Again: Loss-Gap Supervision for Free-form Crop Routing in Vision-Language Models
paper.abstract: Vision-language models (VLMs) fail many detail-centric questions for a concrete reason: the answer is visible in the image, yet lost after the image is compressed into a low-resolution global view. Allocating more visual tokens to every query improves some OCR and document cases, but it spends computation indiscriminately and can disturb tasks that rely on global context. We propose GapSight, a framework for learning visual re-reading: a VLM first takes a global glance, then selectively returns

summary.core_problem: VLM 在处理细节问题时常失败，因为图像被压缩为低分辨率全局视图后丢失了细节；而盲目增加所有查询的视觉 token 会浪费计算资源并干扰依赖全局上下文的任务。
summary.importance: 提出了一种基于损失差距监督的自由形式裁剪路由框架 GapSight，使 VLM 能够根据问题选择性地“重新查看”局部区域，在不盲目增加计算量的情况下提升细节理解能力。
summary.technical_approach: GapSight 框架：VLM 先进行全局浏览，当问题需要局部证据时，选择性地返回自由形式的区域。监督信号来自目标模型自身的失败信号：离线比较全局视图和候选裁剪增强视图下的答案损失或多项选择选项裕度；改善目标答案的裁剪成为模型特定的复习标签。一个轻量级的自由形式裁剪路由器将这些标签蒸馏为 one-shot 推理策略，预测是否复习、预期效用以及连续的裁剪框。
summary.experiments: 在多个 VLM benchmark 上验证了 GapSight 的有效性，证明其能在保持全局理解的同时提升细节问题的准确率。

summary_en.core_problem: VLMs often fail on detail-centric questions because details are lost after the image is compressed into a low-resolution global view; blindly allocating more visual tokens to all queries wastes computation and disturbs tasks relying on global context.
summary_en.importance: Proposes GapSight, a free-form crop routing framework based on loss-gap supervision, enabling VLMs to selectively 'look again' at local regions based on the question, improving detail understanding without blindly increasing computation.
summary_en.technical_approach: GapSight framework: A VLM first takes a global glance, then selectively returns to a free-form region when the question calls for local evidence. Supervision comes from the target model's own failure signal: offline comparison of answer loss or multiple-choice option margin under a global-only view and candidate crop-augmented views; crops that improve the target answer become model-specific review labels. A lightweight free-form crop router distills these labels into a one-shot inference policy predicting whether to review, expected utility, and a continuous crop box.
summary_en.experiments: Validated on multiple VLM benchmarks, proving GapSight can improve accuracy on detail-centric questions while maintaining global understanding.

recommendation.zh: 利用模型自身的 loss gap 作为监督信号来训练 crop router，实现 VLM 的自适应高分辨率局部重读，思路巧妙，对多模态高分辨率处理有启发。
recommendation.en: Using the model's own loss gap as a supervision signal to train a crop router for adaptive high-resolution local re-reading in VLMs is a clever approach, inspiring for multimodal high-resolution processing.

paper.title: ENCORE: Entropy-Guided Cropping and Attention Regularization for Robust Vision--Language Understanding
paper.abstract: Vision-Language Models (VLMs) perform well on diverse vision-language tasks, but transformer-based visual encoders split images into fixed-resolution sub-images, compromising object integrity in lightweight VLMs. Existing methods only focus on the visual modality and fail to dynamically preserve the integrity of prompt-relevant regions, limiting performance. In this work, we observe that the early-layer image-text entropy of cross-modal attention strongly correlates with answer grounding quality

summary.core_problem: 轻量级 VLM 在高分辨率/patch 化输入下容易把“提示词相关区域”切碎（尤其是文字、细粒度目标），导致 grounding 变差与 VQA 准确率下降。论文要解决的是：能否用模型早期层的跨模态注意力信号，动态选择更合适的裁剪，并在微调时用同一信号做正则，让模型更聚焦关键视觉 token。
summary.importance: 对预训练研究的关联度中等：它不是预训练新范式，而是一个可迁移的“训练信号/推理时策略”——用早期层 image-text attention 的熵作为可计算指标，既指导 inference-time cropping，又作为 fine-tune 的正则项。对做 VLM 预训练/中期训练的人，启发在两点：1）早期层对齐信号可作为可控的优化目标（类似把对齐质量变成可微的 proxy）；2）把“输入分辨率/切块策略”从纯视觉工程问题，变成“由文本提示引导”的跨模态决策问题。它更像一个轻量 recipe，适合快速集成到现有 VLM 训练/推理管线，但对大规模从零预训练的增益与稳定性仍需更多证据。
summary.technical_approach:
核心观察：早期层的跨模态注意力分布越“尖锐”（熵越低），答案 grounding 覆盖越完整、VQA 准确率越高。
1）image–text entropy 定义：在第 k 层取视觉 token Z_I 与文本 token Z_T，基于 CLIP 相似度做温度缩放 softmax 得到 prompt-relevant 的注意力/概率分布 p，然后计算熵 H_S = -\sum p\log(p+\epsilon)。直觉是：若提示词相关视觉区域被切碎或被大量无关 patch 稀释，注意力会更分散，熵更高。
2）ECS（Entropy-based Cropping Strategy，推理阶段）：预设一组候选裁剪比例/长宽比（文中裁剪范围 1 到 4），对每个候选 crop 用早期层（ECS 用 k=1）计算 H_S，选择熵最小的 crop；并将该 crop 与原图组合成最终视觉输入，以尽量保留连续的提示词相关区域。
3）ERT（Entropy Regularization Training，微调阶段）：在标准 next-token 训练损失上加一个熵正则项 L = L_NTP + \alpha H_S（文中 \alpha=0.1，ERT 用 k=2）。作者给出解释：对 p_i>1/e 的“相关 token”，最小化熵会进一步抬高其概率；对 p_i<1/e 的“无关 token”，自信息项会抑制噪声配对，效果有点像对比学习里的负样本抑制。实现上只需 LoRA 微调少量参数（文中称 0.14% 参数可训练）。
summary.experiments:
实验设置：在 InternVL3-2B 上做微调与评测，覆盖 10 个基准（TextVQA、OCRBench、SEED2-Plus、InfoVQA、CCBench、RealWorldQA、HallBench、POPE、MMBench-v1.1-EN、MMStar）。关键超参：base LR 4e-8；ECS 温度 \tau=1、k=1；ERT 温度 \tau=0.1、k=2；\epsilon=1e-32；\alpha=0.1。
主要结果（相对 InternVL3-2B）：
- TextVQA +2.8%，OCRBench +1.4%（文本密集任务提升更明显，符合“减少文字被切碎”的动机）。
- RealWorldQA +2.0%，CCBench +2.4%（说明裁剪策略对非纯 OCR 任务也有收益）。
- SEED-2 报告到 65.5、InfoVQA 到 68.x（你提供的正文在此处截断，InfoVQA 精确小数与其余基准的完整表格需回看论文表 1/表 2）。
消融与分析（从正文可见的点）：作者强调熵与 grounding/准确率的相关性，并分别在 inference（ECS）与 training（ERT）使用不同层数与温度，暗示信号在早期层更稳定、且推理与训练的最优锐化程度不同。
summary.reading_guide:
泛读建议：
1）先看 Fig.1：熵与 grounding coverage / VQA accuracy 的相关性是整篇文章的支点，决定这个 proxy 是否可信。
2）看 Method 里熵的具体计算：是用 CLIP 相似度近似 cross-attention，而不是直接读 transformer attention；这影响可复现性与适用到别的架构时的改动量。
3）看 ECS 的候选裁剪集合与组合策略：它决定推理开销（要评估多少个 crop）以及是否会引入分布偏移。
4）看 ERT 的损失形式与阈值解释（p>1/e）：这是作者试图给出“为什么熵正则不会把注意力塌缩到单点”的关键论证。
预计阅读时间：15–25 分钟可掌握方法并判断是否值得集成；若要落地到自家 VLM 训练，建议精读实验设置与消融（约 1 小时）。

summary_en.core_problem: Lightweight VLMs with patchified high-resolution inputs often fragment prompt-relevant regions (notably text), hurting grounding and VQA accuracy. The paper asks whether an early-layer cross-modal signal can (i) select better crops at inference time and (ii) act as a regularizer during fine-tuning to focus attention on key visual tokens.
summary_en.importance: Moderate relevance to pretraining: it is not a new pretraining objective for training from scratch, but a practical, transferable proxy signal—image–text attention entropy—that can be used both for inference-time input selection and for training-time regularization. The main pretraining-facing insight is that early alignment signals can be turned into an explicit optimization target, and that “cropping / resolution engineering” can be made text-conditioned rather than purely vision-driven. Evidence is currently strongest for 2B-class VLM fine-tuning; whether the same proxy scales cleanly to large-scale pretraining and remains stable across architectures is still an open question.
summary_en.technical_approach:
Key observation: lower entropy of early-layer image–text attention correlates with better grounding coverage and higher VQA accuracy.
1) Image–text entropy: from layer k, obtain visual tokens and text tokens; compute a prompt-relevant distribution via temperature-scaled softmax over CLIP similarities, then compute Shannon entropy H_S = -\sum p\log(p+\epsilon). High entropy indicates dispersed attention, consistent with fragmented or noisy prompt-relevant regions.
2) ECS (Entropy-based Cropping Strategy, inference): evaluate a small set of candidate crops/aspect ratios; compute H_S using very early layers (k=1 in ECS) and pick the crop with minimal entropy; combine the selected crop with the original image as the final input.
3) ERT (Entropy Regularization Training, fine-tuning): add entropy as a regularizer to the standard next-token loss: L = L_NTP + \alpha H_S (k=2 in ERT). The paper argues this sharpens attention on relevant tokens (p_i > 1/e) while suppressing irrelevant ones (p_i < 1/e), loosely analogous to negative-sample suppression in contrastive learning. Implementation is LoRA-based with only ~0.14% trainable parameters.
summary_en.experiments:
Setup: fine-tune InternVL3-2B and evaluate on 10 benchmarks (TextVQA, OCRBench, SEED2-Plus, InfoVQA, CCBench, RealWorldQA, HallBench, POPE, MMBench-v1.1-EN, MMStar). Hyperparameters include LR 4e-8, \tau=1 for ECS and \tau=0.1 for ERT, \alpha=0.1, k=1 (ECS) / k=2 (ERT), crop ratio range 1–4.
Reported gains vs InternVL3-2B: +2.8 on TextVQA, +1.4 on OCRBench, +2.0 on RealWorldQA, +2.4 on CCBench. The excerpt also mentions SEED-2 reaching 65.5 and InfoVQA reaching 68.x, but the exact remaining numbers require checking the full result tables in the paper.
summary_en.reading_guide:
Skim priorities:
1) Fig.1 correlation study (entropy vs grounding/accuracy): this is the empirical justification for using entropy as a proxy.
2) The exact entropy computation: it uses CLIP-similarity-based cross-modal distribution rather than raw transformer attention, which affects portability.
3) ECS candidate set and inference overhead: how many crops are evaluated and how crops are merged with the original.
4) ERT loss and the p>1/e interpretation: the key argument for why entropy minimization helps rather than collapsing attention.
Time: ~15–25 minutes to decide whether to adopt; ~1 hour to replicate and integrate into a training/inference pipeline.

recommendation.zh: 可读早层cross-attention熵的相关性实验；方法像推理补丁，但若相关性稳，能指导VLM token选择。
recommendation.en: Read the early cross-attention entropy correlation results; the method is a patch, but a stable signal would be useful for VLM token selection.

paper.title: PatchGate: Narrowing the Verbalization Gap with Intrinsic Object Inventories in Frozen Vision-Language Models
paper.abstract: Reliable image captioning in Vision-Language Models (VLMs) requires captions to be both precise and complete, avoiding unsupported object mentions while covering visible objects. Existing training-free methods primarily address the former requirement, suppressing unsupported object words by intervening on model-predicted mentions during generation. Because they operate only on objects the model is already likely to mention, visible objects omitted from the output remain difficult to recover. We

summary.core_problem: 现有的免训练 VLM 图像描述方法主要关注抑制不支持的对象提及，但难以恢复被模型遗漏的可见对象，导致描述不够完整。
summary.importance: 提出 PatchGate，一种免训练框架，通过在生成前从冻结的 VLM 中提取内在的对象证据，来缩小内在对象集与最终对象提及之间的差距，提升图像描述的完整性。
summary.technical_approach: PatchGate 包含两个阶段：1) Visual Evidence eXtraction (VEX)：从 LM 解码器后半部分层读取 patch 级别的词汇证据，在没有任何任务 prompt 的情况下构建以图像为条件的对象集；2) Visual-Evidence Inclusion-Exclusion Decoding (VIED)：利用提取的证据在解码过程中进行干预，包含可见对象并排除不支持的对象。
summary.experiments: 在图像描述任务上验证了 PatchGate 能够有效提升描述的精确度和完整性。

summary_en.core_problem: Existing training-free VLM image captioning methods mainly focus on suppressing unsupported object mentions but struggle to recover visible objects omitted by the model, leading to incomplete captions.
summary_en.importance: Proposes PatchGate, a training-free framework that extracts intrinsic object evidence from a frozen VLM before generation to narrow the gap between the intrinsic object set and final object mentions, improving caption completeness.
summary_en.technical_approach: PatchGate consists of two stages: 1) Visual Evidence eXtraction (VEX): reads patch-level lexical evidence from the latter half of LM decoder layers to construct an image-conditioned object set without any task prompt; 2) Visual-Evidence Inclusion-Exclusion Decoding (VIED): uses the extracted evidence to intervene during decoding, including visible objects and excluding unsupported ones.
summary_en.experiments: Validated on image captioning tasks, showing PatchGate effectively improves caption precision and completeness.

recommendation.zh: 通过分析 VLM 内部特征来提取 object evidence 并干预解码，属于典型的免训练干预方法，作为机制分析和解码策略的参考即可。
recommendation.en: Extracting object evidence by analyzing internal VLM features to intervene in decoding is a typical training-free intervention method; useful as a reference for mechanism analysis and decoding strategies.

paper.title: Perturb the Thought, Not the Pixels: Latent-Space Rollout Diversification for Reinforcement Learning of Vision-Language Models
paper.abstract: Reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) improves the reasoning ability of vision-language models (VLMs), and diversifying the rollouts within each optimization group amplifies its gains. Existing approaches diversify through decoding temperature or pixel-space image distortion; we ask whether the perturbation belongs in the model's latent space instead. We introduce Noise-Contrastive GRPO (NC-GRPO), which injects scale-calibrated Gaussian noise into the last hidden layer of the pro

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作讨论的是 RLVR 里一个常被当作实现细节、其实直接决定学习信号强弱的问题：组内 rollout 的多样性应该从哪里来。GRPO 依赖同一 prompt 下多条回答的相对奖励；如果组内样本高度一致，优势信号就会塌掉。已有做法主要靠 decoding temperature，或者像 NoisyRollout 那样在图像像素空间加噪声。作者要解决的是：这些扰动都没有直接作用在模型内部的“问题表征”上，能否把分叉点前移到 latent space，让 rollout 在隐藏状态层面分化，从而得到更有用的组内对比信号。
summary.importance: 对基座研究的直接相关性不如纯预训练论文强，但它对 post-train 阶段的 rollout 设计有一个清楚的启发：在 group-based RL 中，真正重要的不是表面上的采样随机性，而是能否制造对策略有区分度的内部状态分叉。这个思路和 latent reasoning、hidden-state perturbation、以及 test-time branching 有天然联系。若以后把 RL 信号更深地接到预训练或 mid-training 阶段，latent-space diversification 可能比输入空间扰动更通用，因为它不依赖具体模态，也不要求额外的数据增强管线。
summary.technical_approach:
方法叫 NC-GRPO（Noise-Contrastive GRPO）。做法很简单：在每个 rollout group 中，只对一半分支在 prompt encoding 的 prefill 阶段注入高斯噪声，而且噪声加在最后一层 hidden state 上；另一半分支保持标准 GRPO。这样，同一 prompt 会从两个不同的内部起点出发生成回答。若某些 noisy branch 在被扰动后仍能走到正确答案，它们就会在组内相对奖励下被强化；若被扰动后偏离正确轨道，则会被压低。于是，模型对这一“分叉点扰动”的敏感性被转成了 policy gradient 信号。

关键设计有几处。

第一，噪声只加在 prefill forward，不在 decode 过程中持续注入。作者明确区分了“改变 rollout 出发状态”和“改变生成时持续可见的缓存表示”这两件事。NC-GRPO 只做前者，因此 decode 成本与标准 GRPO 相同，也更容易把效果归因到初始 latent branching，而不是整个生成过程被噪声污染。

第二，噪声尺度按 hidden norm 校准。具体做法是让扰动的期望二范数与原 hidden state 范数成比例，因此 σ 是无量纲、对 hidden width 不敏感的相对扰动强度。文中还给出方差随维度 d 以 2/d 收缩的性质，说明在高维表示里，实际扰动幅度会集中在设定值附近。这个设计避免了“不同模型宽度下同一 σ 含义不同”的问题。

第三，噪声采用 annealing schedule，早期探索更强，后期逐步降到 0。这和 NoisyRollout 的训练节奏一致，但这里扰动对象从像素换成了 latent state。

第四，作者做了 antithetic 和 steered probes。前者用相反方向的噪声对，后者用可控方向扰动，目的是区分“只是加了噪声预算”与“独立随机分叉”哪个才是有效因素。结论是后者更关键：真正起作用的是独立 stochastic diversity，而不是某个特定方向或总噪声能量。

从方法定位看，它不是在改 GRPO objective，也不是在改 reward model，而是在改 rollout 生成分布。这个切入点比较干净，因为训练目标、评测方式、解码设置都尽量保持不变，便于把收益归因到 diversification 机制本身。
summary.experiments:
实验主要在多模态数学推理和幻觉鲁棒性上展开。作者报告，在五个 multimodal math OOD benchmark 上，NC-GRPO 相比 vanilla GRPO 有显著提升，pooled McNemar 检验的显著性范围是 p=0.001 到 p<1e-4。除了 OOD，文中也说 in-domain accuracy 有提升，说明 latent perturbation 不只是做 domain shift regularization。

与图像空间噪声相比，NC-GRPO 在 hallucination robustness 上更好：POPE 上显著，p=0.007；HallusionBench 提升 0.6 个百分点。这个结果有两层含义。其一，latent diversification 并不只是让答案更散，而是可能让模型学到对内部表征扰动更稳健的决策边界。其二，像素噪声会把变化限制在视觉编码器能表达的方向上，而 latent 噪声更直接地作用于跨模态融合后的内部状态。

机制实验是这篇文章最值得看的部分。作者用 matched antithetic 和 steered probes 说明，收益主要来自独立随机分叉，而不是固定方向扰动或更大的噪声预算。另一个有用结果是 noise-scale study：σ0 控制 specialization 程度，较大噪声会更偏向 reasoning gain、但可能牺牲 general capability；文中指出 σ0=0.2 是一个较平衡的区间，在 reasoning 上有收益，同时 general capability 没有可测下降。

摘要和正文片段没有给出完整模型规模、训练步数和所有 benchmark 的逐项分数，因此这里不宜编造具体数字。可以确认的硬结果是：五个 OOD 多模态数学 benchmark 上显著优于 vanilla GRPO；POPE 上 p=0.007；HallusionBench +0.6；并做了不同噪声尺度与机制探针实验。
summary.reading_guide:
这篇适合泛读，重点放在方法动机和机制验证，不必把它当成一个需要逐式推导的 RL 论文。

先看 Introduction 和 Method 3.1，弄清楚作者到底扰动了什么、没有扰动什么。尤其要注意：噪声只在 prefill 的最后一层 hidden state 注入，decode 时不继续加噪，也不改 objective。这一点决定了实验解释是否干净。

然后看噪声尺度校准公式和对应命题。这里的价值不在数学难度，而在它把 σ 变成了 width-invariant 的相对量，方便后续做可控实验。

最值得看的其实是机制实验和 noise-scale study。前者回答“为什么有效”，后者回答“代价是什么”。如果你关心 latent reasoning、NoisyCoconut、或者 test-time branching，这两部分会比主表分数更有启发。预计 20–30 分钟可以读完主线；若只想判断是否值得迁移到文本 LLM，可重点看作者关于 modality-agnostic 的论证以及实现开销描述。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper studies a practical but underexamined question in RL with verifiable rewards: where should rollout diversity come from? GRPO relies on within-group reward differences, so if all rollouts for a prompt are too similar, the learning signal collapses. Existing diversification methods mainly use decoding temperature or image-space perturbations such as noisy images. The paper asks whether the perturbation should instead be applied directly to the model’s internal representation, so that rollouts branch from different latent states rather than merely from different pixel inputs or sampling randomness.
summary_en.importance: Its relevance to core pretraining is indirect, but the paper offers a useful lesson for post-training and potentially for mid-training RL: what matters in group-based RL is not superficial sample randomness, but whether the policy is exposed to informative internal-state branching. That connects naturally to latent reasoning, hidden-state perturbation, and branching-based exploration. If RL signals are pushed earlier into the training pipeline, latent-space diversification may be more general than input-space augmentation because it is modality-agnostic and does not require a separate augmentation stack for each modality.
summary_en.technical_approach:
The method is NC-GRPO, Noise-Contrastive GRPO. For each rollout group, half of the branches are standard GRPO rollouts, while the other half receive Gaussian noise injected into the last hidden layer during the prompt-encoding prefill pass. The noisy branches therefore start generation from displaced latent states. If a branch still reaches the correct answer despite the displacement, it is reinforced relative to branches that fail, so sensitivity to that latent perturbation is converted into policy-gradient signal through group-normalized rewards.

Several design choices matter.

First, the noise is injected only once during prefill, not throughout decoding. The paper is careful about this distinction: it changes the departure state of the rollout, but does not keep perturbing the cached representation during generation. This keeps decoding cost identical to standard GRPO and makes attribution cleaner.

Second, the noise scale is calibrated to the hidden-state norm. The perturbation magnitude is proportional to the norm of the original hidden vector, so sigma becomes a dimensionless relative scale rather than an architecture-dependent absolute one. The paper also shows that the relative perturbation magnitude concentrates with variance 2/d, which means the actual perturbation size is tightly controlled in high-dimensional hidden spaces.

Third, the noise follows an annealing schedule: stronger exploration early, decaying to zero later. This mirrors prior noisy-rollout schedules, but moves the perturbation from pixel space into latent space.

Fourth, the paper includes antithetic and steered probes. These are designed to test whether the gain comes from simply adding more noise budget or from creating independent stochastic branches. The conclusion is that independent stochastic diversity is the active ingredient, not a specific direction or just larger perturbation energy.

Methodologically, this is a clean intervention. The GRPO objective, reward, decoding, and evaluation are kept fixed as much as possible, so the observed differences can be attributed mainly to the diversification mechanism.
summary_en.experiments:
The experiments focus on multimodal mathematical reasoning and hallucination robustness. The paper reports significant gains over vanilla GRPO on five out-of-domain multimodal math benchmarks, with pooled McNemar significance ranging from p=0.001 to p<1e-4. It also reports improvements on in-domain accuracy, suggesting that latent perturbation is not merely acting as domain-shift regularization.

Compared with image-space noise, NC-GRPO performs better on hallucination robustness: significant on POPE with p=0.007, and +0.6 points on HallusionBench. This matters because it suggests latent diversification is not just making outputs more varied; it may be encouraging policies that are more stable to perturbations in internal representations. It also highlights a limitation of pixel-space noise: it can only diversify along directions expressible by the visual encoder, whereas latent noise acts after multimodal fusion.

The mechanism studies are the most informative part. Matched antithetic and steered probes indicate that the benefit comes mainly from independent stochastic branching rather than a particular perturbation direction or total noise budget. The noise-scale study is also useful: sigma_0 acts as a specialization dial. Larger noise tends to favor reasoning gains but can trade off against general capability, while sigma_0=0.2 is reported as a regime that improves reasoning without measurable loss in general capability.

The provided text does not include the full model sizes, training budgets, or all benchmark-by-benchmark scores, so it would be unsafe to invent them. The reliable takeaways are the significant gains on five OOD multimodal math benchmarks, the POPE result at p=0.007, the +0.6 HallusionBench gain, and the mechanism and scale ablations.
summary_en.reading_guide:
This is a good skim paper. Focus on the motivation and the mechanism studies rather than treating it as a dense RL derivation.

Start with the introduction and the method section that defines exactly what is perturbed and what is not. The key point is that noise is injected only into the final hidden layer during prefill, while decoding and the objective remain unchanged. That design choice is central to the paper’s causal interpretation.

Then read the noise-scaling formulation and the proposition about width-invariant relative perturbation. The math is simple, but it is important because it turns sigma into a controlled experimental knob rather than a model-specific heuristic.

The most valuable sections are the mechanism probes and the noise-scale study. One explains why the method helps; the other explains what trade-off it induces. If you care about latent reasoning, NoisyCoconut-style branching, or rollout diversification for text-only LLMs, those sections are more informative than the headline benchmark table. A focused read should take 20 to 30 minutes.

recommendation.zh: 将探索噪声从 decoding/pixel 移到 latent space，对 RLVR 训练 VLM 的多样性生成有启发，值得关注其 noise scale 的设定和梯度回传机制。
recommendation.en: Moving exploration noise from decoding/pixel to latent space offers insights for diverse generation in RLVR for VLMs; worth checking the noise scale setup and gradient flow mechanism.

paper.title: Hints, Critics, and Teachers: Prior Injection for Sparse-Reward RL in Vision-Language Math Reasoning
paper.abstract: Reinforcement learning for vision-language math reasoning starves under sparse reward: on a pool of 20,830 visual-math problems where Qwen2-VL-2B answers 3.6% of rollouts correctly, 85-97% of GRPO rollout groups are entirely wrong and contribute zero gradient. We train eleven methods under identical conditions in this regime, each injecting a different prior: text (reference-solution hints), distribution (on-policy distillation from a 7B teacher), and value (a value-pretrained critic with an MSE

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作处理的是一个很具体、也很常见的 RL 失效点：在视觉-语言数学推理里，如果基础模型初始成功率很低，GRPO 这类组内相对优势方法会因为“整组全错”而拿不到有效梯度，训练几乎处于饥饿状态。作者不是再提一个单点技巧，而是把三类常见补救思路放到同一控制条件下比较：文本先验（hint）、分布先验（teacher distillation）、价值先验（critic）。论文真正要回答的问题不是“哪种方法名字更好”，而是“先验是否真的传递到了 policy”，以及在极端 sparse-reward 条件下，哪些设计能把无梯度状态改造成可学习状态。
summary.importance: 对预训练研究者来说，这篇文章的价值不在 GUI 或 VLM 任务本身，而在它把 post-train RL 中一个常被模糊处理的问题拆开了：当 reward 太稀疏时，训练成败首先取决于训练信号能否穿透到 token 级更新，而不是取决于目标函数表面形式。这个结论对 reasoning RL、RLVR、以及更广义的 pretrain↔post-train 接口都有参考意义。第二个价值点是评测有效性：作者发现一个长期使用的 held-out 集合会系统性奖励“模型没变”，甚至与真实跨域迁移负相关，这对任何依赖固定验证集做 recipe 选择的训练工作都很重要。第三个价值点是工程验证：评分器、答案抽取器、judge 设计、porting bug 都可能比算法差异更大，论文把这些问题当作一等公民处理，这一点比很多方法细节更值得借鉴。
summary.technical_approach: 方法上，作者先构造并验证了一个真正稀疏的训练池：从 MathV360K 里筛出 20,830 个 visual-math 问题，用 Qwen2-VL-2B 预先测得单 rollout 正确率只有 3.6%，85%–97% 的 GRPO rollout group 全错。然后在完全相同的训练预算、数据池、随机种子和硬件条件下，比较 11 个训练臂。文本先验部分，核心是给模型前缀一段参考解法，让采样从更接近成功的状态开始；作者还区分了“hint 真正改善探索”与“UFT 类辅助似然项是否额外有用”，结论是收益主要来自探索起点改变，而不是额外的监督项。分布先验部分，作者比较了多种 on-policy distillation 方式，关键差别在于 teacher 信号是否被 teacher 能力上限卡住、是否只在失败样本上 gated、以及是否随训练退火；结果显示 annealed global distillation 有效，而 failure-gated persistent distillation 不行，说明蒸馏信号如果只在局部失败区域触发，往往送不到真正决定策略迁移的地方。价值先验部分，作者训练 critic 给 token 级 credit assignment，但重点不是“有没有 critic”，而是 critic 的参数化是否正确：把 clipped-MSE 标量回归换成 HL-Gauss categorical loss 之后，credit 传播质量明显改善。作者把这个变化描述为一行替换，但含义很重：在稀疏奖励下，value head 的表示形式会直接决定先验是否能被 policy 吸收。最后还测试了 text prior 和 distribution prior 叠加，发现几乎没有叠加收益，说明二者主要都在解决同一个早期瓶颈，而不是互补瓶颈。
summary.experiments: 实验设计很干净。11 个 arms 用同一训练池、同一步数和 batch 预算、同一 seed、每个 arm 一台 8×A800 节点。评测采用独立 LLM judge（DeepSeek）盲评完整输出，并用 McNemar exact test 做成对显著性检验。核心结果有三层。第一层是“先验是否送达”的分层：在训练域外的 DynaMath 上，6 个先验确实传到 policy 的方法集中在 30.6%–32.9%，其余 5 个方法——包括 plain GRPO 和几种先验被 teacher cap、gating 或 critic 失配吞掉的变体——集中在 27.0%–29.1%，两组区间不重叠。第二层是组件级归因：hint 预验证可把成功率从 7.2% 拉到 34.4%，说明探索起点确实能解锁稀疏任务；critic 从 clipped-MSE 改成 HL-Gauss 后，in-domain accuracy 提升 +14.4 个百分点，并把原本最弱的训练臂变成第二好的 cross-domain 臂；双先验叠加没有额外收益。第三层是评测集诊断：旧的 held-out 集 old-319 与真实跨域迁移排名呈负相关，Spearman ρ=-0.74；最难的 in-domain 子集 sparse-800 与迁移呈强正相关，ρ=+0.89。作者进一步分析 old-319 中 69% 是四选一选择题，各方法都接近 25% 猜测下限，因此“保持输出短选项字母”的旧行为反而拿高分，导致它奖励模型不发生能力变化。论文还做了 scoring audit，发现启发式答案抽取器会对不同方法造成最高 30 个百分点的系统偏差，甚至能颠倒排序；同时排查了 guessing 和 format reward hacking，认为主结果不是这些伪因素造成的。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读时先看 Introduction 和方法总表，抓住作者的主线：不是比较三类先验谁名义上更强，而是比较“先验有没有真正进入 policy 更新”。然后重点看结果部分里对 11 个 arms 的分组结果，以及 critic loss 那一节；这是最有信息量的地方。评测部分建议至少认真看 old-319 与 sparse-800 的相关性分析，因为它解释了为什么一个看似正常的 held-out 集会把实验方向带偏。工程上值得看 Section 6 一类的 verification protocol，包括 blind judge、scoring audit、bug gating，这部分对做 RL 训练的人很实用。作为 skim 级阅读，建议 25–35 分钟：先读引言、主结果图表、critic loss 对比、evaluation validity 分析，最后扫一遍附录里评分与审计细节。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper studies a concrete failure mode of GRPO-style RL in vision-language math reasoning: when the base policy almost never solves a problem, most rollout groups are entirely wrong, the group-relative advantage becomes zero, and training receives no useful gradient. The real question is not which family of tricks sounds better, but which kind of prior actually reaches the policy under extreme sparse-reward conditions. The authors compare three families under matched settings: text priors via hints, distribution priors via teacher distillation, and value priors via a critic.
summary_en.importance: Its relevance goes beyond this specific VLM math setup. For anyone working on reasoning RL, RLVR, or the pretrain-to-post-train interface, the paper makes a sharp point: under sparse rewards, progress depends first on whether learning signal can penetrate token-level updates, not on the nominal form of the objective. A second contribution is methodological: the paper shows that a commonly used held-out set can systematically reward models for not changing, and can even anti-correlate with true cross-domain transfer. That is directly relevant to recipe selection and ablation practice. A third contribution is experimental discipline. Scoring bugs, answer extraction heuristics, and judge design can dominate algorithmic differences; the paper treats these as first-class objects rather than afterthoughts.
summary_en.technical_approach: The setup starts with a deliberately sparse training pool: 20,830 visual-math problems filtered from MathV360K, where Qwen2-VL-2B gets only 3.6% rollout accuracy and 85%–97% of GRPO groups are all-wrong. On this pool, the authors train 11 arms under identical data, budget, seed, and hardware conditions. For text priors, they prepend part of a reference solution so exploration starts from a more promising state. An important decomposition is that the gain comes from improved exploration itself, while the auxiliary UFT-style likelihood term adds little. For distribution priors, they compare several on-policy distillation variants and show that delivery matters: if the signal is capped by teacher ability, gated only to failures, or otherwise poorly routed, it does not help much. Annealed global distillation works; failure-gated persistent distillation does not. For value priors, they train a critic to provide token-level credit assignment even when sequence-level outcomes are uniform. The key finding is not merely that a critic helps, but that critic parameterization matters a lot: replacing clipped MSE scalar regression with an HL-Gauss categorical loss substantially improves signal delivery. They also test stacking text and distribution priors and find little additive benefit, suggesting both mainly address the same early bottleneck rather than complementary ones.
summary_en.experiments: The experimental design is unusually controlled: same pool, same step and batch budget, same seed, one 8×A800 node per arm. Evaluation uses blind judging by an independent LLM judge (DeepSeek) over full outputs, with McNemar exact tests for pairwise claims. The main result is a clean separation by signal delivery. On the out-of-domain DynaMath benchmark, the six arms whose prior demonstrably reaches the policy score 30.6%–32.9%, while the remaining five arms, including plain GRPO and variants where the prior is blocked or misparameterized, score 27.0%–29.1%, with no overlap. Component-level findings are also concrete. A half-solution hint raises prevalidated success from 7.2% to 34.4%, showing that exploration state matters. Changing the critic loss from clipped MSE to HL-Gauss yields +14.4 points in-domain and turns the weakest trained arm into the second-best cross-domain arm. Combining two priors brings little extra gain. The evaluation analysis is equally important: the old held-out set old-319 anti-correlates with genuine cross-domain transfer at Spearman rho = -0.74, while the hardest in-domain slice sparse-800 predicts transfer well at rho = +0.89. The proposed mechanism is compositional: 69% of old-319 is four-option multiple choice, where all methods sit near the 25% guessing floor, so models that preserve the base model’s short option-letter behavior score better. The paper also reports a scoring audit showing that a heuristic answer extractor can introduce up to 30-point arm-dependent bias and even invert rankings.
summary_en.reading_guide: For a quick but useful read, start with the introduction and the table of training arms. The central lens is simple: compare not whether a prior is nominally injected, but whether it is actually delivered to policy updates. Then read the main results section that groups the 11 arms by delivered versus undelivered prior, and the critic-loss comparison in detail. Those are the most informative parts. The evaluation-validity section deserves attention as well, especially the old-319 versus sparse-800 correlation analysis, because it explains how a plausible held-out set can steer conclusions in the wrong direction. The verification section is also worth scanning for practical RL work: blind LLM judging, scoring audits, and bug gating are all concrete and reusable. As a skim paper, this is about a 25–35 minute read if you focus on the setup, the main comparison figures, the critic ablation, and the evaluation audit.

recommendation.zh: 系统对比了稀疏奖励下 RL 的先验注入策略，结论清晰：先验必须直接作用于 policy 才有收益，且指出了评测集过拟合的坑，对做 RL post-training 的同学很有参考价值。
recommendation.en: Systematically compares prior injection strategies for RL under sparse rewards, concluding that priors must directly affect the policy to be beneficial, and highlights the pitfall of evaluation set overfitting; highly relevant for RL post-training.

paper.title: StateSight: Benchmarking Latent Spatial-State Reconstruction in Vision-Language Models
paper.abstract: Vision-language models are increasingly used for multimodal question answering, yet their ability to reconstruct latent spatial structure from a single image remains difficult to isolate. Broad benchmarks often combine perception, optical character recognition, domain knowledge, linguistic priors, and reasoning in the same evaluation. We introduce StateSight, a procedurally generated benchmark for cube-net opposite-face reasoning, occluded cube-tower counting, and 4-neighbor connected-component

summary.core_problem: 如何隔离并准确评估视觉语言模型（VLMs）从单张图像中重建潜在空间结构的能力，而不受感知、OCR、领域知识等因素的干扰？
summary.importance: 提出了StateSight基准测试，专门用于评估VLM的潜在空间状态重建能力。通过程序化生成的数据集和精确匹配的评分机制，提供了一个干净的测试环境，揭示了当前顶级模型（如GPT-5.5和Claude Sonnet 5）在纯空间推理任务上与人类基线之间的显著差距。
summary.technical_approach: 构建了StateSight基准测试，包含三个任务：立方体网络对立面推理、遮挡立方体塔计数和4邻接连通分量计数。每个任务包含300个程序化生成的单图提示，具有确定性的oracle标签和精确匹配评分。这种设计排除了语言先验和领域知识的干扰，专注于纯粹的空间推理。
summary.experiments: 测试了OpenAI GPT-5.5 (gpt-5.5) 和 Claude Sonnet 5。GPT-5.5在三个任务上的准确率分别为59.3%、33.3%和28.3%；Claude Sonnet 5分别为53.3%、18.7%和7.3%。而30名人类参与者的基线准确率分别为80.8%、68.8%和64.3%，显著高于模型。
summary.authors_note: 作者来自Thomas Jefferson High School for Science and Technology。

summary_en.core_problem: How to isolate and accurately evaluate the ability of Vision-Language Models (VLMs) to reconstruct latent spatial structures from a single image, without interference from perception, OCR, domain knowledge, etc.?
summary_en.importance: Introduces StateSight, a benchmark specifically designed to evaluate latent spatial state reconstruction in VLMs. Through procedurally generated datasets and exact-match scoring, it provides a clean testing environment and reveals a significant gap between current top models (e.g., GPT-5.5, Claude Sonnet 5) and human baselines on pure spatial reasoning tasks.
summary_en.technical_approach: Constructs the StateSight benchmark comprising three tasks: cube-net opposite-face reasoning, occluded cube-tower counting, and 4-neighbor connected-component counting. Each task contains 300 procedurally generated single-image prompts with deterministic oracle labels and exact-match scoring. This design eliminates interference from linguistic priors and domain knowledge, focusing purely on spatial reasoning.
summary_en.experiments: Evaluated OpenAI GPT-5.5 (gpt-5.5) and Claude Sonnet 5. GPT-5.5 achieved 59.3%, 33.3%, and 28.3% accuracy across the three tasks; Claude Sonnet 5 achieved 53.3%, 18.7%, and 7.3%. A 30-participant human baseline significantly outperformed both models with accuracies of 80.8%, 68.8%, and 64.3%.
summary_en.authors_note: Author is affiliated with Thomas Jefferson High School for Science and Technology.

recommendation.zh: 一个针对VLM空间推理能力的合成评测集，揭示了当前模型在纯空间结构重建上的短板，可作为VLM能力分析的参考。
recommendation.en: A synthetic benchmark targeting VLM spatial reasoning capabilities, revealing shortcomings of current models in pure spatial structure reconstruction; useful as a reference for VLM capability analysis.
