paper.title: CARD: Diagnosing Belief to Action Routing Failures in Vision Language Models
paper.abstract: Linear probes and activation steering have uncovered that vision-language models (VLMs) internally represent mental states such as agents' beliefs, knowledge, and intentions. However, it is unclear whether and how these representations are used by downstream predictions along these axes. To close this gap, we introduce Cross-Axis Routing Diagnostic (CARD), which steers activations along one axis while measuring the response of a different axis's prediction. Applied to open-weight VLMs on Relay C

summary.core_problem: CARD 关注一个机制诊断问题：VLM 内部即使能线性解码出伙伴的 belief、knowledge、intent 等心理状态，这些表示是否真的被用于后续 action prediction。传统 probe 只能说明表示存在，same-axis steering 只能说明该表示会影响同一轴的回答；它们无法区分“模型没有表示”与“模型有表示但没有把表示路由到动作决策”。
summary.importance: 这篇更接近 VLM 机制分析和评测方法，对预训练的启发在于区分 representation learning 和 representation use。很多多模态预训练或指令数据会提升模型对状态描述的回答能力，但这不等于模型会在行动、规划或协作决策中使用这些状态。CARD 提供了一个较清楚的诊断框架：用跨轴干预检查信息是否从内部表示流向目标预测。对训练目标设计有参考意义，尤其是 VLM/agentic VLM 中仅训练“说出状态”可能不足，需要构造让状态影响行动的监督或 RL 信号。
summary.technical_approach: 方法分三步。第一，对 belief、intent、knowledge 三个轴分别训练 per-layer、per-head 的 L2 正则 logistic probe，输入是一对互为肯定/否定的 statement，取最终输入 token 的 head activation，得到从负例指向匹配正例的单位方向。第二，选择 held-out accuracy 最高的 top-K=56 个 layer-head 位置，约占全部 heads 的 7%，在 forward hook 中只对最后 token、只对这些 head slice 加入 alpha 倍标准差尺度的 probe direction，alpha 使用 +10 和 -10。第三，不看同一轴输出，而是测量另一个轴的预测变化，例如沿 belief 方向 steering 后观察 action 或 knowledge 的准确率变化。作者用 true-belief 和 false-belief 条件下的 accuracy gap shift，以及 mean-accuracy shift，判断某个内部表示是否被路由到另一个预测轴。Relay Chain 是配套的 cooperative grid-world benchmark，加入了 action axis，用 success 和 counter partition 区分 constant-prior、world-state tracker、belief-conditional 三种行为。
summary.experiments: 实验覆盖四个 open-weight VLM family。关键发现是：belief 表示可以从同一层的 head activation 中线性解码出来，held-out probe accuracy 达到 78% 到 94%；对 belief 方向做 activation steering 后，belief 和 knowledge 预测会出现因果响应，说明这些方向不是纯粹的 probe artifact。但 action prediction 基本不响应 belief steering，表现为 action 相关的 gap-shift 或 mean-accuracy shift 接近零。这个结果指向一种 routing failure：模型编码了合作伙伴的 belief，却没有把该信息稳定用于下一步行动选择。文中还使用正负方向 steering 和 projection-subtraction 作为控制，降低把效果误判为普通输出偏置的风险。
summary.reading_guide: 建议泛读，约 20 到 30 分钟。先看 Method 中 CARD 的定义，尤其是 top-K head selection、alpha=±10 steering、gap-shift 和 mean-accuracy shift 这几个指标。然后看 Relay Chain 的数据构造，确认 success/counter partition 如何区分不同策略。结果部分重点看 3×3 cross-axis matrix：same-axis 是正控制，off-diagonal 才是核心。若只关心预训练启发，可重点关注 belief 可解码但不进入 action 的证据，以及作者如何把这个现象转化为可测的 routing failure。

summary_en.core_problem: CARD asks whether mental-state representations inside VLMs are actually used by downstream predictions. A linear probe can show that a model encodes a partner's belief, knowledge, or intention, and same-axis steering can show that such a direction affects answers on the same axis. Neither test tells whether the belief representation is routed into action prediction. The paper targets this gap: distinguishing absent representations from unused representations.
summary_en.importance: The work is mainly a diagnostic and mechanistic evaluation contribution, with a useful implication for multimodal pretraining and agentic VLM training. Improving a model's ability to answer questions about mental states is not the same as making the model use those states when choosing actions. CARD offers a way to test representation use through cross-axis interventions. This is relevant when designing pretraining, SFT, or RL data for cooperative settings: supervision that asks the model to describe beliefs may not train the pathway that turns beliefs into decisions.
summary_en.technical_approach: CARD has three steps. First, for each axis such as belief, intent, or knowledge, the authors train L2-regularized logistic probes on per-layer, per-head activations at the final input token. Each example contains a matched statement and its negation, and the learned unit vector points from the negated statement toward the matched one. Second, they select the top K=56 layer-head pairs by held-out probe accuracy, roughly 7% of all heads, and use forward hooks to add a scaled version of the probe direction only at the final-token position and only in those head slices. The steering scale is alpha=+10 or alpha=-10 in units of the activation standard deviation along the probe direction. Third, they measure a different prediction axis after steering, for example steering belief while evaluating action. The main statistics are the true-belief versus false-belief accuracy gap shift and a mean-accuracy shift. The accompanying Relay Chain benchmark is a cooperative grid-world setup with belief, knowledge, intent, and action questions, plus success and counter partitions that separate constant-prior behavior, world-state tracking, and belief-conditional behavior.
summary_en.experiments: The experiments cover four open-weight VLM families. The central result is that belief is linearly decodable from selected head activations with 78% to 94% held-out probe accuracy. Steering along the belief direction causally affects belief and knowledge predictions, which makes the direction more credible than a purely correlational probe. However, action prediction shows little or no response to belief steering: the action-related gap shift and mean-accuracy shift are near zero. This supports the routing-failure interpretation: the model encodes the partner's belief but does not reliably use it when predicting the next cooperative action. The paper also uses opposite-polarity steering and projection-subtraction style controls to reduce the chance that the measured effect is just a generic output bias.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim in 20 to 30 minutes. Start with the CARD method: probe training, top-K head selection, alpha=±10 steering, gap shift, and mean-accuracy shift. Then read the Relay Chain construction to understand why the success and counter partitions are needed. In the results, focus on the 3-by-3 cross-axis matrices. Same-axis entries are positive controls; off-diagonal entries are the main evidence. For pretraining-oriented readers, the most useful part is the evidence that a VLM can encode belief without using it for action, and the way this failure is made measurable through cross-axis activation interventions.

recommendation.zh: 通过activation steering揭示了VLM内部表征与最终输出之间的断层（有belief但不用），对理解模型内部推理机制和设计更好的对齐/路由策略有启发。
recommendation.en: Reveals the disconnect between internal representations and final outputs in VLMs via activation steering (possessing belief but not using it), inspiring understanding of internal reasoning mechanisms and design of better alignment/routing strategies.

paper.title: From Inference to Adaptation: A Unified Optimal Transport View of Vision Language Model
paper.abstract: Vision-language models (VLMs) have demonstrated remarkable zero-shot capabilities yet remain sensitive to real-world distribution shifts during inference. Although significant efforts are devoted to adapting VLMs at test time, they rely heavily on noisy pseudo-labels predicted directly from raw embedding similarities during inference, which are unreliable under distribution shift and mislead the adaptation. To avoid noise amplification, existing works craft coarse-grained surrogate objectives du

summary.core_problem: 视觉语言模型（VLMs）在测试时适应（TTA）过程中，由于依赖推理时原始嵌入相似度预测的噪声伪标签，导致在分布偏移下适应效果不佳。
summary.importance: 提出了一种统一的最优传输（OT）视角，桥接了 VLM 推理和适应之间脱节的目标，通过显式建模跨模态样本级关系来改善 TTA 性能。
summary.technical_approach: 将零样本图像分类任务公式化为通过 Wasserstein OT 编码的跨模态对齐问题。在推理阶段，利用 OT 距离进行预测；在适应阶段，设计基于 OT 的目标函数，避免了传统方法中粗粒度替代目标导致的推理与适应目标不匹配问题。
summary.experiments: 在多个分布偏移数据集上进行了实验，验证了该方法在 VLM 测试时适应中的有效性。
summary.authors_note: UIUC 和 Wayne State University 的研究。

summary_en.core_problem: Test-time adaptation (TTA) of Vision-Language Models (VLMs) suffers under distribution shifts due to reliance on noisy pseudo-labels predicted from raw embedding similarities during inference.
summary_en.importance: Proposes a unified Optimal Transport (OT) perspective that bridges the detached objectives of VLM inference and adaptation, improving TTA performance by explicitly modeling cross-modal sample-level relationships.
summary_en.technical_approach: Formulates zero-shot image classification as a cross-modal alignment problem encoded via Wasserstein OT. Uses OT distance for prediction during inference and designs an OT-based objective for adaptation, avoiding the objective mismatch caused by coarse-grained surrogate objectives in traditional methods.
summary_en.experiments: Conducted experiments on multiple distribution shift datasets, validating the effectiveness of the proposed method for VLM test-time adaptation.
summary_en.authors_note: Research from UIUC and Wayne State University.

recommendation.zh: 将最优传输引入 VLM 的 Test-Time Adaptation，理论框架较完整，但属于典型的 CV/VLM 下游适应方法，对预训练启发有限。
recommendation.en: Introduces Optimal Transport to VLM Test-Time Adaptation with a solid theoretical framework, but it's a typical CV/VLM downstream adaptation method with limited inspiration for pre-training.

paper.title: Scaling Vision-Language Models Is Not Enough to Mitigate Bias
paper.abstract: Vision-Language Models (VLMs) such as CLIP are now foundational to multimodal systems, yet their robustness to spurious correlations remains poorly understood at scale. We present the first large-scale empirical study of 194 publicly available VLMs, including 16 model families, covering a wide range of model sizes, 24 training datasets, and three evaluation benchmarks, namely ImageNet (overall performance), CelebA (typical single-attribute bias), and UrbanCars (complex multi-attribute biases). A

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作要回答的不是“更大的 VLM 是否更强”，而是“更大的 VLM 是否更不容易学到捷径”。作者把问题收得很清楚：在零样本 VLM 中，预训练阶段学到的图文共现偏差会直接暴露到下游，没有任务特定的纠偏步骤；因此需要系统检验，模型规模、训练数据、架构细节这些常见设计轴，究竟谁真正影响对 spurious correlation 的鲁棒性。全文的核心发现是：标准性能上的 scaling 规律，在偏差更复杂的设定下会明显失效。随着评测从普通识别转向单属性偏差，再转向多属性偏差，模型规模与性能的相关性快速衰减，说明“把模型做大”并不能稳定换来更好的偏差鲁棒性。
summary.importance: 对预训练研究的意义主要有两层。第一，它把“robustness to spurious correlations”从零散案例，推进成了一个接近预训练配方分析的问题：作者一次性比较了 194 个公开 VLM、16 个家族、24 个训练数据源，覆盖参数规模、数据规模、数据策展程度、patch granularity 等多个轴，因而结论不再只是某个模型族上的局部现象。第二，它给出一个对基座训练很直接的提醒：如果目标是做更可靠的多模态基础模型，继续沿着参数量和常规 benchmark 往上推，并不足以解决偏差问题；训练数据的规模与清洗质量、视觉 token 的粒度，反而是更稳定的控制杆。对做统一多模态预训练的人，这个结论很实用，因为它把注意力从“单纯扩模型”拉回到“数据分布和表示方式”。
summary.technical_approach:
方法上，这不是提出新模型，而是做大规模受控分析。评测设计有一个清晰的难度阶梯：ImageNet 用来测一般识别能力；CelebA 测单一 spurious attribute 下的鲁棒性；UrbanCars 测两个同时存在的 spurious attributes，对应更复杂的 group shift。作者把偏差复杂度形式化为属性数 M 的增长，组数随 |Y|×∏|A_m| 组合爆炸，因此多属性偏差比单属性偏差更难，这个设定和实验观察是一致的。

分析上，作者把多个设计因素拆开看：模型参数规模、训练数据规模、训练数据是否经过策展/过滤、视觉 patch size、架构家族等。一个关键点是他们不只看总体相关性，还做 controlled comparisons，也就是尽量在同一家族或相近设定下只改变一个因素，避免把“模型大”与“数据更好”“架构更新”混在一起。全文最有信息量的结论有三条：
1. 模型规模对标准识别仍然有效，但对复杂偏差鲁棒性几乎失效；
2. 数据属性更稳，尤其是数据规模和策展质量，在多属性偏差上仍保持可观相关性；
3. 输入表示会影响偏差鲁棒性，patch 变粗会伤害 worst-group 表现，说明更细粒度的视觉 token 有助于保留区分真正因果特征与背景捷径所需的信息。

从机制解释看，作者的论证是：对比学习式 VLM 训练会主动利用图文共现中的高频捷径，而扩大模型容量会提升拟合这些统计规律的能力，但不保证模型更愿意依赖因果相关特征。相反，数据策展可以直接改变 shortcut 的暴露频率，patch granularity 则影响模型能否解析局部对象与背景的细粒度差异。这也是为什么这些因素比单纯 scaling 更稳定。
summary.experiments:
实验规模是全文的重要支撑：194 个公开 VLM，来自 16 个模型家族，参数量从 63M 到 3.6B，训练数据覆盖 24 个来源，规模从 13M 到 12.8B 样本。评测包括 ImageNet、CelebA 和 UrbanCars，分别对应总体性能、单属性偏差、多属性偏差。

最关键的数字有几组。第一，Spearman 相关性随偏差复杂度显著下降：模型规模与性能的相关性在 ImageNet 上是 ρ=0.68，在 CelebA 上降到 ρ=0.48，在 UrbanCars 上几乎消失，仅 ρ=0.05。这个结果直接支撑“bias complexity sensitivity”。第二，在受控比较里，只增大模型规模时，ImageNet 平均提升约 +2.6%，但 UrbanCars 的 Worst-Group Accuracy 反而平均下降 -4.2%。这说明更大模型可能更会利用训练分布中的 shortcut，而不是更能摆脱它。第三，数据因素更稳：训练数据规模在多属性偏差上仍有 ρ=0.41 的相关性；经过策展的数据集，相比同规模但未过滤的数据，Worst-Group Accuracy 最多可高出 25%。第四，视觉 token 粒度有明确影响：patch size 从 16 增到 32，在受控比较中会让 UrbanCars 的 WGA 下降 6.8%。

如果看消融的含义，最值得注意的不是某个绝对最优模型，而是不同设计轴在不同 benchmark 上的“斜率变化”：标准 benchmark 上有效的改动，到了复杂偏差 benchmark 上可能失灵，甚至反向。这一点比单个榜单名次更重要。
summary.reading_guide:
这篇适合泛读，但建议把引言、实验设定和主要图表认真看完。先看 Figure 1，抓住全文主结论：随着偏差复杂度上升，scaling law 的解释力在下降。然后看 methodology 里对 group structure 和 bias complexity 的定义，理解为什么 UrbanCars 比 CelebA 更能暴露问题。实验部分重点看两类结果：一类是相关性分析，另一类是 controlled comparisons。前者告诉你哪些因素“总体上相关”，后者告诉你这些相关性是否可能只是混杂因素。

如果时间有限，优先看：1）模型规模、数据规模、数据策展、patch size 这几组主结果；2）Worst-Group Accuracy 的定义和使用方式；3）作者如何控制不同模型家族之间的比较偏差。预计 25 到 35 分钟可以抓住主要信息。若你做多模态预训练，值得深挖的点有两个：一是 curated data 为什么能在 size-matched 条件下带来这么大的 WGA 差距；二是 patch granularity 对 shortcut reliance 的影响，后续可以联想到视觉 tokenizer、region token 或 object-centric 表示的设计。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper asks a more precise question than standard scaling studies: does scaling a VLM make it less reliant on spurious correlations, or only better on average recognition? The full paper makes the setup explicit. In zero-shot VLMs, biases learned during web-scale pretraining are exposed directly at deployment time, because there is no task-specific debiasing stage. The central finding is that the usual scaling story weakens sharply as bias complexity increases. Model size correlates well with ImageNet performance, less with single-attribute bias robustness, and almost not at all with multi-attribute bias robustness.
summary_en.importance: Its value for pretraining research is practical rather than architectural. First, it turns spurious-correlation robustness into a large-scale recipe analysis problem: 194 public VLMs, 16 families, 24 training datasets, and multiple design axes are compared in one study. That gives the conclusions more weight than a single-family case study. Second, it identifies which levers remain useful when standard scaling stops helping. Data properties, especially dataset size and curation quality, are more stable predictors of robustness than parameter count. Patch granularity also matters. For people working on multimodal foundation models, this is a direct reminder that reliability will not come from scaling alone; it depends on what data the model sees and how visual evidence is represented.
summary_en.technical_approach:
This is a large empirical analysis rather than a new model. The evaluation is organized as a progression of bias complexity: ImageNet for overall recognition, CelebA for a single spurious attribute, and UrbanCars for two simultaneous spurious attributes. The paper formalizes this through group structure induced by labels and spurious attributes, with the number of groups growing combinatorially as more attributes are involved. That framing matters because it explains why multi-attribute bias is qualitatively harder, not just a slightly noisier benchmark.

The analysis decomposes several design factors: model size, training data size, whether the training data is curated or unfiltered, patch size, and architecture family. A useful part of the paper is that it does not rely only on global correlations. It also performs controlled comparisons where one factor changes while others are kept as comparable as possible within a family. That reduces the risk of attributing gains from better data or newer architectures to scale alone.

Three findings stand out. First, model scaling remains effective for standard recognition but loses predictive power for robustness under complex bias. Second, data properties are more stable: larger and better curated datasets retain meaningful association with worst-group performance even in the harder settings. Third, input granularity matters: coarser visual patches hurt worst-group accuracy, suggesting that fine-grained visual tokens help the model separate causal object evidence from background shortcuts.

The mechanism proposed by the paper is sensible. Contrastive VLM training benefits from frequent image-text co-occurrences, which are often shortcuts. More capacity helps fit those regularities, but does not force the model to rely on causally relevant features. Data curation changes the shortcut distribution directly, and finer patching preserves local evidence that may be necessary to resist background or co-occurrence bias.
summary_en.experiments:
The experimental coverage is the backbone of the paper: 194 public VLMs from 16 families, parameter counts from 63M to 3.6B, and 24 training data sources ranging from 13M to 12.8B samples. Evaluation uses ImageNet, CelebA, and UrbanCars, corresponding to overall performance, single-attribute bias, and multi-attribute bias.

The most important numbers are straightforward. The Spearman correlation between model scale and performance drops from 0.68 on ImageNet to 0.48 on CelebA and to 0.05 on UrbanCars. That is the clearest quantitative evidence for what the authors call bias complexity sensitivity. In controlled comparisons where model size is the main varying factor, scaling improves ImageNet accuracy by about +2.6% on average, but reduces UrbanCars worst-group accuracy by -4.2%. So larger models can become better at exploiting shortcuts rather than better at avoiding them. Data-related factors are more stable: training data size still shows a correlation of 0.41 with robustness on the multi-attribute benchmark, and curated datasets outperform size-matched unfiltered alternatives by up to 25% in worst-group accuracy. Patch granularity also has a measurable effect: moving from patch size 16 to 32 lowers UrbanCars WGA by 6.8% in controlled comparisons.

The main experimental lesson is not which single model wins, but which design axes keep their effect as the benchmark becomes more bias-sensitive. That is more informative for pretraining decisions than leaderboard ordering.
summary_en.reading_guide:
This is a skim paper, but it is worth reading the introduction, the benchmark setup, and the main result figures carefully. Start with Figure 1 to get the central claim: the explanatory power of scaling weakens as bias complexity increases. Then read the methodology section that defines group structure and bias complexity, because that makes the UrbanCars result easier to interpret. In the experiments, focus on two result types: correlation analyses and controlled comparisons. The first tells you what factors track robustness globally; the second tells you whether those trends survive when confounders are reduced.

If time is limited, prioritize the sections on model scale, data scale, data curation, and patch size, plus the definition of worst-group accuracy. Around 25 to 35 minutes should be enough to extract the main message. If you work on multimodal pretraining, two follow-up questions are worth deeper thought: why curation gives such a large WGA gain even at matched dataset size, and how patch granularity interacts with shortcut reliance and visual tokenization design.

recommendation.zh: 读相关性表和数据分组即可；它削弱“VLM 放大自然去偏”的 prior，数据治理信号更硬。
recommendation.en: Read the correlation tables and dataset splits; it weakens the prior that VLM scaling alone washes out bias.

paper.title: The Gate Always Closes: On Injecting Auxiliary Signals into Frozen Vision-Language Models
paper.abstract: Auxiliary signal pathways in VLMs are routinely fitted with learnable gates so the optimiser can decide how much of the signal to admit. We find that the optimiser almost always decides on zero: across five injection designs, every gated pathway becomes behaviourally closed, with accuracy invariant to ablating the pathway at inference even when the gate parameter would nominally pass 30-45% of the signal. We attribute this suppression phenomenon to two regimes, a dead-gradient regime formalised

summary.core_problem: 冻结视觉语言模型（VLM）在 LoRA 微调中，向冻结主干时通过可学习门控注入辅助信号的路径几乎都会被优化器完全抑制，同时 LoRA 微调容易侵蚀预训练模型的泛化能力，以及双曲空间投影的前缀 token 会因嵌入范数不匹配导致生成崩溃。
summary.importance: 揭示了 VLM 适配器设计中一个被忽视的门控抑制现象，给出了两种机制解释，为辅助信号注入的设计原则提供了实证依据；同时提出利用训练期前向耦合的几何正则化思路，可直接迁移到多模态预训练与参数高效微调的稳定性研究。
summary.technical_approach: 1. 门控抑制现象：在 5 种注入设计（注意力偏置、门控前缀 token、边际训练组合目标等）下，即使门控参数名义上通过 30–45% 信号，推理时消融该路径后任务精度完全不变，路径行为上完全闭合。归因于两种机制：① 死梯度区：图像衍生信号对 caption 不变性导致一阶判别梯度为零（命题 1 形式化）；② 负效用区：辅助信号实际损害损失，梯度持续将门控推向零。2. 几何正则化：将视觉场景层级关系编码为洛伦兹双曲面上的连续潜图，用 IoA 驱动的蕴含损失与角度排斥损失作为 LoRA 训练期的辅助损失，仅在训练前向传播参与计算，推理时可完全丢弃，通过前向耦合约束 LoRA 不偏离预训练流形。3. 前缀注入稳定性：双曲空间投影的前缀 token 与文本嵌入存在范数失配，对前缀做 RMS 归一化对齐文本嵌入分布，解决生成崩溃，且证明崩溃源于残差流主导而非注意力 softmax 饱和。
summary.experiments: 以 LLaVA-1.5-7B 为基座，在 GQA 等任务上验证：无辅助监督的 LoRA 微调使 GQA 精度从 60.38% 降至 57.21%，加入双曲几何正则后保留预训练精度；发现学习提示在关系精度与属性精度存在权衡，几何训练可避免该权衡；5 种门控注入设计全部出现行为闭合；RMS 归一化可稳定前缀注入的生成质量。
summary.reading_guide: 重点阅读第 4 节门控抑制现象的机制分析与命题 1，第 3 节几何辅助损失的设计逻辑，第 5 节嵌入范数对齐的诊断实验；附录补充双曲流形公式与关系特征构造；预计阅读时间 30–40 分钟，核心创新在训练动态层面的观察，而非双曲编码本身只是实验载体。

summary_en.core_problem: When fine-tuning frozen Vision-Language Models (VLMs) with LoRA, learnable-gated auxiliary signal injection pathways are almost entirely suppressed by the optimizer; meanwhile LoRA fine-tuning tends to erode the pretrained model's generalization, and prefix tokens projected from hyperbolic space cause generation collapse due to embedding norm mismatch.
summary_en.importance: Uncovers a neglected gating suppression phenomenon in VLM adapter design with two mechanistic explanations, providing empirical guidance for auxiliary signal injection design; the geometric regularization via training-time forward coupling is directly transferable to multimodal pretraining and parameter-efficient fine-tuning stability research.
summary_en.technical_approach: 1. Gating suppression: across five injection designs (attention biases, gated prefix tokens, margin-trained compositional objectives, etc.), even when gate parameters nominally pass 30–45% of the signal, ablating the pathway at inference leaves task accuracy unchanged — pathways are behaviorally closed. Two regimes are identified: (a) dead-gradient regime, formalized in Proposition 1, where caption-invariance of image-derived signals nulls first-order discriminative gradients; (b) negative-utility regime, where the auxiliary signal actively harms the loss and gradients consistently drive the gate toward zero. 2. Geometric regularization: hierarchical visual scene relations are encoded as a continuous latent graph on the Lorentz hyperboloid, with IoA-driven entailment loss and angular repulsion loss acting as auxiliary losses during LoRA training. The geometric computation only participates in the forward pass at training time and can be dropped entirely at inference, constraining LoRA from drifting away from the pretrained manifold via forward coupling. 3. Prefix injection stability: prefix tokens projected from hyperbolic space exhibit norm mismatch with text embeddings; RMS normalization of prefixes to the text embedding distribution resolves generation collapse, which is attributed to residual-stream dominance rather than attention-softmax saturation.
summary_en.experiments: Using LLaVA-1.5-7B as the base model: LoRA fine-tuning without auxiliary supervision drops GQA accuracy from 60.38% to 57.21%, while adding hyperbolic geometric regularization preserves pretrained accuracy; learned prompts exhibit a trade-off between relational and attribute accuracy, which geometric training avoids; all five gated injection designs exhibit behavioral closure; RMS normalization stabilizes generation quality for prefix injection.
summary_en.reading_guide: Focus on Section 4 for mechanistic analysis of gating suppression and Proposition 1, Section 3 for the design logic of geometric auxiliary losses, Section 5 for diagnostic experiments on embedding norm alignment; supplement with appendix for hyperbolic manifold formulations and relational feature construction; estimated reading time 30–40 minutes. The core innovation lies in training-dynamics-level observations, while the hyperbolic encoding itself is only an experimental vehicle.

recommendation.zh: 揭示了 VLM 微调中一个反直觉的现象：优化器倾向于关闭辅助信号的门控。作者没有强行打开门控，而是将其转化为训练时的正则化项，思路巧妙，对多模态微调有启发。
recommendation.en: Reveals a counter-intuitive phenomenon in VLM fine-tuning: optimizers tend to close gates for auxiliary signals. Instead of forcing them open, the authors cleverly repurpose them as training-time regularization, offering insights for multimodal fine-tuning.

paper.title: Self-Boosting Vision-Language Models with Noisy Student On-Policy Self-Distillation
paper.abstract: Post-training enables vision-language models (VLMs) to understand human instructions and perform various downstream tasks. Current post-training methods usually rely on human-annotated data, distillation from external models, reinforcement learning with human feedback, or verifiable answers. This limits their ability to improve without external supervision. To tackle this, we propose NOPD (Noisy Student On-Policy Self-Distillation), a simple yet effective self-distillation approach that improves

summary.core_problem: 现有VLM后训练方法均依赖人工标注、外部教师模型或可验证奖励等外部监督，无法在无任何外部监督的条件下实现模型自我性能提升。
summary.importance: 提出了无外部监督的VLM自提升范式，利用输入扰动带来的预测差异构造自监督信号，拓展了后训练的监督来源；这种on-policy自蒸馏思路可迁移到纯文本LLM的后训练甚至预训练阶段，为利用模型自身能力生成密集监督信号、减少对外部数据/模型的依赖提供了新方向；观察到的隐式推理压缩现象，对理解模型推理效率与能力提升的关系具有参考价值。
summary.technical_approach:
提出NOPD（Noisy Student On-Policy Self-Distillation，噪声学生同策略自蒸馏），核心是让同一个模型同时扮演教师和学生角色：教师分支处理干净的图文输入，输出token级概率分布；学生分支处理加噪/损坏的输入，训练目标是让学生的输出分布与教师分布通过KL散度对齐。
该方法利用干净输入与损坏输入之间的预测差异构造自监督信号，不需要任何外部标注、外部教师模型或可验证奖励。与传统噪声学生方法不同，其教师和学生是同一模型的不同输入分支，属于同策略自蒸馏，无需迭代训练多代学生模型。
summary.experiments:
在5个视觉推理基准上的测试显示，NOPD可持续提升VLM性能，效果达到或超过依赖外部监督的方法。
NOPD会带来隐式推理压缩效应：模型输出长度缩短的同时准确率提升。
该方法在不同模型架构和非推理类任务上均表现出泛化性。
summary.reading_guide: 先读第1章引言和第3章方法部分，快速理解NOPD的核心思路与现有自蒸馏/噪声学生方法的区别；再读第4章主要实验结果和消融分析，重点关注性能提升逻辑和推理压缩现象。无需深入查看所有基准的详细数值。预计阅读时间30-45分钟。

summary_en.core_problem: Existing vision-language model (VLM) post-training methods all rely on external supervision such as human annotations, external teacher models, or verifiable rewards, and no approach can improve VLM performance without any external supervision.
summary_en.importance: This work introduces a supervision-free VLM self-improvement paradigm that uses prediction discrepancies from input perturbations to generate self-supervised signals, expanding the sources of post-training supervision. The on-policy self-distillation idea can be transferred to text-only LLM post-training or even pre-training, offering a new direction for reducing reliance on external data or models by leveraging a model's own capabilities to generate dense supervision. The observed implicit reasoning compression effect also informs research on the relationship between reasoning efficiency and capability gain.
summary_en.technical_approach:
The proposed NOPD (Noisy Student On-Policy Self-Distillation) uses a single model as both teacher and student. The teacher branch processes clean image-text inputs and produces token-level probability distributions. The student branch processes corrupted/noisy inputs, and is trained to align its output distribution with the teacher's distribution via KL divergence.
This method constructs self-supervision signals from the prediction gap between clean and corrupted inputs, requiring no external labels, external teacher models, or verifiable rewards. Unlike traditional noisy student methods, the teacher and student are two input branches of the same model, making it an on-policy self-distillation approach that does not require iterative training of successive student generations.
summary_en.experiments:
Tests across five visual reasoning benchmarks show NOPD consistently improves VLM performance, matching or exceeding methods that depend on external supervision.
NOPD induces an implicit reasoning compression effect: model output length decreases while accuracy increases.
The method generalizes across different model architectures and non-reasoning tasks.
summary_en.reading_guide: Start with Section 1 (Introduction) and Section 3 (Method) to grasp the core idea of NOPD and its differences from existing self-distillation and noisy student methods. Then read Section 4 for main experimental results and ablation studies, focusing on the logic of performance gain and the reasoning compression phenomenon. Detailed per-benchmark numerical results can be skimmed. Estimated reading time: 30–45 minutes.

recommendation.zh: VLM后训练的自监督思路，§3的方法设计对多模态后训练数据构造有参考。
recommendation.en: Self-supervised post-training approach for VLMs; §3 method design is useful for multimodal post-training data construction.

paper.title: What CLIP Knows but Cannot Say: Recovering Negation from Frozen Intermediate Features
paper.abstract: Contrastive vision-language models such as CLIP map semantically opposite phrases (e.g., "a dog" vs. "not a dog") to nearly identical embeddings, rendering them insensitive to negation. We attribute this failure to a phenomenon we call Representational Collapse: by tracking compositional divergence and visual alignment across the CLIP text encoder, we show that middle layers build compositional syntax, but the final layers collapse this structure as visual alignment rises, producing a syntax-bli

summary.core_problem: CLIP类对比视觉语言模型无法区分带否定的描述和原描述，会将语义相反的短语映射到几乎相同的嵌入空间位置，存在明显的肯定偏差。现有微调方法会改动预训练权重，破坏依赖冻结CLIP特征的下游系统兼容性，且受联合嵌入空间的几何约束限制，无法根本解决否定识别问题。
summary.importance: 工作揭示了对比VLM预训练中的层间表征动态：文本编码器中间层已经学到了包含否定在内的组合句法结构，但最后几层为优化跨模态视觉对齐，会主动丢弃这类句法信息，形成表征坍缩。这个发现对VLM预训练的目标设计、层间监督配置、对齐与组合性的权衡有直接参考价值；冻结骨干、仅从中间层提取信号补全能力的思路，也为复用预训练多模态模型提供了轻量可行的路径。
summary.technical_approach: 首先设计逐层组合散度（LCD）指标，逐层级量否定表述与对应肯定表述的表征分离度，结合每层的视觉对齐程度，定位到编码器中句法信息最丰富的“组合峰值层”，以及视觉对齐快速上升前的稳定“锚点层”，验证了最后几层的表征坍缩现象。在此基础上提出PeakPatch轻量校正系统，全程冻结CLIP权重，仅新增两个小模块：嵌入校正网络（ECN）通过交叉注意力从组合峰值层提取否定相关信号，锚定锚点层的稳定表征，预测偏移向量将丢失的句法信息注入最终层嵌入；分数校正网络（SCN）对比峰值层表征、校正后的嵌入与图像嵌入，为余弦相似度分数输出有界的标量校正。两个模块联合端到端训练，总参数量5.2M，仅占CLIP骨干的3.5%，保留原有的余弦相似度推理接口。
summary.experiments: 在COCO否定多选任务上达到74.3%准确率，较原生CLIP提升35.1个百分点，较最优的编码器微调基线提升17.8个百分点；在完全分布外的检索场景下，仅修改文本侧路径的表现超过所有微调基线；校正后的嵌入可直接迁移到文生图任务，否定遵循度分数提升18.4。在NegBench VOC多选任务上，原生CLIP对肯定描述的准确率为81%，对否定描述的准确率仅3%（低于随机猜测），校正后否定识别能力大幅恢复。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读重点关注前半部分的逐层表征探测与表征坍缩现象分析，这是对预训练研究最有迁移价值的结论；ECN、SCN的具体网络结构可以快速浏览，不用细抠。核心收获是：预训练VLM并非没有学到否定这类组合语义，只是这类信号在最终层为对齐目标被丢弃，仍然可以从中间层恢复。预计阅读时间20分钟。

summary_en.core_problem: Contrastive vision-language models such as CLIP fail to distinguish negated descriptions from their affirmative counterparts, mapping semantically opposite phrases to nearly identical positions in the shared embedding space and exhibiting a strong affirmation bias. Existing fine-tuning methods modify pretrained weights, break compatibility with downstream systems built on frozen CLIP features, and are fundamentally limited by geometric constraints of the joint embedding space that prevent full negation support.
summary_en.importance: This work identifies a clear layer-wise representation dynamic in contrastive VLM pretraining: middle layers of the text encoder already learn compositional syntactic structure (including negation), but final layers actively discard this syntactic information to optimize cross-modal visual alignment, leading to what the authors term Representational Collapse. This finding has direct implications for VLM pretraining objective design, layer-wise supervision configuration, and balancing the tradeoff between cross-modal alignment and compositional generalization. The approach of recovering missing capabilities from intermediate layers while keeping the backbone frozen also offers a lightweight path for reusing pretrained multimodal models.
summary_en.technical_approach: The authors first introduce Layer-wise Compositional Divergence (LCD), a metric that measures per-layer representation separation between negated and affirmative captions. Combining LCD measurements with per-layer visual alignment scores, they identify a "compositional peak layer" where syntactic information is maximally preserved, and a stable "anchor layer" located before the sharp rise in visual alignment, confirming the representational collapse in final layers. Based on this observation, they propose PeakPatch, a lightweight correction system that keeps CLIP fully frozen and adds two small modules: an Embedding Correction Network (ECN) that uses cross-attention to extract negation signals from the compositional peak layer, anchors these signals to stable representations from the anchor layer, and predicts a deviation vector to inject lost syntax into final-layer embeddings; a Score Correction Network (SCN) that compares peak-layer representations, corrected embeddings, and image embeddings to output bounded scalar corrections for cosine similarity scores. The two modules are trained end-to-end, adding 5.2M parameters (3.5% of the CLIP backbone) while preserving the standard cosine similarity inference interface.
summary_en.experiments: PeakPatch achieves 74.3% accuracy on the COCO negation multiple-choice task, a 35.1 point improvement over vanilla CLIP and a 17.8 point improvement over the strongest encoder fine-tuning baseline. In fully out-of-distribution retrieval settings, it outperforms all fine-tuning baselines despite only modifying the text-side processing path. Corrected embeddings transfer directly to text-to-image generation, improving negation adherence scores by 18.4. On the NegBench VOC multiple-choice task, vanilla CLIP reaches 81% accuracy on affirmative captions but only 3% on negated captions (worse than random guess), while PeakPatch largely recovers negation discrimination capability.
summary_en.reading_guide: For skimming, prioritize the layer-wise probing analysis and the description of Representational Collapse in the early method section—this is the insight most transferable to pretraining research. The specific architectural details of the ECN and SCN modules can be scanned quickly. The core takeaway is that pretrained VLMs do not fail to learn compositional semantics such as negation; these signals are merely discarded in final layers to satisfy alignment objectives, and remain recoverable from intermediate layers. Estimated reading time: 20 minutes.

recommendation.zh: 对 CLIP 文本编码器内部表征坍塌的分析很有意思，揭示了对比学习目标如何牺牲细粒度语法（如否定）以换取粗粒度视觉对齐，对理解多模态对齐机制有启发。
recommendation.en: The analysis of representational collapse in CLIP's text encoder is insightful, revealing how contrastive objectives sacrifice fine-grained syntax (like negation) for coarse visual alignment; useful for understanding multimodal alignment mechanisms.

paper.title: Ask Twice, Look Twice: Prompt Echoing Resolves the Question-First Paradox in Vision-Language Models
paper.abstract: Where should the question go in a vision-language model (VLM) prompt: before the image or after it? Intuition says before: knowing what is asked should tell the model where to look. Yet across visual question answering benchmarks, question-first prompting consistently underperforms the image-first ordering recommended for frontier VLMs, a phenomenon we term the question-first paradox. We trace the paradox to a conflict between two stages of VLM computation. Logit-lens and attention probes show t

summary.core_problem: 解释 VLM 中“问题放在图像前反而更差”的 prompt 顺序悖论，并寻找无需训练的修正方式。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是 VLM 推理机制分析加轻量 prompt 方法。它把 prompt 顺序问题拆成两个阶段：问题在图像前确实能引导视觉表征，但答案 token 在生成时更难读取被大量图像 token 隔开的早期问题。这对多模态预训练中的序列布局、图文 interleaving 和 answer-token conditioning 有一定启发。
summary.technical_approach: 论文使用 logit lens、attention probe 和 causal attention knockout 分析 VLM 内部计算。核心诊断是：question-first 改善感知阶段的 patch 表征对齐，但破坏答案阶段对问题文本的访问。由此提出 prompt echoing，即把问题在图像前后各放一次，同时保留视觉引导和答案条件。
summary.experiments: 实验横跨多个 VQA benchmark，比较 question-first、image-first 和 prompt echoing。摘要说明 question-first 在 VQA 上稳定弱于 image-first，attention knockout 验证答案 token 只有在问题位于图像之后时才有效读取问题；具体模型列表和提升数字未在摘要中给出。
summary.authors_note: 作者来自 Carnegie Mellon University；Deva Ramanan 是知名计算机视觉研究者，长期研究视觉识别、检测和视觉基础模型相关问题。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper explains why placing the question before the image can hurt VLM performance, despite the intuition that it should guide visual perception.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is a mechanistic VLM analysis plus a training-free prompt fix. It separates perceptual steering from answer-token conditioning: a question before the image can shape image representations, but the final answer token may fail to attend back to that question after hundreds of visual tokens. This is relevant for multimodal sequence layout and native VLM pretraining design.
summary_en.technical_approach: The authors use logit-lens analysis, attention probes, and causal attention knockout. Their diagnosis is that question-first prompting helps patch-level perception but harms downstream answer formation. They propose prompt echoing, where the question is placed both before and after the image.
summary_en.experiments: The paper evaluates across visual question answering benchmarks and compares question-first, image-first, and echoed prompts. The abstract reports consistent underperformance of question-first prompting and uses attention knockout to show that the answer token reads the question mainly when it follows the image; exact model names and gains are not provided in the abstract.
summary_en.authors_note: The work is from Carnegie Mellon University. Deva Ramanan is a well-known computer vision researcher with substantial work on visual recognition and foundation-model-related vision systems.

recommendation.zh: 只看 probes 和 knockout；它提醒多模态预训练别只管视觉引导，还要保证答案 token 的晚期可访问性。
recommendation.en: Skim the probes and knockout; the useful lesson is to optimize both visual steering and late answer-token access in VLM layouts.

paper.title: On Success and Simplicity: A Second Look at Transferable Vision-Language Attack Pipeline
paper.abstract: Vision-Language Pre-training Models (VLPMs) are known to be vulnerable to adversarial attacks. Recent transferable attacks on VLPMs have followed a common pipeline with complicated loss functions or multi-stage text/image attacks. However, in this paper, we demonstrate that such a sophisticated attack pipeline can be simpler yet more successful. Specifically, we identify three previously overlooked issues caused by inappropriate cross-modal interactions and excessive operations. To address them,

summary.core_problem: 重新审视视觉-语言预训练模型的可迁移对抗攻击流程，指出复杂跨模态攻击 pipeline 可能引入无效甚至有害操作。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是 VLM 鲁棒性与安全分析。它不直接改进预训练，但对理解视觉-语言对齐表征的脆弱性有参考价值。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 Simple Vision-Language Attack，识别既有 pipeline 中不合适跨模态交互和过度操作带来的三个问题，并用更简单的攻击流程提升迁移性和效率。
summary.experiments: 在四个数据集和三个下游任务上验证。摘要给出 Flickr30k 文图检索结果：SimVLA 在 R@1 transferability 上比强 baseline 高 8.01%-14.71%，耗时约为 35.73%，最大显存约为 46.26%。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper revisits transferable attacks on vision-language pretrained models and argues that complex cross-modal attack pipelines may contain unnecessary or harmful operations.
summary_en.importance: This is a VLM robustness and security analysis. It does not improve pretraining directly, but it offers evidence about fragility in vision-language aligned representations.
summary_en.technical_approach: The proposed Simple Vision-Language Attack identifies three issues caused by inappropriate cross-modal interactions and excessive operations, then simplifies the attack pipeline to improve transferability and efficiency.
summary_en.experiments: The method is evaluated on four datasets and three downstream tasks. On Flickr30k text-image retrieval, SimVLA improves R@1 transferability by 8.01%-14.71% over a strong baseline while using about 35.73% of the time and 46.26% of peak VRAM.

recommendation.zh: 看 abstract 和实验表就够；有意思的是复杂跨模态 attack 反而降迁移性，可作为 VLM 对齐脆弱性备查。
recommendation.en: The abstract and tables are enough; the useful signal is that complex cross-modal attacks can reduce transferability in VLMs.

paper.title: Visual Access Boundaries in Vision-Language Model Reasoning
paper.abstract: Chain-of-Thought (CoT) prompting is widely used as a test-time scaling strategy for Vision-Language Models (VLMs), but it remains unclear what is extended when VLMs generate longer reasoning traces. We ask whether CoT requires continued access to image tokens, or whether it mainly operates over visual information already made available earlier in the forward pass. We introduce Visual Access Sweep, a causal intervention that masks attention from generated-token queries to image-token keys along l

summary.core_problem: 在视觉语言模型（VLMs）中使用思维链（CoT）生成长推理轨迹时，模型是否需要持续访问图像 token，还是主要依赖前向传播早期提取的视觉信息？
summary.importance: 通过引入 Visual Access Sweep 因果干预方法，首次量化了 VLM 在 CoT 推理过程中的视觉访问边界（VAB），揭示了 CoT 并不显著增加对深层视觉特征的依赖，为理解和优化 VLM 的长上下文推理机制提供了关键洞察。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 Visual Access Sweep，一种因果干预技术，通过在层深度和生成时间上掩码生成 token 查询对图像 token 键的注意力，来寻找保持任务准确率的最小访问区域，定义为视觉访问边界（VAB）。
summary.experiments: 在 Qwen2.5-VL 和 InternVL3 的六种模型配置上进行实验。结果表明，无 CoT 直接回答和 CoT 提示都表现出有限的 VAB。在 14B 和 38B 规模的模型中，尽管 CoT 生成的序列长得多，其 VAB 层与无 CoT 的边界最多相差两层。

summary_en.core_problem: When Vision-Language Models (VLMs) generate long reasoning traces using Chain-of-Thought (CoT), do they require continued access to image tokens, or do they mainly rely on visual information extracted earlier in the forward pass?
summary_en.importance: Introduces Visual Access Sweep, a causal intervention, to quantify the Visual Access Boundary (VAB) during VLM CoT reasoning for the first time, revealing that CoT does not significantly increase reliance on deep visual features, providing key insights for understanding and optimizing long-context reasoning in VLMs.
summary_en.technical_approach: Proposes Visual Access Sweep, a causal intervention that masks attention from generated-token queries to image-token keys along layer depth and generation time to find the minimal access region preserving task accuracy, defined as the Visual Access Boundary (VAB).
summary_en.experiments: Conducted on six model configurations from Qwen2.5-VL and InternVL3. Results show both no-CoT direct answering and CoT prompting exhibit finite VABs. In 14B and 38B models, despite substantially longer generations, the VAB layer for CoT differs from the no-CoT boundary by at most two layers.

recommendation.zh: 通过 attention masking 巧妙探究了 VLM CoT 过程中的视觉依赖，发现长 CoT 并不需要持续访问深层视觉 token，对 VLM 推理优化（如 KV cache 压缩）极具启发，建议阅读实验部分。
recommendation.en: Cleverly investigates visual dependency during VLM CoT via attention masking, finding that long CoT doesn't require sustained access to deep visual tokens; highly inspiring for VLM inference optimization (e.g., KV cache compression), recommend reading the experiments.

paper.title: TORINO: Token Reduction via Interpretable Concept Overlap in Vision-Language Models
paper.abstract: Vision-Language Models (VLMs) have demonstrated impressive capabilities across different tasks, but their computational cost is dominated by the large number of visual tokens fed to the language model. Existing token reduction methods rely on attention-based scores or pairwise similarity, without an explicit semantic representation of each token. We introduce TORINO (TOken Reduction via Interpretable coNcept Overlap), a plug-and-play framework for adaptive visual token reduction in VLMs that req

summary.core_problem: TORINO 解决的是 VLM 推理时视觉 token 过多的问题：CLIP/ViT 产生的数百个 patch token 直接送入 LLM，带来较高的注意力计算和显存开销；已有剪枝或合并方法多依赖 attention、CLS 相似度或 embedding 距离，缺少对 token 语义冗余的显式刻画。
summary.importance: 这篇论文对预训练研究的直接价值不在训练 recipe，而在两个接口问题：第一，解释性工具能否反过来指导模型计算路径；第二，视觉 token 压缩是否应从几何相似转向概念相似。对 native multimodal LLM 和图像 tokenization 方向有启发，因为它把视觉 token 的压缩依据从局部外观相似度换成 SAE latent 中的共享概念激活。中等压缩率下，如果语义冗余确实比 embedding 距离更可靠，这类方法可能成为多模态长上下文推理中的轻量前处理模块。
summary.technical_approach: TORINO 是一个无需微调的 inference-time 框架。它把视觉 encoder 某层输出的 patch token 输入到预训练 Sparse Autoencoder，得到稀疏 latent 表示。每个 latent 维度被视为一个较可解释的视觉概念，例如 sky、bull、grass、horns。方法用 token 的主导激活 latent 或共享 latent 来定义 concept overlap，再按概念重叠把 token 分组。分组后有两种压缩方式：一类是在组内剪掉被认为冗余的 token，另一类是将组内 token 融合成代表 token。关键区别在于，它不是用原始 embedding 的欧氏距离做合并，也不是用 attention 分数估计重要性，而是先把 token 映射到稀疏概念空间，再根据概念共享关系做决策。论文采用 Matryoshka BatchTopK SAE：BatchTopK 控制平均激活特征数，Matryoshka 结构让特征字典带有嵌套层级，这有利于用粗粒度概念形成语义区域，用细粒度概念保留局部差异。TORINO 还有固定预算版本，可以在目标 token 数约束下保留概念分组准则；自适应版本则让简单图像压缩得更强，复杂图像保留更多组。
summary.experiments: 根据论文给出的摘要和引言，实验重点是比较 TORINO 与 attention-based、CLS-similarity、pairwise-similarity 等视觉 token reduction baseline，在多个 VLM benchmark 上的性能-压缩折中。作者强调优势主要出现在 moderate-reduction regime，即中等压缩率区间：此时语义冗余仍有可利用空间，概念分组比纯相似度合并更容易保留任务相关信息。论文还分析了这种优势的区间性：压缩过轻时，各方法差距有限；压缩过重时，任何方法都会丢失必要视觉证据，概念空间也难以补偿。由于提供的正文片段没有包含完整结果表和具体数值，参数量、token 数、各 benchmark 精确提升幅度不宜补写。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读建议 20 到 30 分钟。优先看方法部分中 concept overlap 的定义、分组策略、组内 prune/merge 的具体实现，以及 fixed-budget 版本如何满足目标 token 数。实验部分重点看性能-压缩曲线，而不是只看单点结果；尤其要确认 moderate-reduction 区间的定义、不同 benchmark 上是否一致、以及在复杂图像和简单图像上的自适应 token 数分布。消融部分建议关注 SAE 层选择、latent 宽度、BatchTopK/Matryoshka 设置、用主导 latent 分组和多 latent overlap 分组的差别。若关心多模态预训练，可重点思考一个问题：SAE 字典是在 frozen encoder 上后训练得到，还是可以在未来作为 tokenizer/connector 训练目标的一部分。

summary_en.core_problem: TORINO targets the visual-token bottleneck in VLM inference. A CLIP/ViT encoder emits hundreds of patch tokens, and passing all of them into the LLM dominates latency and memory. Prior reduction methods usually rely on attention scores, CLS similarity, or raw embedding distance, which do not explicitly represent what semantic concept each token carries.
summary_en.importance: The main relevance is not a new pretraining recipe, but a useful interface between interpretability and multimodal tokenization. The paper asks whether an SAE dictionary can be used as an operational compression signal, rather than only as a post-hoc analysis tool. For native multimodal LMs, the useful idea is to compress visual tokens by shared concept activations instead of local visual similarity. If this signal remains reliable at scale, it could be a lightweight front-end for multimodal long-context inference.
summary_en.technical_approach: TORINO is a plug-and-play inference-time method. It takes visual patch tokens from a frozen VLM, projects them through a pretrained Sparse Autoencoder, and obtains sparse latent activations. These latent dimensions are treated as interpretable visual concepts, such as sky, bull, grass, or horns. The method defines concept overlap through shared SAE activations, groups tokens by their dominant or overlapping active concepts, and then either prunes redundant tokens within each group or merges them into representative tokens. The central distinction from attention- or similarity-based reduction is the intermediate sparse concept space: reduction decisions are made after semantic decomposition, not directly in the dense embedding space. The paper uses Matryoshka BatchTopK SAEs. BatchTopK controls the average number of active features, while the Matryoshka objective encourages a nested feature hierarchy, which is useful for grouping coarse semantic regions while preserving finer distinctions when needed. A fixed-budget variant enforces a target number of output tokens while keeping the concept-guided grouping criterion.
summary_en.experiments: From the provided text, the empirical claim is that TORINO outperforms attention- and similarity-based baselines across VLM benchmarks in the moderate-reduction regime. This regime matters because semantic redundancy is still exploitable: mild compression leaves little room for improvement, while overly aggressive compression removes necessary visual evidence regardless of the scoring signal. The paper also appears to analyze why the advantage is regime-specific. The available content does not include the full result tables, so exact model sizes, token budgets, benchmark scores, and numerical gains should not be inferred.
summary_en.reading_guide: A 20- to 30-minute skim is enough. Focus on the method section defining concept overlap, the grouping rule, the prune/merge procedure, and the fixed-budget variant. In the experiments, read the accuracy-vs-token curves rather than isolated numbers. Check whether the moderate-compression advantage is consistent across benchmarks, and whether adaptive token counts correlate with image complexity. The most useful ablations are likely SAE layer choice, latent width, BatchTopK/Matryoshka settings, and dominant-latent grouping versus multi-latent overlap. For multimodal pretraining, the key follow-up question is whether such SAE dictionaries should remain a post-hoc compression tool or be incorporated into tokenizer/connector training.

recommendation.zh: 用 SAE 提取的语义概念来做视觉 Token 压缩，思路很巧，为 VLM 推理加速提供了一个比 attention score 更具可解释性的 baseline，值得一看。
recommendation.en: Cleverly uses SAE-extracted semantic concepts for visual token compression, providing a more interpretable baseline than attention scores for VLM inference acceleration; worth a skim.

paper.title: VLRC: Vision-Language Reprojection Consistency as a scalable signal for better feed-forward 3D pretraining
paper.abstract: Feed-forward 3D models are commonly trained using either expensive geometric supervision or self-supervised photometric objectives, both of which provide incomplete learning signals. We introduce Vision-Language Reprojection Consistency (VLRC), a scalable auxiliary objective that exploits frozen vision-language representations as semantic multi-view supervision. Given a predicted 3D reconstruction, VLRC reprojects dense vision-language features across views and enforces feature consistency betwe

summary.core_problem: 现有前馈3D模型的两类主流预训练信号都存在固有缺陷：几何监督（深度标注、点云、伪标签等）获取成本高、携带数据集/传感器/教师模型的固有偏置、难以持续扩展到新域；自监督光度一致性损失受光照变化、低纹理区域、重复图案、动态物体等因素影响存在大量歧义，无法提供完整的学习信号。
summary.importance: 提出了一种可扩展、无需额外3D标注的辅助预训练信号，将冻结的视觉语言表示作为语义多视图监督，同时兼容自监督单目重建流程和监督预训练3D模型的无标注域适配，为3D预训练与多模态语义表示的深度融合提供了可行路径。
summary.technical_approach: 提出视觉语言重投影一致性（VLRC）辅助训练目标：给定前馈3D模型预测的深度、相机位姿、内参诱导出的3D重建结果，将冻结的密集视觉语言特征（来自CLIP、SigLIP、VL-JEPA等模型）通过预测的几何参数跨视图重投影，强制对应物理点的特征在多视图间保持一致。该损失无需额外3D标注，可无缝集成到现有自监督预训练流程或SelfEvo风格的无标注域适配流程中，从两方面改进3D学习：一是补充特征空间的3D估计监督信号，弥补光度损失在歧义区域的梯度缺失；二是让预测的3D结构与密集语义表示天然对齐，改善下游多模态任务的融合质量。
summary.experiments: 在多个公开数据集上的验证显示，VLRC可同时提升自监督和监督两种设置下的核心3D估计指标（深度精度、相机位姿估计、内参预测、3D重建质量）；由于输出的3D结构与视觉语言特征对齐更一致，下游零样本开放词汇3D语义分割性能也获得稳定提升。（提供的手稿节选未包含具体数值结果）
summary.reading_guide: 泛读约15分钟，重点关注第1节的核心观察（多视图视觉语言特征的不一致性可作为3D几何预测错误的训练信号）、第2节的VLRC损失公式推导与集成方式，实验部分重点看不同预训练设置下的增益对比，消融实验可快速浏览。

summary_en.core_problem: Two dominant pretraining paradigms for feed-forward 3D models both have inherent limitations: geometric supervision (depth annotations, point clouds, pseudo-labels, etc.) is costly to obtain, carries biases from datasets/sensors/teacher models, and is hard to scale continuously to new domains; self-supervised photometric consistency loss is highly ambiguous under illumination changes, low-texture regions, repeated patterns, and dynamic objects, leaving learning signals incomplete.
summary_en.importance: Introduces a scalable, annotation-free auxiliary pretraining signal that leverages frozen vision-language representations as semantic multi-view supervision. It is compatible with both self-supervised monocular reconstruction pipelines and unlabeled domain adaptation of supervised pretrained 3D models, providing a practical path for deep integration of 3D pretraining and multimodal semantic representations.
summary_en.technical_approach: Proposes Vision-Language Reprojection Consistency (VLRC), an auxiliary training objective that takes the 3D reconstruction induced by the feed-forward model's predicted depth, camera pose, and intrinsics, reprojects dense frozen vision-language features (from CLIP, SigLIP, VL-JEPA, etc.) across views via the predicted geometric parameters, and enforces feature consistency for corresponding physical points across views. This loss requires no additional 3D annotations and integrates seamlessly into existing self-supervised pretraining or SelfEvo-style unlabeled domain adaptation pipelines. It improves 3D learning in two complementary ways: first, it adds a feature-space supervision signal for 3D estimation to fill gradient gaps in ambiguous regions where photometric loss fails; second, it naturally aligns predicted 3D structure with dense semantic representations to improve fusion quality for downstream multimodal tasks.
summary_en.experiments: Validation across multiple public datasets shows that VLRC improves core 3D estimation metrics (depth accuracy, camera pose estimation, intrinsic prediction, 3D reconstruction quality) in both self-supervised and supervised settings. Since the output 3D structure is better aligned with vision-language features, downstream zero-shot open-vocabulary 3D semantic segmentation performance also receives consistent gains. (Specific numerical results are not included in the provided manuscript excerpts.)
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim in ~15 minutes. Focus on the core observation in Section 1 (inconsistency of multi-view vision-language features as a training signal for 3D geometric prediction errors), Section 2 for VLRC loss formulation and integration strategy. For experiments, focus on gain comparisons across different pretraining settings; ablation studies can be browsed quickly.

recommendation.zh: 利用冻结的 VLM 特征作为 3D 预训练的跨视图一致性约束，展示了 2D 基础模型特征在 3D 几何和语义对齐中的潜力，对多模态统一表示有一定启发。
recommendation.en: Utilizes frozen VLM features as cross-view consistency constraints for 3D pretraining, demonstrating the potential of 2D foundation model features in 3D geometric and semantic alignment, offering some inspiration for multimodal unified representations.

paper.title: Prior Bias in Vision Language Models on UML Diagram Interpretation
paper.abstract: Vision Language Models (VLMs) are increasingly applied to software engineering artifacts, especially UML class diagrams whose meaning depends on visual notation. Yet, it is unclear whether VLMs actually read such diagrams or instead answer from pretrained priors about how classes typically relate. We introduce a controlled UML benchmark in which each prior-conforming diagram is paired with its prior-conflicting counterpart that (1) preserves the same class names and layout while (2) reverses onl

summary.core_problem: 视觉语言模型在解读UML类图时可能依赖预训练先验而非真正读取图中关系箭头方向，其真实视觉理解能力存疑。
summary.importance: 构建了一个受控UML基准，通过配对先验一致/先验冲突图（仅反转关系箭头）量化VLM的先验偏差程度，属于评测方法贡献。
summary.technical_approach: 为每个符合先验的UML图构造仅反转关系箭头的对照图，保持类名和布局不变，通过对比准确率下降幅度度量先验偏差。
summary.experiments: 评测8个开源VLM（InternVL3.5、Qwen3系列）和2个闭源模型（GPT-5.4、GPT-5.4 Mini）；反转箭头使开源模型关系方向准确率平均下降33.48%，三类条件下下降45.28%，闭源模型也有10%~18.62%的差距；scaling仅带来有限改善。
summary.authors_note: 作者来自软件工程与NLP交叉领域，未识别出知名多模态预训练研究者。

summary_en.core_problem: Vision-language models may rely on pretrained priors rather than actually reading relation arrows when interpreting UML class diagrams, raising doubts about their true visual understanding.
summary_en.importance: Contributes a controlled UML benchmark that quantifies prior bias in VLMs by pairing prior-conforming diagrams with prior-conflicting counterparts that only reverse the relation arrow.
summary_en.technical_approach: For each prior-conforming UML diagram, a paired diagram is constructed by reversing only the relation arrow while keeping class names and layout unchanged; accuracy drop is used to measure prior bias.
summary_en.experiments: Evaluates 8 open-source VLMs (InternVL3.5, Qwen3 families) and 2 closed-source models (GPT-5.4, GPT-5.4 Mini); arrow reversal reduces open-source relation-direction accuracy by 33.48% on average, and by 45.28% in the three-class condition; closed models still show 10%–18.62% gaps; scaling provides only limited improvement.
summary_en.authors_note: Authors work at the intersection of software engineering and NLP; no well-known multimodal pretraining researchers identified.

recommendation.zh: VLM先验偏差的一个干净小样本诊断，结论符合预期（开源VLM视觉符号理解弱），看摘要和主表即可。
recommendation.en: A clean small-scale diagnosis of VLM prior bias; results are expected (open-source VLMs are weak at visual symbol understanding); read abstract and main tables only.

paper.title: Combating Textual Noise and Redundancy: Entropy-Aware Dense Visual Token Pruning
paper.abstract: Visual token pruning is a crucial strategy for accelerating VLMs by compressing redundant image patches, yet existing methods often fail to preserve critical cues under dense instructions and fine-grained queries. In this paper, we investigate this failure and identify two underlying bottlenecks: the widespread dispersion of textual noise that corrupts dense cross-modal scoring, and the feature fragmentation inherent to standard token selection. To address these issues, we propose Entropy-Aware

summary.core_problem: EADP 解决的是 VLM 推理时视觉 token pruning 在密集指令和细粒度问题下容易丢关键信息的问题。已有方法通常用 CLIP 的 EOS 全局文本特征给视觉 token 打分，再选 Top-K；这种做法在粗粒度场景可用，但面对小物体、局部属性、否定查询或长指令时，会出现语义定位不准和 token 选择冗余。
summary.importance: 这篇论文对基座预训练的直接贡献有限，更偏 VLM inference compression。但它对多模态模型的 token 预算分配有启发：视觉 token 压缩不能只看单点 saliency，还要考虑文本噪声、局部覆盖和全局代表性。对于 native multimodal pretraining 或长视觉上下文训练，这类分析可以帮助设计更稳的视觉 token selection、动态 token routing 或 curriculum。它的价值在于把 pruning 失败拆成两个具体机制：dense text guidance 中的高熵文本噪声，以及 Top-K 选择造成的局部重复采样。
summary.technical_approach: EADP 分两步。第一步是 entropy-aware dense scoring。它不用单个 EOS token 直接代表整句，而是计算非 EOS 文本 token 与视觉 token 的 dense cross-modal similarity。问题是功能词、标点等文本 token 的相似度响应往往在空间上接近均匀，会形成噪声底座。EADP 对每个文本 token 的空间相似度分布计算熵，高熵表示该 token 没有明确视觉落点，倾向于被过滤或降权；低熵 token 更可能对应具体实体或属性，会被保留并加权。随后将去噪后的 dense signal 与 EOS 全局语义信号融合，兼顾局部细节和整体语义稳定性。第二步是 structured token selection。它先用 Gaussian smoothing 引入局部空间连续性，再用 score polarization 放大核心视觉实体与背景的差异。最终不采用简单 Top-K，而是把选择问题写成 facility location submodular maximization，用代表性覆盖替代局部峰值追逐，从而减少在同一物体局部区域重复采样。
summary.experiments: 给出的全文片段主要包含问题分析和方法设计，没有提供完整实验表和具体数值。可以确认的实验观察是：基于 CLIP EOS 的全局指导在 dense visual tasks 上容易激活宽泛背景，缺少细粒度定位能力；直接使用 dense text-token guidance 也不稳定，因为功能词和标点带来空间分散的高熵响应；标准 Top-K 会集中选择少数高分区域，导致同一目标局部过采样，其他语义部件缺失。完整论文的实验部分应重点验证三类消融：熵过滤是否优于直接 dense guidance，facility location 是否优于 Top-K，在严格 token budget 下是否更能保留细粒度问答和负例判断能力。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读建议 20 分钟。先看 Observations and Insights，这部分比方法公式更关键，能看到作者如何定位 pruning 的两个瓶颈：文本噪声扩散和 Top-K 冗余。方法部分重点看 entropy 的定义、文本 token 过滤/加权方式、dense score 与 EOS score 的融合权重，以及 facility location objective 如何构造视觉 token 间的覆盖关系。实验部分建议优先看低 token budget、细粒度 VQA、否定查询和密集指令场景；如果只有部署兴趣，再看 latency 与保留 token 数的折中曲线。

summary_en.core_problem: EADP targets visual token pruning for VLM inference under dense instructions and fine-grained queries. Standard pruning pipelines score visual tokens with a compressed global text feature, often the CLIP EOS token, and then keep the Top-K tokens. This can miss small but decisive visual cues and can waste the token budget on redundant regions.
summary_en.importance: The paper is more relevant to VLM inference compression than to LLM pretraining. Its useful signal for pretraining researchers is the analysis of token budget allocation in multimodal models. The paper separates two failure modes that are often mixed together: noisy dense text guidance caused by high-entropy function words and punctuation, and redundant local sampling caused by Top-K selection. These ideas can inform dynamic visual token routing, long visual-context training, or native multimodal pretraining where token economy matters.
summary_en.technical_approach: EADP first builds an entropy-aware dense relevance score. Instead of relying only on the CLIP EOS embedding, it computes dense similarities between non-EOS text tokens and visual tokens. For each text token, it measures the entropy of its spatial similarity distribution. High-entropy tokens tend to have diffuse, non-localized responses and are treated as textual noise; low-entropy tokens are more likely to correspond to concrete visual entities or attributes and receive higher weight. The denoised dense relevance map is then fused with the global EOS signal. For selection, EADP adds spatial priors through Gaussian smoothing and score polarization, then replaces naive Top-K with a facility-location submodular objective. This shifts the criterion from picking the largest local peaks to selecting a compact set that covers the important visual content with less redundancy.
summary_en.experiments: The supplied content includes the diagnostic observations but not the full quantitative tables. The reported observations are that EOS-based global guidance often highlights broad background regions on dense visual tasks, dense token-level guidance can be corrupted by spatially diffuse text tokens, and Top-K selection tends to oversample a few discriminative regions while missing other semantic parts. The key experiments to check in the full paper are ablations for entropy filtering, fusion with EOS guidance, Gaussian smoothing and polarization, and facility-location selection versus Top-K, especially under tight token budgets and fine-grained or negative-query settings.
summary_en.reading_guide: A practical skim should take around 20 minutes. Read the observations section first, since it explains why common pruning pipelines fail. Then inspect the entropy definition, how text tokens are filtered or weighted, and how dense guidance is fused with the EOS feature. In the selection part, focus on the facility-location objective and how visual-token similarity is used to encourage coverage. In the experiments, prioritize tight-budget settings, fine-grained VQA, negative queries, and the latency-accuracy trade-off.

recommendation.zh: 针对 VLM 推理加速的视觉 Token 剪枝，引入熵过滤文本噪声和子模优化保证空间连续性，做多模态推理优化的可以参考其 Token 选择策略。
recommendation.en: Visual token pruning for VLM inference acceleration, introducing entropy to filter textual noise and submodular optimization for spatial continuity; useful reference for multimodal inference optimization.

paper.title: Visually Grounded Self-Reflection for Vision-Language Models via Reinforcement Learning
paper.abstract: Large vision-language models can reason over multimodal inputs by generating textual chains of thought (CoT). A key capability exhibited in CoT reasoning is self-reflection: revisiting earlier decisions and correcting previous errors. However, existing LVLMs often fail to properly attend to visual inputs during reflection, limiting their ability to translate feedback into grounded corrections, especially for out-of-distribution images. To address this issue, we propose a novel reinforcement lear

summary.core_problem: 解决 LVLM 在多模态 CoT 自我反思时没有真正回看视觉证据，导致错误修正不接地的问题。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是 VLM 后训练方法改进。它关注的不是更强视觉编码器，而是如何通过 RL 训练让模型在反思阶段利用图像、表格、图表等视觉输入修正中间错误。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 VRRL，一个面向视觉接地自我反思的强化学习框架。方法包含两点：训练时随机 mask 轨迹前缀，让模型重点学习从错误或缺失的中间状态恢复；使用 experience replay buffer 的 buffered roll-ins，把模型带到更多失败状态，让它学习如何根据视觉证据纠正推理路径。
summary.experiments: 实验面向包含表格和图表的视觉接地任务。摘要未给出模型规模、训练数据量和具体数值提升，但声称方法能提升对分布外图像的 grounded correction 能力，并优于已有 LVLM 反思基线。
summary.authors_note: The University of Texas at Austin 与 New York University；Greg Durrett 长期从事 NLP、问答和可解释推理相关研究。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses a failure mode where LVLMs produce reflective CoT text but do not actually re-ground their corrections in the visual input.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is a multimodal post-training method. It is useful mainly as a training-signal design study for grounded reflection, not as a pretraining result.
summary_en.technical_approach: VRRL introduces two RL-time interventions. Prefix masking forces the model to recover from missing or incorrect intermediate reasoning instead of only learning to avoid early mistakes. Buffered roll-ins from an experience replay buffer expose the model to diverse failure states that require visually grounded correction.
summary_en.experiments: The evaluation targets visual grounding tasks involving tables and charts. The provided abstract does not specify model sizes, data scale, or exact gains, but reports improved grounded self-correction, especially under out-of-distribution visual inputs.
summary_en.authors_note: The University of Texas at Austin and New York University. Greg Durrett is known for work in NLP, question answering, and interpretable reasoning.

recommendation.zh: 作为 VLM RL 训练信号设计看即可；重点看 prefix masking 和 replay roll-in，别把它当预训练结论。
recommendation.en: Treat it as VLM RL signal design; read the prefix-masking and replay roll-in details, not as evidence about pretraining.
