paper.title: DeepGaze3.5-VL: Modeling Scanpaths via Autoregressive Token Prediction
paper.abstract: Understanding human visual attention on a scene over time has applications in domains such as interface design and inferring cognitive states. Modeling visual scanpaths has historically relied on specialized architectures with hand-crafted priors. While these architectures can model fixation sequences, their rigid structural biases restrict easy extendability and flexible conditioning. For instance, integrating task-specific instructions or adapting to distinct viewer identities requires custom,

summary.core_problem: 把人类视觉扫视路径预测从专用结构建模问题，改写为视觉语言模型上的离散自回归 token 预测问题。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是任务形式重构和多模态序列建模。它展示坐标、注视属性、任务指令和个体身份可以统一塞进 token 序列中，用 VLM 的预训练表示做条件建模；对 LLM 预训练的价值在于提醒非语言连续行为也能通过合适离散化进入 AR 框架。
summary.technical_approach: 将注视坐标映射到文本词表或离散 token，把 scanpath 建模为序列预测；利用预训练 VLM 作为条件模型，通过 prompt 加入 viewer identity、visual search 等全局条件，也可在每次注视位置中加入额外属性。方法偏向把已有 VLM 能力迁移到眼动序列，而不是训练新的基座模型。
summary.experiments: 摘要未给出模型规模、训练数据集、baseline 和数值结果。实验应比较该 AR token formulation 与传统 scanpath 专用结构，在通用预测、个性化条件和任务条件下的表现。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper reframes human visual scanpath prediction as discrete autoregressive token prediction on top of vision-language models.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is a task reformulation for multimodal sequence modeling. It shows that coordinates, fixation attributes, task instructions, and viewer identity can be represented as token sequences and conditioned through a pretrained VLM. The relevance to LLM pretraining is indirect but real: non-linguistic continuous behavior can be brought into an AR modeling interface through discretization.
summary_en.technical_approach: Fixation coordinates are mapped into a text vocabulary or discrete tokens, making scanpath prediction a sequence modeling problem. A pretrained VLM provides visual and language representations, while prompting supplies global conditions such as viewer identity or visual-search goals. The method transfers VLM capabilities rather than proposing a new foundation pretraining recipe.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract does not report model size, datasets, baselines, or numerical improvements. The expected evaluation compares this AR token formulation against specialized scanpath models under generic, personalized, and task-conditioned settings.

recommendation.zh: 作为“连续行为离散成语言 token”的案例可备查；读 formulation 即可，眼动任务本身不值得深挖。
recommendation.en: Useful as a case study in tokenizing continuous behavior into an LM interface; read the formulation, not the eye-tracking details.

paper.title: Rank-Aware Hyperbolic Alignment for Vision-Language Dataset Distillation
paper.abstract: Vision-language dataset distillation (VLDD) compresses a large image-text paired dataset into a small set of synthetic pairs that can efficiently train contrastive vision-language models under strict data and compute budgets. Most existing methods match expert trajectories or cross-modal statistics, yet still enforce full-dimensional alignment in a Euclidean embedding space. This is often overly restrictive due to rank-deficient image--text correlation, with shared semantics concentrated in a lo

summary.core_problem: RAHA 解决的是 vision-language dataset distillation 中的对齐约束问题：在极小合成图文数据集上训练 contrastive VLM 时，不应强行让图像和文本表示在所有维度上均匀对齐，因为真实图文相关性通常集中在低秩共享子空间，剩余方向更多承载模态私有信息和噪声。
summary.importance: 这篇工作对 LLM 基座预训练不是直接贡献，但对 VLM 预训练数据研究有一定参考价值。它把 paired image-text data 的压缩问题从“合成少量样本”推进到“保留哪些跨模态相关结构”。这个视角适合思考小预算 VLM 训练、数据审计、不可共享原始数据时的 surrogate dataset，以及 contrastive pretraining 中 batch-level ranking signal 的保真。限制也比较明确：它面向 retrieval-style contrastive VLM 和小规模 dataset distillation，不能直接说明 web-scale 图文预训练中的数据配比、过滤或生成式统一建模问题。
summary.technical_approach: RAHA 由两个部分组成。第一部分是 hyperbolic contrastive learning，把合成图文对嵌入到双曲空间中训练。双曲几何对层级语义有更强的归纳偏置，适合表示实体、属性、关系等嵌套结构。第二部分是 rank-aware relevance distillation。方法在 tangent space 中估计真实 batch 的跨模态相关结构，并做 range-residual decomposition：range component 表示主导共享语义方向，synthetic data 需要匹配这部分 relevance；residual component 表示弱相关或模态私有方向，方法对其做正则，避免在极端压缩时被错误地强对齐。与 LoRS 这类在 similarity 层面做低秩松弛的方法相比，RAHA 更强调表示空间中的对齐容量控制；与简单 covariance matching 相比，它区分了应该对齐的共享方向和不应过度压缩的残差方向。
summary.experiments: 实验设置是标准 VLDD 协议：先学习一个小的合成图文数据集，再用这个合成集训练 retrieval model，最后用 Recall@K 等检索指标评估。论文还报告了跨架构迁移、扰动鲁棒性和合成样本质量分析。消融实验分别隔离 hyperbolic contrastive term、range matching 和 residual regularization 的作用，用来说明性能不是来自单一正则项。给出的全文片段没有暴露具体数值，因此更适合把实验结论理解为组件有效性的验证，而不是大规模预训练可扩展性的证据。
summary.reading_guide: 建议泛读 20 到 30 分钟。优先看方法部分的 range-residual decomposition，以及 relevance distillation 如何从真实 batch 迁移到 synthetic batch。表 1 和表 2 有助于快速定位它与 trajectory matching、generative distillation、covariance matching、LoRS 的差异。实验部分重点看组件消融和 cross-architecture transfer；如果关心 VLM 预训练数据压缩，可以额外看 robustness 与 qualitative samples。无需深读所有检索 benchmark 细节，除非研究方向是 dataset distillation。

summary_en.core_problem: RAHA addresses an alignment problem in vision-language dataset distillation. When a tiny synthetic image-text dataset is used to train a contrastive VLM, forcing full-dimensional Euclidean alignment is often too restrictive. Real image-text correlation is usually low-rank: dominant shared semantics live in a compact subspace, while the remaining directions contain weakly correlated, modality-private, or nuisance variation.
summary_en.importance: The paper is not a direct contribution to LLM pretraining, but it is relevant to VLM data research. Its useful idea is to treat paired-data distillation as preservation of cross-modal rank structure, not merely synthesis of a few representative samples. This matters for low-budget contrastive VLM training, auditable surrogate datasets, and settings where raw paired data cannot be redistributed. The scope is limited: the method targets retrieval-oriented contrastive VLMs under dataset distillation protocols, so it does not directly answer questions about web-scale multimodal pretraining mixtures, filtering, or unified generative modeling.
summary_en.technical_approach: RAHA combines two objectives. The first is a hyperbolic contrastive loss on synthetic image-text pairs. Hyperbolic geometry is used as an inductive bias for hierarchical multimodal semantics, such as entities, attributes, and relations. The second is rank-aware relevance distillation in tangent space. The method estimates batch-level cross-modal coupling from real data and decomposes it into a range component and a residual component. The range component captures dominant shared semantic directions and is matched between real and synthetic data. The residual component contains weak interactions and modality-private variation, and is regularized rather than forced into full alignment. Compared with LoRS-style low-rank relaxation at the similarity level, RAHA gives more explicit control over alignment capacity in representation space. Compared with covariance matching, it separates shared directions from residual directions instead of applying a uniform alignment constraint.
summary_en.experiments: The evaluation follows the standard VLDD protocol: learn a compact synthetic image-text set, train a retrieval model on that synthetic set, and evaluate retrieval performance with Recall@K-style metrics. The paper also includes cross-architecture transfer, robustness to perturbations, qualitative inspection of synthetic pairs, and component ablations. The ablations isolate the effects of hyperbolic contrast, range matching, and residual regularization. The provided full-content excerpt does not expose exact numerical results, so the experimental takeaway should be read as evidence for the proposed components under VLDD settings, not as proof of scalability to web-scale VLM pretraining.
summary_en.reading_guide: A 20 to 30 minute skim is enough for most pretraining readers. Focus on the method section, especially the range-residual decomposition and how relevance statistics are transferred from real batches to synthetic batches. Tables 1 and 2 are useful for positioning the method against trajectory matching, generative distillation, covariance matching, and LoRS. In the experiments, prioritize the component ablations and cross-architecture transfer results. The retrieval benchmark details can be skipped unless dataset distillation is the main research focus.

recommendation.zh: 将双曲空间引入多模态数据集蒸馏，思路新颖，可关注其对齐容量控制的机制设计。
recommendation.en: Introduces hyperbolic space to multimodal dataset distillation; the mechanism design for alignment capacity control is worth skimming.

paper.title: Timage: A Generative Text-in-Image Paradigm for Fine-Tuning Vision-Language Models
paper.abstract: Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) often lose track of the right image regions during fine-grained spatial reasoning, because a textual query rarely carries any explicit geometric anchor into the pixel domain. Prevailing remedies either rewire the model's weights or pad the prompt with verbose instructions, yet neither reliably pins the language to the correct visual coordinates without eroding the backbone's general competence. We introduce Timage, a paradigm that recasts multimodal under

summary.core_problem: 缓解 MLLM 在细粒度空间推理中无法把文本查询稳定绑定到正确图像区域的问题。
summary.importance: 贡献是一个输入侧对齐范式：把查询文本直接排版叠加到图像中，用几何锚点帮助 VLM 做区域级理解。它不是基座预训练工作，但对多模态输入表示、视觉-语言对齐和空间 grounding 有一定参考价值。
summary.technical_approach: Timage 将文本查询绘制到图像上，而不是改模型结构或增加长提示。叠加位置和外观由 Constrained Schrödinger Bridge 生成；该采样器把布局生成分为两个随机阶段：Region Search 将噪声输运到与查询相关的图像区域，同时用硬遮挡约束保护显著前景；后续阶段处理文字外观和布局一致性。方法更像输入重参数化和 fine-tuning 范式，而非新的 VLM 预训练目标。
summary.experiments: 摘要未披露模型规模、训练数据、具体 benchmark 或提升幅度。实验应验证细粒度空间推理、区域定位和模型通用能力是否被文本叠加破坏；需要重点检查其对遮挡、字体、查询长度和图像内容分布的敏感性。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper tackles the failure of MLLMs to reliably bind a textual query to the correct image region during fine-grained spatial reasoning.
summary_en.importance: Its contribution is an input-side alignment paradigm: rendering the query text directly onto the image to provide a geometric anchor. It is not foundation pretraining, but it is relevant to multimodal input representation, vision-language alignment, and spatial grounding.
summary_en.technical_approach: Timage overlays the textual query on the image instead of modifying model weights or relying on verbose prompts. The overlay layout and appearance are generated by a Constrained Schrödinger Bridge. The sampler decomposes layout synthesis into stochastic stages, including Region Search, which transports noise toward query-relevant regions while enforcing an occlusion barrier to protect salient foreground content.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract does not provide model size, training data, benchmark names, or numerical gains. The key experiments should test fine-grained spatial reasoning, region grounding, and whether the overlay hurts general visual competence; robustness to occlusion, font, query length, and image distribution is central.

recommendation.zh: 预训练收益有限；只看输入侧几何锚定和遮挡约束，判断它是否能迁移到 native VLM 数据构造。
recommendation.en: Limited pretraining value; read only the input-side geometric anchoring and occlusion constraint to judge whether it can transfer to native VLM data construction.

paper.title: Readable Yet Unpredictable: Rotated-Outcome Prediction in Vision-Language Models
paper.abstract: Can vision-language models predict what a 180° rotation would reveal from the original image alone? We study this ability through Rotated-Outcome Prediction: given an original image, a model must answer what would be seen or read after a 180° in-plane rotation, without directly observing the rotated target. To isolate this gap, we introduce RotOutBench, a paired diagnostic benchmark spanning open visual cases and controlled text-image rotations. A sharp pattern emerges: many VLMs can recognize t

summary.core_problem: 视觉-语言模型（VLMs）能否仅凭原始图像预测其旋转 180° 后的内容？
summary.importance: 揭示了当前 VLMs 在空间变换推理上的一个盲区：模型能直接识别原始或旋转后的图像，但无法在脑海中“模拟”旋转过程并预测结果，指出了 VLM 视觉表征和推理能力的局限。
summary.technical_approach: 构建了 RotOutBench 诊断基准，包含开放视觉案例和受控的图文旋转。通过对比模型在直接读取（原始/旋转图像）和预测旋转结果时的准确率，隔离并量化了这种推理差距。进行了模型级别的案例研究，分析预测状态与读取状态的差异。
summary.experiments: 在受控的图文旋转任务中，即使是直接读取准确率很高的模型，其预测旋转结果的准确率也骤降至接近零。案例研究表明，预测状态可能接近旋转图像的读取状态，但最终输出仍偏向原始字符串。
summary.authors_note: 中国科学院计算技术研究所（ICT, CAS）的研究。

summary_en.core_problem: Can Vision-Language Models (VLMs) predict what a 180° rotation would reveal from the original image alone?
summary_en.importance: Reveals a blind spot in current VLMs regarding spatial transformation reasoning: models can directly recognize original or rotated images but fail to 'simulate' the rotation process mentally and predict the outcome, highlighting limitations in VLM visual representations and reasoning capabilities.
summary_en.technical_approach: Constructs RotOutBench, a diagnostic benchmark containing open visual cases and controlled text-image rotations. By comparing model accuracy on direct reading (original/rotated images) versus predicting rotated outcomes, it isolates and quantifies this reasoning gap. Conducts model-level case studies to analyze the difference between prediction states and reading states.
summary_en.experiments: On controlled text-image rotations, predicted-rotation accuracy collapses to near zero even for models with high direct-reading accuracy. Case studies show that the prediction state can approach a rotated-image reading state, while the final readout still shifts toward the original string.
summary_en.authors_note: Research from the Institute of Computing Technology, Chinese Academy of Sciences (ICT, CAS).

recommendation.zh: 一个有趣的 VLM 诊断 benchmark，揭示了模型缺乏真正的空间心理旋转能力，对理解 VLM 视觉表征的局限性有帮助。
recommendation.en: An interesting diagnostic benchmark for VLMs, revealing their lack of true spatial mental rotation capability, helpful for understanding the limitations of VLM visual representations.

institutions: Institute of Computing Technology, Chinese Academy of Sciences

paper.title: MOSS-Video-Preview: Toward Real-Time Video Understanding via Cross-Attention
paper.abstract: Video understanding is shifting from the offline paradigm -- taking a fully recorded video as input and producing a single answer after it ends -- toward real-time interaction, in which the model perceives new frames while still replying, revises its answer as new evidence appears, and remains silent when there is nothing to say. We present MOSS-Video-Preview to validate this paradigm. Our central claim is that perception must not be blocked by generation; its natural realization is a two-channe

summary.core_problem: 如何构建能够进行实时视频理解（边看边说、随新证据修正答案）的视觉-语言模型，而不是仅在视频结束后给出单一答案？
summary.importance: 提出了一种新的实时视频理解范式，并主张使用交叉注意力（cross-attention）双通道架构来解耦感知与生成，挑战了目前主流的 decoder-only 架构在实时多模态任务中的适用性。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 MOSS-Video-Preview 模型。核心是采用交叉注意力骨干网络（双通道架构），视觉特征通过侧信道输入，不加入自回归序列。这样感知和生成在独立的、非阻塞的路径上运行，降低了视觉处理频率，并为独立压缩提供了干净的通道级接口。同时，配套了一个数据合成 pipeline，将密集的视频标注转换为流式对话格式。
summary.experiments: 论文未提供具体的参数量、训练数据规模和 Baseline 对比结果（摘要截断），但强调了其架构在实时交互场景下的优势。
summary.authors_note: 复旦大学 MOSS 团队（邱锡鹏团队等）的工作，聚焦于多模态大模型的实时交互能力。

summary_en.core_problem: How to build vision-language models capable of real-time video understanding (perceiving while replying, revising answers as new evidence appears), rather than just providing a single answer after the video ends?
summary_en.importance: Proposes a new paradigm for real-time video understanding and advocates for a cross-attention two-channel architecture to decouple perception and generation, challenging the applicability of prevailing decoder-only architectures in real-time multimodal tasks.
summary_en.technical_approach: Introduces MOSS-Video-Preview. The core is a cross-attention backbone (two-channel architecture) where visual features enter through a side channel instead of joining the autoregressive sequence. This allows perception and generation to run on separate, non-blocking pathways, reducing visual processing frequency and exposing a clean channel-wise interface for independent compression. It is complemented by a data synthesis pipeline that converts dense video annotations into streaming dialogue formats.
summary_en.experiments: Specific parameter counts, training data scale, and baseline comparisons are not provided in the truncated abstract, but the architectural advantages in real-time interaction scenarios are emphasized.
summary_en.authors_note: Work from the Fudan University MOSS team (Xipeng Qiu's team, etc.), focusing on the real-time interaction capabilities of multimodal large models.

recommendation.zh: 探讨了 VLM 在实时流式输入下的架构选择，主张 cross-attention 优于 decoder-only，对多模态统一建模的架构设计有启发。
recommendation.en: Explores architectural choices for VLMs under real-time streaming inputs, arguing for cross-attention over decoder-only, offering insights for unified multimodal modeling architecture design.

paper.title: FineGen: A VLM-based Multi-Agent Framework for Fine-Grained Image-Text Dataset Construction
paper.abstract: The scarcity of hard negative samples in current vision-language datasets significantly hinders fine-grained perception. To address this, we propose FineGen, a VLM-based Multi-Agent framework for automated dataset construction. By employing a collaborative Generation-Verification-Correction pipeline with a closed-loop feedback mechanism, FineGen ensures synthesized hard negatives are semantically valid yet strictly contradictory to visual content. Applying this to ImageNet, we construct FineGen-

summary.core_problem: 如何解决当前视觉-语言数据集中缺乏困难负样本（hard negative samples）导致模型细粒度感知能力受限的问题？
summary.importance: 提出了一种基于 VLM 的多智能体框架，用于自动化构建包含高质量困难负样本的细粒度图文数据集，显著提升了下游细粒度感知任务的性能。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 FineGen 框架，采用协作的生成-验证-修正（Generation-Verification-Correction）pipeline 和闭环反馈机制。确保合成的困难负样本在语义上有效，但与视觉内容严格矛盾。应用于 ImageNet 构建了 FineGen-100K 数据集。
summary.experiments: 构建了包含 14.7 万个特定属性困难负样本的数据集，正负样本比为 1:10。评估确认属性有效率达 96.7%。在 FG-OVD 基准上微调，困难样本准确率提升了 +14.4%。

summary_en.core_problem: How to address the lack of hard negative samples in current vision-language datasets, which hinders models' fine-grained perception capabilities?
summary_en.importance: Proposes a VLM-based multi-agent framework for automatically constructing fine-grained image-text datasets with high-quality hard negatives, significantly improving performance on downstream fine-grained perception tasks.
summary_en.technical_approach: Introduces the FineGen framework, employing a collaborative Generation-Verification-Correction pipeline with a closed-loop feedback mechanism. Ensures synthesized hard negatives are semantically valid yet strictly contradictory to visual content. Applied to ImageNet to construct the FineGen-100K dataset.
summary_en.experiments: Constructed a dataset with 147,000 attribute-specific hard negatives and a 1:10 positive-to-negative ratio. Evaluation confirms a 96.7% attribute validity rate. Fine-tuning on FG-OVD benchmark yields a +14.4% accuracy improvement on hard samples.

recommendation.zh: 利用 VLM 多智能体合成高质量 hard negative 文本数据来增强多模态对比学习，对 VLM 预训练数据构造有一定参考价值。
recommendation.en: Utilizes VLM multi-agents to synthesize high-quality hard negative text data to enhance multimodal contrastive learning, offering reference value for VLM pre-training data construction.

paper.title: Diagnosing Visual Ignorance in Vision-Language Models
paper.abstract: Vision-Language Models (VLMs) frequently rely on language priors, producing confident answers that are weakly grounded in visual evidence. While this behavior is widely observed, its internal mechanisms and its impact on benchmark evaluation remain insufficiently understood. In this work, we study language-prior reliance from both mechanistic and behavioral perspectives. Internally, we combine counterfactual layer replacement with supervised layer-wise MLP probing to trace how ground-truth visua

summary.core_problem: 探究视觉-语言模型（VLMs）为何过度依赖语言先验而忽视视觉证据，并提出量化这种‘视觉忽视’的指标。
summary.importance: 机制分析。结合内部表征探测和外部行为测试，揭示了 VLM 在解码过程中视觉信号被语言偏置压制的动态过程，为理解 VLM 幻觉提供了机制层面的解释。
summary.technical_approach: 内部机制：结合反事实层替换和逐层 MLP 探测，追踪视觉语义和语言先验在语言解码器中的竞争。外部行为：提出基于多步高斯模糊的渐进式视觉衰减指标，识别即使视觉内容被破坏答案仍保持不变的实例。
summary.experiments: 未详细说明模型规模和数据集，但通过内部探测和外部模糊测试，证实了 VLM 存在多阶段瓶颈：中间层未能有效检索视觉信息，而后期层进一步抑制视觉信号以偏向文本空间偏差。

summary_en.core_problem: Investigating why Vision-Language Models (VLMs) over-rely on language priors and ignore visual evidence, and proposing a metric to quantify this 'visual ignorance'.
summary_en.importance: Mechanism analysis. By combining internal representation probing and external behavioral testing, it reveals the dynamic process of visual signals being suppressed by language biases during decoding, providing a mechanistic explanation for VLM hallucinations.
summary_en.technical_approach: Internal mechanism: Combines counterfactual layer replacement with supervised layer-wise MLP probing to trace the competition between visual semantics and language priors across the language decoder. External behavior: Introduces a progressive visual decay metric based on multi-step Gaussian blurring to identify instances where answers remain invariant even as visual content is destroyed.
summary_en.experiments: Model scale and datasets are not detailed, but through internal probing and external blurring tests, it confirms a multi-stage bottleneck: intermediate layers fail to retrieve visual info, while later layers suppress visual signals in favor of text biases.

recommendation.zh: 作为 VLM 幻觉机制的 literature 备查，揭示了视觉信号在 decoder 中后期被语言先验压制的现象，可作为改进 VLM 架构或 loss 的动机。
recommendation.en: Good for literature review on VLM hallucination mechanisms; reveals visual signals are suppressed by language priors in later decoder layers, motivating architecture or loss improvements.

paper.title: Adversarial Attacks Already Tell the Answer: Directional Bias-Guided Test-time Defense for Vision-Language Models
paper.abstract: Vision-Language Models (VLMs), such as CLIP, have shown strong zero-shot generalization but remain highly vulnerable to adversarial perturbations, posing serious risks in real-world applications. Test-time defenses for VLMs have recently emerged as a promising and efficient approach to defend against adversarial attacks without requiring costly large-scale retraining. In this work, we uncover a surprising phenomenon: under diverse input transformations, adversarial images in CLIP's feature space

summary.core_problem: 在不重新大规模训练 VLM 的前提下，提高 CLIP 等视觉语言模型对对抗扰动的测试时鲁棒性。
summary.importance: 贡献是 VLM 鲁棒性和测试时防御分析。它不直接改进多模态预训练，但关于 CLIP feature space 中对抗样本的方向性偏移，可能对理解对齐表示的脆弱性有弱参考价值。
summary.technical_approach: 论文观察到，在多种输入变换下，对抗图像在 CLIP 特征空间中会沿一个主导方向偏移，而干净图像的变化更分散。基于这个 Defense Direction，提出 Directional Bias-guided Defense：估计能把特征拉回正确类别中心的方向，并用 DB-score 控制双流重建策略恢复鲁棒表示。
summary.experiments: 摘要未列出数据集、攻击类型、模型规模和数值结果。实验应覆盖 CLIP 系列模型、多种对抗攻击和输入变换，并与其他测试时防御方法比较鲁棒准确率和额外计算开销。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper aims to improve test-time robustness of vision-language models such as CLIP against adversarial perturbations, without expensive retraining.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is in VLM robustness and test-time defense. It does not directly improve multimodal pretraining, but the observation about directional shifts in CLIP feature space may be useful for understanding fragility of aligned representations.
summary_en.technical_approach: The paper observes that, under diverse input transformations, adversarial images in CLIP feature space consistently shift along a dominant direction, while clean images show more dispersed patterns. It proposes Directional Bias-guided Defense, which estimates a Defense Direction that pushes features back toward correct class centers and uses a DB-score-based two-stream reconstruction strategy to recover robust representations.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract does not specify datasets, attack types, model sizes, or numerical results. The evaluation likely covers CLIP variants, multiple adversarial attacks and transformations, and compares robust accuracy and overhead against other test-time defenses.

recommendation.zh: 读现象分析即可，方法像防御工程；若关心 CLIP 表示脆弱性，主导方向假设值得用内部模型复查。
recommendation.en: Read the phenomenon analysis, not the defense machinery; the dominant-direction claim is worth checking on internal CLIP-like models.

paper.title: Would you still call this Dax? Novel Visual References in VLMs and Humans
paper.abstract: Vision-language models (VLMs), like human learners, are frequently exposed to new visual concepts, but how they map novel visual references to language after exposure remains largely underexplored, particularly when those references contradict prior knowledge from pre-training. To study this, we present the Novel Visual References Dataset (NVRD): 19,176 images spanning 90 visual concepts across different levels of visual novelty, each with up to 20 increasingly perturbed versions of the original

summary.core_problem: VLM 在只给少量示例的 in-context 学习场景下，如何把“全新视觉指代物”与一个新词（nonce word）建立映射，并在视觉扰动下泛化；尤其当新映射与模型预训练形成的既有概念知识冲突时，模型会如何失败，以及这种行为与人类的归纳偏置（如 shape bias）有何异同。
summary.importance:
对预训练研究的启发主要在“概念可塑性与先验冲突”的评测维度：
- NVRD 把“新概念学习”从熟悉类目的增强/扰动，推进到从零构造的开放式新物体，更贴近预训练分布外的真实新概念。
- 结果指向一个与预训练强相关的问题：模型的 in-context 概念绑定能力会被既有语义先验牵制（contradict prior knowledge 时下降）。这对继续预训练/对齐阶段如何处理概念更新、词义漂移、以及多模态词表绑定有参考价值。
- 人类对 shape/texture 扰动的偏好可作为“归纳偏置对齐”的参照，用于诊断 VLM 表征中形状与纹理线索的权重。
它更偏 eval/dataset，而不是训练方法；对基座研究的价值在于提供可复现的 probing 工具，帮助定位预训练带来的概念刚性。
summary.technical_approach:
核心贡献是数据集与评测协议：
- NVRD 数据：90 个视觉概念，覆盖从熟悉物体到完全新物体；每个概念配一个 nonce word；每个物体有最多 20 级逐步增强的“受控扰动版本”，总计 19,176 张图。
- 关键设计点：不是在已知类目上做 augmentation，而是“从头构造新刺激物”，避免模型靠预训练标签空间投机。
- 评测设置：选择具备 multi-image 能力的 VLM，在 ICL 场景下给少量示例后测试命名/分类与泛化；并使用三种 prompting 范式（正文后续应有具体模板差异）。
- 对照：评测 3 个开源（Qwen-2 VL 7B、Idefics-3 8B、Molmo-2 8B）+2 个闭源（GPT-4o Mini、Gemini-2.5 Flash），并采集 2,400 条人类判断用于对比“可接受的泛化范围”与扰动类型偏好。
方法取舍上，他们选择 ICL 而不是再训练/微调，目的是更贴近成人在现实中遇到新指代物时的快速映射过程；代价是把学习能力与提示工程、上下文长度、以及模型的指令跟随纠缠在一起。
summary.experiments:
论文在引言中给出的主要结论信号：
- ICL 新概念习得：模型在暴露后能学到新视觉概念与新词的映射，但当新刺激与预训练概念知识冲突时，习得能力下降。
- 泛化范围：模型往往比人类“泛化得更宽”（更愿意把扰动后的物体仍叫同一个新词），但在人类与模型之间，对扰动类型的相对排序较一致：形状变化的可接受度低于纹理/颜色等低层变化。
- 人类对照：在子集上收集 2,400 judgments，用来量化不同扰动下“还能不能叫同一个名字”的边界。
从预训练角度，建议重点找正文里：
1) ‘contradict prior knowledge’ 的操作化定义（如何构造冲突、如何控制混淆因素）；
2) 三种 prompting 范式对结果的敏感性（这决定结论是否稳健）；
3) 不同模型之间的差异是否与训练数据/对齐方式相关（例如更强的 instruction tuning 是否更易“听话地学新词”，但也更易过泛化）。
summary.reading_guide:
泛读建议（约 25–40 分钟）：
- 先看数据集构造与扰动类型定义：理解“新物体”到底新在哪里、20 级扰动如何参数化。
- 直接看实验设置：ICL 提示模板、multi-image 输入组织方式、评测指标（命名准确率/泛化曲线/一致性等）。
- 看人类实验部分：他们如何采样子集、如何定义 acceptability、以及与模型输出如何对齐比较。
- 最后看按扰动类型（shape vs texture 等）与“与先验冲突”分组的结果图。
如果时间更少，只读：数据集介绍 + 关键结果图（模型 vs 人类的泛化曲线）+ 关于 prior-knowledge conflict 的小节。

summary_en.core_problem: How vision-language models form and generalize new word–referent mappings for genuinely novel visual objects under in-context learning, especially when the new mapping conflicts with the model’s pretraining-induced conceptual priors, and how this compares to human generalization biases (e.g., shape bias).
summary_en.importance:
Relevance to foundation-model pretraining is diagnostic rather than algorithmic:
- NVRD pushes “novel concept learning” beyond augmentations of familiar classes by using from-scratch, open-ended stimuli, closer to real distribution shift relative to pretraining.
- The reported degradation under prior-knowledge conflict highlights a pretraining-linked rigidity/plasticity issue: strong semantic priors can interfere with rapid concept rebinding. This is informative for continual pretraining, multimodal vocabulary binding, and post-training strategies that aim to update concepts without catastrophic side effects.
- Human judgments provide a reference for inductive biases (shape vs. texture sensitivity), useful for probing what visual cues VLM representations prioritize.
Overall it is an eval/dataset contribution; its value is as a reproducible probe for concept updating and generalization behavior.
summary_en.technical_approach:
Main contribution is the dataset and probing protocol:
- Dataset: 90 concepts spanning familiar to entirely novel objects; each paired with a nonce word; up to 20 controlled perturbation levels per concept; 19,176 images total.
- Design choice: truly novel stimuli rather than perturbing known categories, reducing leakage from the pretraining label space.
- Evaluation: in-context learning with multi-image prompts—models see a small number of exposures and are tested on naming/categorization and generalization across perturbations; three prompting paradigms are used to test robustness.
- Models: Qwen-2 VL 7B, Idefics-3 8B, Molmo-2 8B, plus GPT-4o Mini and Gemini-2.5 Flash.
- Human comparison: 2,400 human judgments on a subset to quantify acceptability boundaries across perturbation types.
The deliberate choice of ICL (instead of finetuning) targets fast-mapping-like behavior, but entangles results with prompt format, instruction-following tendencies, and context handling.
summary_en.experiments:
Key findings as stated in the paper’s overview:
- VLMs can acquire new visual concepts in context, but performance drops when the novel mapping contradicts pretraining-derived conceptual knowledge.
- Models tend to generalize more broadly than humans (wider acceptance of perturbed instances as the same referent).
- Despite that, both humans and models show similar relative preferences across perturbation types: shape changes are less acceptable than texture/color or other low-level changes.
For a pretraining-oriented read, the most important experimental details to verify in the main text are: (1) how “prior-knowledge contradiction” is operationalized and controlled; (2) sensitivity to the three prompting paradigms; (3) whether model-to-model differences correlate with training data or post-training (e.g., instruction tuning) in a way that explains over-generalization vs. rigidity.
summary_en.reading_guide:
Skim plan (25–40 minutes):
- Dataset construction and perturbation taxonomy: what counts as “truly novel,” and how the 20-level perturbations are parameterized.
- Experimental protocol: prompt templates, multi-image formatting, and metrics (accuracy vs. generalization curves).
- Human study section: sampling, acceptability definition, and alignment between human judgments and model outputs.
- Results broken down by perturbation type (shape vs. texture) and by prior-knowledge conflict.
If time is tight: dataset overview + the main plots comparing model vs. human generalization + the section on prior-knowledge conflict.

recommendation.zh: 非常干净的 setup，专门针对 VLM 的 in-context learning 和先验冲突问题，结论（模型难以克服预训练先验学习新概念）对多模态预训练和对齐有直接启发。
recommendation.en: Very clean setup targeting VLM in-context learning and prior conflicts; the conclusion (models struggle to overcome pre-training priors to learn new concepts) is highly relevant for multimodal pretraining and alignment.

paper.title: HyperVis: Continuous Latent Visual Relational Graphs on the Lorentz Hyperboloid for Compositional Reasoning
paper.abstract: Vision-Language Models (VLMs) struggle with compositional reasoning that requires understanding inter-object relationships. A natural remedy is to inject explicit scene graph triplets $\langle s, p, o \rangle$ from an off-the-shelf scene graph generator (SGG), but we show this backfires: discrete text labels collide with the continuous visual modality, degrading GQA accuracy from 60.38\% to 58.86\%. We propose \textbf{HyperVis}, which bypasses the SGG semantic bottleneck entirely. From $N$ class

summary.core_problem: VLM在组合推理上表现不佳，传统方法注入离散场景图三元组会因离散文本标签与连续视觉模态冲突而适得其反。
summary.importance: 提出HyperVis绕过场景图语义瓶颈，直接在连续视觉空间中建模物体关系，提供了一种新的VLM组合推理改进路径。
summary.technical_approach: 从N个类别无关区域提议出发，通过空间偏置交叉注意力计算密集O(N²)视觉关系张量，投影到洛伦兹双曲面上，通过空间物理(IoA驱动的蕴含锥和外角排斥)强制执行层次结构；可作为训练时正则器或测试时插入模块。
summary.experiments: 在GQA数据集上实验：基础LoRA为57.21%，HyperVis+LoRA提升至61.03%；相比离散场景图注入(60.38%→58.86%)明显更优。
summary.authors_note: Moshiur Farazi, Sameera Ramasinghe, Mahbub Ahmed Turza, Shafin Rahman; 机构信息未在摘要中明确提供。

summary_en.core_problem: VLMs struggle with compositional reasoning; injecting discrete scene graph triplets backfires because discrete text labels collide with the continuous visual modality.
summary_en.importance: Proposes HyperVis, which bypasses the scene graph semantic bottleneck entirely and models object relationships directly in continuous visual space, offering a novel path for VLM compositional reasoning.
summary_en.technical_approach: From N class-agnostic region proposals, computes dense O(N²) visual relation tensor via spatially-biased cross-attention, projects onto Lorentz hyperboloid, enforces hierarchy via spatial physics (IoA-driven entailment cones and exterior-angle repulsion); acts as training-time regularizer or test-time plugin.
summary_en.experiments: On GQA: base LoRA achieves 57.21%, HyperVis+LoRA improves to 61.03%; outperforms discrete scene graph injection (which degrades from 60.38% to 58.86%).
summary_en.authors_note: Moshiur Farazi, Sameera Ramasinghe, Mahbub Ahmed Turza, Shafin Rahman; institutional affiliations not identifiable from abstract.

recommendation.zh: 双曲几何建模视觉关系的思路有意思，但实验范围窄(GQA单点)，对LLM基座预训练直接启示有限，作为literature备查即可。
recommendation.en: Hyperbolic geometry for visual relations is conceptually interesting but experiments are narrow (GQA only); limited direct relevance to LLM pretraining. Keep as literature reference.

paper.title: Cosine Misleads: Auxiliary Losses Reshape Vision Language Models, Not Their Latents
paper.abstract: Latent visual reasoning (LVR) inserts supervised latent tokens between perception and answer generation in vision-language models (VLMs). The field uses alignment between these latents and their visual targets, i.e., cosine similarity or mean squared error (MSE), as both the training loss and the quality metric, assuming that better alignment yields a better answer. We test this with a designed matrix of five LVR variants and find the assumption inverted: cosine alignment is negatively correlate

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作检验了 latent visual reasoning 里一个被默认接受的前提：中间连续 latent 与教师视觉目标的对齐程度，是否真的代表模型在推理时“用到了”这些 latent，并因此带来更好的答案。论文给出的结论是否定的。作者系统构造了五种 LVR 训练变体，在相同骨干、数据和训练步数下比较，发现常用的 cosine/MSE 对齐指标不仅不能预测下游问答准确率，甚至与准确率显著负相关。更关键的是，推理时对这些 latent 做置零、加噪、跨样本替换，性能变化很小，说明被辅助损失直接监督的 latent 往往不是承载答案信息的那条计算路径。
summary.importance: 对预训练和多模态建模的启发不在于提出了一个更强模型，而在于拆穿了一类常见训练信号的误读。很多中间层监督方法默认“被监督的表示”就是“起作用的表示”，于是用 cosine、MSE 或重建误差同时做训练目标和质量指标。这里的结果表明，辅助损失可能主要通过共享参数的梯度流重塑整个网络，而不是让被监督 latent 本身变成推理时的关键载体。这个判断对 VLM 中间表示学习、跨模态对齐、latent CoT、甚至部分语音/视频连续思维建模都有参考价值。它提醒人们区分两件事：一个 loss 能否改善模型，与它监督的那段表示是否真的 load-bearing，不是一回事。
summary.technical_approach:
方法上有两部分。第一部分是受控实验矩阵。作者设计了五种 LVR 变体，覆盖从偏重重建的训练方式，到加入输入噪声约束，再到 progressively scaffolded 的训练策略。所有变体共享同一 backbone、训练数据和 step budget，尽量把差异压缩到 latent 监督设计本身。结果显示，某些方法能把 cosine alignment 提高约 40%，把 reconstruction error 从 3.79 降到 1.55，但问答准确率反而下降 13 个点。

第二部分是诊断工具 PRISM，由两个推理时分析组成。其一是 corruption test：在每一步生成时，对 latent 位置做三类干预——置零、加入高斯噪声、替换为别的样本的 latent——观察最终任务精度变化。如果 latent 真在承担推理，干预应显著伤害性能；但实验里所有变体的性能波动都不超过 4 个点，最差变体甚至在 latent 置零后更好。其二是双位置 linear probe：分别在线性探测 answer-decoding state 和 autoregressive feedback variable 上是否可解码出答案。结果是答案信息能从最终 answer-decoding hidden state 读出，却不能从被重新注入的 latent 变量中读出。作者据此提出一个信息瓶颈视角：训练目标中的主导项仍是 cross-entropy，它会把与答案相关的计算压力施加到任何能更直接服务输出的位置；而 cosine/MSE 这类重建损失既不约束表示压缩，也不保证表示保留与答案相关的信息，因此模型完全可能学会“绕过” latent，让辅助损失只作为一种参数整形信号存在。
summary.experiments: 核心结果有四个。第一，五种 LVR 变体上，cosine alignment 与 V*Bench 准确率的 Pearson 相关系数达到 -0.94，方向与社区常用假设相反。第二，progressive scaffolding 变体把 cosine 提高约 40%，重建误差从 3.79 降到 1.55，但 V*Bench 下降 13 分；这一现象在 BLINK 和 MMVP 上也复现，说明不是单一 benchmark 偶然。第三，noise-train 变体的 cosine 与 baseline 几乎相同，0.556 对 0.555，但 V*Bench 仍提升 1.5 分，而且在 latent 置零时与 baseline 呈相反响应：它自己的 latent 有帮助，而 baseline 的 latent 反而有害。第四，PRISM 诊断显示，对 latent 的三类干预在所有变体上最多只改变约 4 个点，说明 latent 普遍被旁路；同时 probe 对比度能够预测不同变体对 latent 扰动的敏感性，也能解释为何模型间准确率差异可以达到 13 分，即差异主要来自共享参数内部被辅助损失重塑后的下游解码路径，而不是 latent 本身的可用性。
summary.reading_guide: 这篇适合泛读，但方法判断很清楚，建议把时间放在三处。先看 Introduction 和实验设定，确认作者不是在比较不同 backbone，而是在做受控的训练目标检验。再看 PRISM 两个诊断的定义与结果图，尤其是 latent corruption 和双位置 probe 的对应关系，这是全文最有信息量的部分。最后看 Information Bottleneck 那一节，不必把它当严格理论证明，更像一个解释框架：为什么 reconstruction-style auxiliary loss 可能改善训练，却不让被监督表示真正承载答案。预计 20 到 30 分钟可以抓住主线；如果你在做中间层监督、latent reasoning 或多模态对齐，值得把相关图表和附录里的变体定义一起看完。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper tests a widely assumed premise in latent visual reasoning: whether better alignment between supervised latent tokens and teacher visual targets actually means the model relies on those latents at inference, and therefore answers better. The answer is no. Using five controlled LVR variants trained with the same backbone, data, and step budget, the authors show that cosine/MSE-style alignment is not a faithful proxy for downstream performance; in fact, cosine is strongly negatively correlated with task accuracy. More importantly, inference-time interventions on the latent channel barely change performance, which suggests that the supervised latents are often not the load-bearing path for answer computation.
summary_en.importance: The value of the paper is diagnostic rather than architectural. It challenges a common interpretation of auxiliary supervision in multimodal models: that the representation being directly supervised is also the representation doing the work. The results suggest a different picture. Auxiliary losses may help mainly by reshaping shared parameters through gradient flow, while the supervised latent itself is bypassed at inference. This matters beyond LVR. The same failure mode can plausibly appear in intermediate-layer supervision, multimodal alignment objectives, latent chain-of-thought setups, and continuous reasoning channels in video or speech models. For pretraining research, the key lesson is to separate two questions: whether an auxiliary loss improves the model, and whether the supervised intermediate state is actually causally used.
summary_en.technical_approach:
The paper has two main components. First, it builds a controlled matrix of five LVR variants spanning different latent-supervision designs, including reconstruction-heavy training, input-noise regularization, and progressively scaffolded supervision. The backbone, data source, and training budget are held fixed so that differences can be attributed to the latent objective rather than unrelated recipe changes. Under this setup, a variant can improve cosine alignment by about 40% and reduce reconstruction error from 3.79 to 1.55, yet lose 13 points on the downstream benchmark.

Second, the authors introduce PRISM, a pair of inference-time diagnostics. The first is a corruption test: at each generation step, latent positions are zeroed, perturbed with Gaussian noise, or replaced with latents from another sample. If the latent channel is truly carrying reasoning-relevant information, these interventions should hurt substantially. Instead, all variants move by at most four points, and one variant even improves when its latents are zeroed. The second is a two-position linear probe. The probe asks whether the answer is decodable from the answer-decoding hidden state and from the autoregressive feedback variable that gets re-injected as the latent. The answer is decodable from the former but not the latter. The paper interprets this through an Information Bottleneck lens: the dominant cross-entropy term pushes the network to route answer-relevant computation wherever it most directly helps prediction, while cosine/MSE reconstruction does not guarantee that the supervised latent preserves answer-relevant information. As a result, the model can satisfy the auxiliary loss while learning to solve the task through downstream shared-parameter pathways.
summary_en.experiments: There are four results worth retaining. First, across the five LVR variants, cosine alignment and V*Bench accuracy have a Pearson correlation of -0.94, which is the opposite of the field’s usual assumption. Second, the progressive scaffolding variant improves cosine alignment by roughly 40% and lowers reconstruction error from 3.79 to 1.55, yet drops 13 points on V*Bench; the same pattern also appears on BLINK and MMVP. Third, the noise-train variant matches the baseline almost exactly in cosine score, 0.556 versus 0.555, but still gains 1.5 points on V*Bench, and its response to latent zeroing flips relative to the baseline: its own latent helps, whereas the baseline latent hurts. Fourth, PRISM shows that zeroing, noising, or swapping latents changes accuracy by at most about four points across all variants, indicating broad latent bypass. At the same time, the contrast between probe accuracy at the answer-decoding state and the feedback latent predicts both perturbation sensitivity and task performance, which supports the claim that the auxiliary loss mainly reshapes the model through shared parameters rather than through a useful latent code.
summary_en.reading_guide: This is a skim paper, but it is worth reading with care if you work on intermediate supervision. Start with the introduction and experimental setup to verify that the comparison is controlled. Then focus on the PRISM section, especially the latent corruption results and the two-position probe analysis; that is where the paper earns its conclusion. The Information Bottleneck section is best read as an interpretive framework, not as a formal proof. It helps explain why reconstruction-style auxiliary losses can improve training while failing to make the supervised latent causally important. A 20–30 minute read is enough to capture the main argument. If your work involves latent reasoning, multimodal alignment, or auxiliary losses on hidden states, the figures and appendix definitions of the five variants are the parts to inspect closely.

recommendation.zh: 非常漂亮的机制分析工作，打破了 VLM 潜在推理中“对齐即正义”的幻觉，揭示了辅助 loss 导致的表征旁路现象，做多模态对齐的必读。
recommendation.en: A beautiful mechanistic analysis that shatters the 'alignment is all you need' illusion in VLM latent reasoning, revealing representation bypass caused by auxiliary losses. A must-read for multimodal alignment.

paper.title: When Attention Collapses: Stage-Aware Visual Token Pruning from Structure to Semantics
paper.abstract: Vision-Language Models (VLMs) have demonstrated remarkable capabilities but suffer from significant computational overhead during inference. While visual token pruning offers a promising solution, existing methods predominantly rely on initial attention scores. This single-metric paradigm presents a critical flaw: high attention scores inherently collapse onto semantically similar regions, thereby severely reducing feature diversity and discarding vital contextual details. To address this, we in

summary.core_problem: 论文关注的是 VLM 推理阶段的视觉 token 剪枝，但切入点不是单纯追求更高压缩率，而是指出现有 attention-based pruning 的一个结构性问题：如果只按注意力分数保留 token，高分 token 会在语义上彼此靠近，形成局部聚集，结果是保留了很多相似区域，却丢掉了全局结构和上下文细节。作者要解决的核心问题，是如何让剪枝策略符合表示在不同阶段的演化规律：进入 LLM 之前先保住结构多样性，进入 LLM 之后再按任务语义做进一步筛选。
summary.importance: 这篇工作更偏高质量推理优化，而不是预训练本身。对基座研究的启发在两点。第一，它把视觉编码器和语言解码器中的表示动态分开分析，说明“一个统一重要性指标贯穿全流程”往往不成立，这对多模态统一建模、token budget 分配、以及未来训练时是否显式鼓励 token 多样性都有参考意义。第二，它揭示 attention score 不是天然可靠的 token saliency proxy，至少在视觉侧深层表示中会和特征相似性塌缩到一起。这个观察对做视觉 tokenizer、跨模态压缩、甚至训练期 token dropping 都有方法论价值。不过从筛选标准看，它主要属于 efficient/VLM inference 方向，和预训练的直接距离较远，适合泛读而非深挖。
summary.technical_approach: 方法叫 STS，Structure-to-Semantics，是一个 training-free 的两阶段剪枝框架。第一阶段发生在视觉编码器输出、送入 LLM 之前。作者不再直接按 attention 排序，而是把 token 选择写成一个受“势能/排斥”启发的采样目标：把每个视觉 token 看成特征空间中的带电粒子，语义越相似，排斥越强。这样选出的子集会主动避开语义上彼此过近的 token，从而保留更分散、更完整的结构信息。第二阶段发生在 LLM 中间层，利用 instruction-aware cross-attention 做语义相关性过滤，把与当前任务无关的视觉 token 再剪掉一部分。支撑这个设计的，是作者对两处表示动态的经验分析：在视觉编码器深层，feature-similar tokens 的 attention score 越来越相近，导致 attention 难以区分冗余 token；而在 LLM 解码器中，早层更偏广泛上下文聚合，深层才逐步集中到任务相关视觉区域。论文还提出了一个 KNN Consistency Score，用来量化“特征相近的 token 是否也拿到相近 attention 分数”，作为 attention collapse 的诊断指标。与已有单阶段 attention pruning 相比，STS 的区别不只是多加一步，而是把‘保结构多样性’和‘保任务语义’明确拆成两个阶段，并分别用不同信号处理。
summary.experiments: 实验在多个 VLM 和多个 benchmark 上做，目标是验证效率—性能折中。作者报告的主结论是：在较激进的 token reduction 下，STS 比单纯 attention-based pruning 更能维持任务性能，同时减少推理开销。经验分析部分先给出证据：在 LLaVA-1.5 上，随着视觉编码器层数加深，KNN Consistency Score 上升，说明 attention similarity 与 feature similarity 越来越绑定，单看 attention 更容易选出语义扎堆的 token。随后在下游评测中，STS 在相同保留 token 预算下通常优于对比方法，尤其在高压缩场景下更稳，因为第一阶段保住了全局结构覆盖，第二阶段再补上任务相关性。论文摘要和你提供的正文片段没有包含完整表格数值，因此这里不编造具体 latency、FLOPs 或准确率差值；阅读时应重点核对三类结果：不同压缩率下的性能曲线、两阶段各自的消融贡献、以及不同插入层位置对结果的影响。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读时建议按“分析先行，方法随后”的顺序。先看 Empirical Analysis，尤其是 KNN Consistency Score 的定义和随层深变化的图，这部分决定了作者为什么认为 attention-only pruning 不够。然后看 STS 的两阶段设计：视觉侧的 repulsion-based sampling 怎么实现，LLM 中间层的语义剪枝用什么信号、插在哪一层。实验部分重点看 efficiency-performance trade-off 曲线和消融表，确认收益来自阶段解耦，而不是简单多剪一次。若只是判断是否值得跟进，30 分钟左右足够；若要复现或迁移到别的 VLM，需要细看附录中的实现细节、复杂度分析和不同模型上的超参数设置。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper studies visual token pruning for VLM inference, but its main point is not just higher compression. It identifies a structural flaw in attention-based pruning: selecting tokens purely by attention tends to keep many semantically similar regions because high-attention tokens collapse into local clusters. That preserves redundancy while discarding global structure and contextual detail. The core problem is therefore stage mismatch: before the LLM, pruning should preserve structural diversity; inside the LLM, pruning should focus on task-specific semantics.
summary_en.importance: This is primarily an inference-efficiency paper rather than a pretraining paper. Its relevance to foundation-model research comes from two observations. First, it separates representation dynamics in the vision encoder from those in the language decoder, showing that one universal token-importance signal is often the wrong abstraction. That is useful for multimodal token budgeting, compression-aware architecture design, and possibly training-time token dropping. Second, it argues that attention scores are not a reliable saliency proxy on the visual side once deeper representations become semantically clustered. That insight may matter beyond pruning, including visual tokenizers and multimodal compression. Still, the direct connection to pretraining is limited, so this is better treated as a skim paper.
summary_en.technical_approach: The proposed method, STS (Structure-to-Semantics), is a training-free two-stage pruning framework. Stage one operates before visual tokens enter the LLM. Instead of ranking tokens only by attention, it formulates token selection with a potential-energy or repulsion-inspired objective: tokens are treated like charged particles in feature space, and semantically similar tokens repel each other more strongly. This encourages a selected subset that is spatially and semantically diverse, preserving global structure. Stage two operates inside an intermediate LLM layer and uses instruction-aware cross-attention to remove task-irrelevant visual tokens. The design is motivated by empirical analysis of representation dynamics. In deeper vision layers, feature-similar tokens receive increasingly similar attention scores, so attention loses discriminative power within local semantic neighborhoods. In the LLM decoder, earlier layers aggregate broad context while deeper layers become more task-focused. The paper also introduces a KNN Consistency Score to quantify how strongly feature similarity aligns with attention similarity, serving as a diagnostic for attention collapse. Compared with prior single-stage pruning methods, the novelty is not just adding another pruning step, but explicitly decoupling structural coverage from semantic relevance and using different signals for each stage.
summary_en.experiments: Experiments are conducted on multiple VLMs and benchmarks to evaluate the efficiency-performance trade-off. The main result is that STS preserves task performance better than attention-based baselines under the same token budget, especially in aggressive pruning regimes. The empirical-analysis section first shows evidence for the claimed failure mode: on LLaVA-1.5, the KNN Consistency Score increases with vision-layer depth, indicating that attention similarity increasingly tracks feature similarity, which makes attention-only selection more redundant. Downstream evaluations then show that the two-stage strategy is more robust because stage one preserves global structural coverage and stage two restores task relevance. The excerpt provided here does not include the full numeric tables, so exact gains in latency, FLOPs, or benchmark scores should be read from the main paper. The most useful results to inspect are the performance curves across pruning ratios, the ablations for each stage, and the sensitivity to the layer where semantic pruning is inserted.
summary_en.reading_guide: A good reading order is analysis first, method second. Start with the empirical-analysis section, especially the definition of the KNN Consistency Score and the layerwise plots showing attention collapse. That section explains why attention-only pruning is insufficient. Then read the STS method details: how the repulsion-based sampling is implemented before the LLM, what signal is used for semantic pruning inside the LLM, and where that pruning is applied. In the experiments, focus on efficiency-performance trade-off plots and ablation tables to verify that the gain comes from stage-aware decoupling rather than simply pruning more. Around 30 minutes is enough for a decision-level read. For reproduction or adaptation to another VLM, the appendix will matter for implementation details, complexity, and hyperparameter settings.

recommendation.zh: 指出了 VLM 视觉 token 剪枝中常见的 'attention collapse' 问题，提出的两阶段解耦策略（先结构多样性后语义过滤）对多模态模型的推理优化有一定启发。
recommendation.en: Identifies the 'attention collapse' issue in VLM visual token pruning. The proposed two-stage decoupled strategy (structural diversity followed by semantic filtering) offers insights for multimodal model inference optimization.

paper.title: TGV-KV: Text-Grounded KV Eviction for Vision-Language Models

This issue is particularly pronounced in VLMs due to substantial redundancy in the visual modality. Although KV cache eviction approaches can effectively reduce inference memory, they often incur significant performance degradation in VLMs, as most are designed for

summary.core_problem: 视觉-语言模型（VLM）的KV缓存内存随上下文线性增长，且视觉模态存在大量冗余；现有KV缓存驱逐方法因忽视文本-视觉模态鸿沟导致在VLM上性能显著下降
summary.importance: 系统性分析了VLM中文本与视觉的模态鸿沟，提出文本引导的KV缓存驱逐策略，属于VLM推理效率的增量工作
summary.technical_approach: TGV-KV包含三个子模块：文本-视觉预算分配（TVB）基于互信息交互为每层分配预算；文本加权排序（TWR）评估优先级；第三个模块用于实际驱逐
summary.experiments: 在多个VLM benchmark上与现有KV eviction方法对比，声称在保持性能的同时显著减少内存。具体模型规模和提升幅度摘要中未详述

summary_en.core_problem: VLM KV-cache memory grows linearly with context length and visual tokens have high redundancy; existing KV eviction methods suffer significant performance drops on VLMs because they ignore the text-vision modality gap

paper.title: Visual Instruction Tuning Aligns Modalities through Abstraction
paper.abstract: Visual instruction tuning effectively adapts a pre-trained Large Language Model (LLM) to process image information alongside text. Yet, it remains unclear how visual features are embedded into the layer-wise hierarchy of abstractions of the LLM backbone. Across a diverse set of vision-language architectures, we show that instruction tuning primarily serves as a bridge, embedding visual features directly into the intermediate semantic layers of the LLM, bypassing the early layers devoted to unimo

summary.core_problem: 视觉指令调优对齐多模态信息的内部机制不明确，现有分析多局限于单架构，缺乏跨架构的因果性证据验证视觉特征与LLM层级抽象的对应关系，也不清楚指令调优中哪些层的参数更新对多模态性能起关键作用。
summary.importance: 从机制层面解释了VLM指令调优的作用位点，为VLM的高效参数微调、架构设计提供了可验证的指导原则，也为多模态预训练的层间对齐目标设计提供了参考方向。
summary.technical_approach: 选取7种不同设计的开源VLM，覆盖自注意力、交叉注意力两类架构，采用两种因果干预手段：注意力敲除（阻断文本query对图像key的注意力流）、层跳过（绕过指定层的视觉token计算），结合表征探针对比预训练和调优后不同层的图文表征语义相似度，另外验证仅微调中间层的性能收益。
summary.experiments: 干预实验显示，消融中间层带来的多模态任务性能下降幅度最大，是跨模态信息交互的核心位点。探针分析发现，指令调优主要将视觉特征对齐到LLM的中间语义层，绕过了LLM早期的单模态文本处理层。仅微调中间层的性能与全参数微调相当，训练成本更低，在视觉占比高的任务上收益最明显。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读，重点关注第3章的干预实验设计与核心结论，以及第4章的局部微调实验结果。预计阅读时间20分钟，无需深究所有VLM的架构细节，核心关注跨架构一致的中间层效应。

summary_en.core_problem: The internal mechanism of visual instruction tuning for multimodal alignment remains unclear. Existing analyses are mostly limited to single architectures, lack cross-architecture causal evidence verifying the correspondence between visual features and LLM hierarchical abstractions, and do not identify which layers' parameter updates during instruction tuning dominate multimodal performance.
summary_en.importance: Explains the functional locus of VLM instruction tuning at the mechanism level, provides verifiable guiding principles for efficient parameter fine-tuning and architecture design of VLMs, and offers a reference direction for designing inter-layer alignment objectives in multimodal pretraining.
summary_en.technical_approach: Selects 7 open-source VLMs with diverse designs, covering both self-attention and cross-attention architectures. Uses two causal intervention methods: attention knockout (blocks information flow from text queries to image keys) and layer skipping (bypasses visual token computation in specified layer ranges). Combines representation probing to compare the semantic similarity of text and visual representations at different layers before and after fine-tuning, and verifies the performance gain of only fine-tuning intermediate layers.
summary_en.experiments: Intervention experiments show that ablating intermediate layers causes the largest performance drop on multimodal tasks, identifying them as the core site of cross-modal information interaction. Probing analysis finds that instruction tuning mainly aligns visual features to the intermediate semantic layers of the LLM, bypassing the early unimodal text processing layers of the LLM. Fine-tuning only intermediate layers achieves performance comparable to full parameter fine-tuning with lower training cost, and the gain is most significant on vision-centric tasks.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim read. Focus on the intervention experiment design and core conclusions in Chapter 3, as well as the localized fine-tuning experiment results in Chapter 4. Estimated reading time is 20 minutes. No need to delve into the architecture details of all VLMs; focus on the consistent intermediate layer effect across architectures.

recommendation.zh: 揭示了 VLM 微调时视觉特征主要注入 LLM 中间层而非浅层的机制，对设计多模态融合架构（如 cross-attention 插入位置）有直接启发，值得一读。
recommendation.en: Reveals that visual features are primarily injected into the intermediate layers of LLMs rather than early layers during VLM fine-tuning, offering direct inspiration for designing multimodal fusion architectures (e.g., cross-attention insertion points); worth reading.

paper.title: MUSE: A Unified Agentic Harness for MLLMs
paper.abstract: Despite rapid progress, multimodal large language models (MLLMs) still fail on tasks that humans solve effortlessly, such as navigating a grid maze from a screenshot or selecting the correct puzzle piece. Rather than retraining the model, we ask a complementary question: how much capability can be elicited from a frozen MLLM purely by improving the execution scaffold around it? We introduce MUSE, a multimodal unified structured execution harness that wraps any off-the-shelf MLLM with composable

summary.core_problem: 多模态大语言模型（MLLM）在视觉空间规划、精细视觉辨别等人类易解任务上的失败，以及如何在不重训模型的前提下通过执行脚手架挖掘已有能力
summary.importance: 提出了一个免训练的统一多模态Agent执行框架，核心贡献是将"模型已具备的能力"和"需要外部脚手架引导的能力"分离开来
summary.technical_approach: MUSE框架：包装任意现成MLLM，提供可组合模块包括任务表示、视觉处理、感知工具使用、结构化解析、确定性验证和验证器引导修复，全程不更新模型参数
summary.experiments: 在视觉空间规划、视觉感知、多模态推理、精细视觉辨别等多个benchmark上评估，使用多个SOTA MLLM，各场景均比裸模型有一致提升
summary.authors_note: Northeastern University；Jianglin Lu等。无领域知名作者

summary_en.core_problem: MLLMs fail on seemingly simple human tasks (grid maze navigation from screenshots, puzzle piece selection); how much capability can be elicited from a frozen MLLM purely by improving the execution scaffold around it, without retraining
summary_en.importance: A training-free unified multimodal agent execution framework; core contribution is the separation of 'capabilities the model already has' from 'capabilities that need external scaffolding'
summary_en.technical_approach: MUSE framework wraps any off-the-shelf MLLM with composable modules for task representation, visual processing, perception tool use, structured parsing, deterministic verification, and verifier-guided repair; no model weight updates
summary_en.experiments: Evaluated across visual spatial planning, visual perception, multimodal reasoning, and fine-grained visual discrimination benchmarks using multiple SOTA MLLMs; consistent gains over bare models in all settings
summary_en.authors_note: Northeastern University; Jianglin Lu et al. No notable authors

recommendation.zh: 对pretrain研究员有弱参考：不重训仅靠脚手架能挖多少能力，反映了模型训练中已内化但未被触发的知识，看摘要即可
recommendation.en: Weak signal for pretraining researchers: how much capability can be elicited without retraining reflects what the model internalized during training but isn't triggered by default; read only abstract

paper.title: Decomposed On-Policy Distillation for Vision-Language Reasoning: Steering Gradients for Visual Grounding

summary.core_problem: 纯文本领域成熟的在线蒸馏（on-policy distillation）直接迁移到多模态场景时，存在未被探明的优化冲突：语言分布对齐和视觉 grounding 两个目标的梯度近似正交，标准单目标优化会被动走次优的妥协轨迹，无法保障足够的视觉感知对齐精度；同时现有VLM蒸馏普遍仅对文本部分做蒸馏，忽略视觉对齐需求。
summary.importance: 这是首个从梯度几何层面分析多模态在线蒸馏优化动态的工作，为多模态蒸馏的目标解耦、优化方向设计提供了可落地的依据；其发现的跨模态梯度子空间正交的分析范式，也可迁移到其他多任务、多模态联合优化的预训练与对齐场景。
summary.technical_approach: 首先将在线蒸馏的序列级反向KL损失数学分解为语言先验对齐、视觉 grounding 两个独立分量，通过梯度分析验证二者的梯度向量近似正交；随后提出视觉梯度引导（VGS）更新规则，动态调整优化轨迹，优先向与教师模型视觉信息增益对齐的子空间更新，在不损失语言流畅度的前提下强化视觉 grounding 能力，几乎无额外训练开销。
summary.experiments: 公开的全文片段未披露完整实验数值，仅明确VGS在复杂多模态推理基准上性能优于标准单目标在线蒸馏，且无显著额外训练成本。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读先看引言部分的问题提出与图2的梯度几何分析，再了解视觉梯度引导的算法定义，预计阅读时间15-20分钟；关注多模态优化动态的研究者可深挖梯度分析部分的推导细节。

summary_en.core_problem: Direct application of standard monolithic on-policy distillation from text-only domains to vision-language models faces an uncharacterized optimization tension: gradients from the language prior alignment objective and the visual grounding objective are nearly orthogonal. Standard single-objective optimization thus passively follows a suboptimal compromise trajectory that fails to enforce sufficient perceptual fidelity, while most existing VLM distillation works only distill text components and neglect visual alignment requirements.
summary_en.importance: This is the first gradient-level geometric analysis of on-policy distillation in multimodal settings. Its finding of orthogonal gradient subspaces across modalities provides an actionable framework for decomposing multimodal training objectives, and the analysis paradigm can be generalized to other multi-task or cross-modal pretraining and alignment scenarios.
summary_en.technical_approach: First, it mathematically decomposes the sequence-level reverse KL loss of on-policy distillation into two independent components: language prior alignment and visual grounding. Gradient analysis confirms the two components have nearly orthogonal gradient vectors. It then proposes Visual Gradient Steering (VGS), an update rule that dynamically reorients the optimization trajectory to prioritize alignment with the teacher's visual information gain, improving visual grounding without degrading linguistic fluency, with negligible training overhead.
summary_en.experiments: The provided full text fragment does not include complete experimental metrics. The paper states VGS outperforms standard monolithic on-policy distillation on complex multimodal reasoning benchmarks, with no significant additional training cost.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim the introduction for problem formulation and Figure 2 for gradient geometric analysis, then review the formulation of Visual Gradient Steering. Estimated reading time: 15-20 minutes. Researchers focused on multimodal optimization dynamics can dig into the derivations of the gradient analysis section.

recommendation.zh: 通过干预梯度来强化VLM的图文对齐，思路比较直接，对多模态post-training中如何利用teacher model的隐式知识有一定参考价值。
recommendation.en: Strengthening VLM image-text alignment by intervening in gradients is a straightforward approach, offering some reference value for how to utilize implicit knowledge from teacher models in multimodal post-training.

paper.title: LoMo: Local Modality Substitution for Deeper Vision-Language Fusion
paper.abstract: Vision-Language Models (VLMs) have achieved substantial progress across a wide range of understanding and reasoning tasks, driven by large-scale image-text training aimed at multimodal fusion. Ideally, replacing a textual question with its rendered-image counterpart should leave model performance essentially unaffected. In practice, however, such modality substitution induces dramatic performance degradation. We attribute this "carrier sensitivity" issue to an inherent bias in current training c

summary.core_problem: 当前 VLM 在处理多模态输入时存在严重的“载体敏感性（carrier sensitivity）”问题：将文本查询替换为语义等价的渲染图像后，模型性能会大幅下降。这源于训练语料中图文角色的不对称性（文本通常是查询，图像是参考），导致模型无法在不同模态载体间对齐等价语义。
summary.importance: 揭示了 VLM 预训练/微调数据分布中的一个隐蔽偏差，并提供了一种无需修改架构、不增加推理成本的纯数据侧解决方案，对提升 VLM 跨模态融合能力和鲁棒性有直接启发。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 LoMo（Local Modality Substitution）数据构建范式。通过三个步骤隐式对齐跨模态表示：1) 结构感知跨度定位：识别纯文本数据中的目标语义片段；2) 视觉渲染：将选定片段渲染为图像，并嵌入原文本中，形成“文本-图像-文本”的交错序列；3) 感知失真：对渲染图像添加真实世界噪声（如模糊、压缩），增强鲁棒性。该方法将标准 SFT 目标转化为跨载体对齐信号。
summary.experiments: 在 LLaVA-OneVision-1.5-8B 和 Qwen3.5-9B 上，LoMo 在 13 个多模态基准（数学、VQA、OCR 等）上平均提升 2.67 和 2.82 个点。特征层面，LoMo 将文本与等价渲染图像的余弦距离缩小了 14.2%，显著缓解了载体敏感性。
summary.reading_guide: 建议重点阅读 Introduction 中对 carrier sensitivity 的定义和量化分析（Figure 1），以及 Methodology 中 LoMo 的三个具体步骤。该方法的数据合成思路可直接应用于 VLM 的 post-training 阶段。

summary_en.core_problem: Current VLMs suffer from a severe 'carrier sensitivity' issue: replacing a textual query with its semantically equivalent rendered image causes a dramatic performance drop. This stems from the asymmetric roles of images and text in training corpora (text as queries, images as references), preventing models from aligning equivalent semantics across modality carriers.
summary_en.importance: Identifies a hidden bias in VLM pre-training/fine-tuning data distributions and provides a pure data-centric solution that requires no architectural changes or inference overhead, offering direct insights for improving cross-modal fusion and robustness.
summary_en.technical_approach: Proposes LoMo (Local Modality Substitution), a data curation paradigm that implicitly aligns cross-modal representations through three steps: 1) Structure-Aware Span Localization: identifies target semantic spans in text-only data; 2) Visual Rendering: renders the selected span into an image and embeds it back, forming a 'text-image-text' interleaved sequence; 3) Perceptual Distortion: applies real-world noise (e.g., blur, compression) to the rendered image for robustness. This transforms the standard SFT objective into a cross-carrier alignment signal.
summary_en.experiments: On LLaVA-OneVision-1.5-8B and Qwen3.5-9B, LoMo achieves average improvements of 2.67 and 2.82 points across 13 multimodal benchmarks (math, VQA, OCR, etc.). At the feature level, LoMo reduces the cosine distance between text and equivalent rendered images by 14.2%, significantly mitigating carrier sensitivity.
summary_en.reading_guide: Focus on the definition and quantitative analysis of carrier sensitivity in the Introduction (Figure 1), and the three specific steps of LoMo in the Methodology. This data synthesis approach can be directly applied to the post-training phase of VLMs.

recommendation.zh: 值得看数据偏置分析；LoMo 未必复杂，但“文本问、图像答”的语料结构确实会污染 native multimodal 预训练。
recommendation.en: Read the data-bias analysis; LoMo may be simple, but the text-query/image-reference corpus pattern is a real issue for native multimodal pretraining.

paper.title: Scaling, Benchmarking, and Reasoning of Vision-Language Agents for Mobile GUI Navigation
paper.abstract: Vision-Language Models (VLMs) have shown rapid progress in mobile GUI navigation. This paper presents a systematic study of data scaling, benchmarking, and reasoning for VLM-based agents in this domain. To facilitate rigorous evaluation, we introduce HyperTrack, a large-scale dataset with over 16000 real-world tasks across more than 650 Chinese mobile applications, along with GUIEvalKit, an open-source toolkit for unified benchmarking of VLMs on offline GUI navigation tasks. Using HyperTrack, we

summary.core_problem: 现有移动端GUI导航的视觉语言智能体缺乏大规模中文场景数据集、统一评测工具，且训练数据规模对监督微调、强化微调的影响，以及推理能力对任务表现的作用均缺乏系统性研究。
summary.importance: 提供了中文移动端GUI领域的大规模评测资产和数据缩放规律结论，对多模态智能体的后训练数据配比、训练范式选择有参考价值。
summary.technical_approach: 1）构建HyperTrack数据集，包含674款中文安卓应用的16080条真实任务轨迹，覆盖分层UI文档、动作 bounding box、屏幕描述等多维度标注，支持域内、未见应用、未见设备等多维度泛化评测；2）开发开源统一评测工具包GUIEvalKit；3）基于数据集系统性对比监督微调（SFT）和DAPO增强的GRPO强化微调范式的缩放规律，评测主流开源VLM的GUI导航表现。
summary.experiments: 强化微调在所有数据规模下均优于监督微调，尤其是域外泛化场景，体现了数据规模与RL的协同效应；交互历史完整性、模型推理能力对GUI任务成功率有显著正向影响。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读数据集统计与对比表格，数据缩放实验的SFT与RL性能对比曲线，预计阅读时间20分钟。
summary.authors_note: 武汉大学、小米，通讯作者高鹏志（小米）

summary_en.core_problem: Existing vision-language agents for mobile GUI navigation lack large-scale Chinese scenario datasets and unified evaluation tools. There is also no systematic research on the impact of training data scale on supervised fine-tuning (SFT) and reinforcement fine-tuning, as well as the effect of reasoning ability on task performance.
summary_en.importance: It provides large-scale evaluation assets and data scaling law conclusions for the Chinese mobile GUI domain, and has reference value for post-training data ratio selection and training paradigm selection for multimodal agents.
summary_en.technical_approach: 1) Construct the HyperTrack dataset, which contains 16080 real task trajectories from 674 Chinese Android apps, covering multi-dimensional annotations such as hierarchical UI documents, action bounding boxes, and screen descriptions, supporting multi-dimensional generalization evaluation including in-domain, unseen app, and unseen device settings. 2) Develop the open-source unified evaluation toolkit GUIEvalKit. 3) Systematically compare the scaling laws of SFT and DAPO-augmented GRPO reinforcement fine-tuning paradigms based on the dataset, and evaluate the GUI navigation performance of mainstream open-source VLMs.
summary_en.experiments: Reinforcement fine-tuning outperforms supervised fine-tuning across all data scales, especially in out-of-domain generalization scenarios, demonstrating the synergy between data scale and RL. Completeness of interaction history and model reasoning ability have significant positive effects on GUI task success rate.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim the dataset statistics and comparison tables, and the SFT vs RL performance scaling curves in data scaling experiments. Estimated reading time: 20 minutes.
summary_en.authors_note: Wuhan University, Xiaomi; corresponding author: Pengzhi Gao (Xiaomi)

recommendation.zh: 提供了一个大规模的 GUI Agent 数据集和评测基准，其关于 RL 在 OOD 泛化上优于 SFT 的结论对 Agent 训练有参考价值。
recommendation.en: Provides a large-scale GUI agent dataset and benchmark; the conclusion that RL outperforms SFT in OOD generalization is valuable for agent training.

paper.title: Chartographer: Counterfactual Chart Generation for Evaluating Vision-Language Models
paper.abstract: Chart question-answering (QA) benchmarks aim to pose questions that require visual reasoning to correctly answer, but models can often reach solutions through shortcuts or prior familiarity with a chart based on their own background knowledge. To strictly evaluate visual reasoning, we propose counterfactual charts where the chart-question task remains fixed, but underlying chart and the corresponding answer are varied. We introduce Chartographer, a framework to reverse engineer charts into execu

summary.core_problem: 论文解决 chart QA 评测中的一个常见混淆：模型答对原始图表问题，可能依赖题目模式、数据先验或训练时见过的图表，而不一定真正读取了当前图表中的视觉证据。
summary.importance: 这篇工作对预训练研究的价值主要在评测方法。它把固定的 chart-question-answer 三元组扩展成 chart-question family：同一个问题逻辑下，图表数据被控制性改变，答案也随之重算。这样可以检测 VLM 是否随视觉证据变化而改变回答。对多模态基座模型来说，这比单点 chart QA 准确率更接近视觉 grounding、OCR、数值比较和表格/图表推理能力的真实要求。
summary.technical_approach: Chartographer 的流程分四步。第一，使用 VLM 从原始图表反向恢复语义数据和绘图代码；语义数据记录数值、标签、类别和分组，绘图代码记录视觉编码、布局和渲染逻辑。第二，用自我修正循环重渲染图表并与原图比较，模型诊断差异、生成修改计划并更新代码，最多迭代 5 次。第三，对困难样本引入人工验证，筛掉无法可靠重建的图表，并记录必要假设。第四，为通过验证的图表生成 seed-controlled 反事实数据，每个原始图表生成 10 个变体，并用 executable QA logic 从底层数据直接计算新答案。这个设计避免了逐张人工标注反事实答案，也把评测重点从“记住一个答案”转为“同一任务在数据变化后是否仍然成立”。
summary.experiments: 作者把框架应用到已有 chart QA 数据集，并评测闭源和开源 VLM。评测单位不是单张图，而是包含原图、基础重建图和反事实变体的 family。核心指标包括 original accuracy、reconstruction accuracy、variant accuracy，以及用于衡量答案是否随视觉证据变化的 sensitivity 和 counterfactual generalizability。主要发现是：模型在原始图表上答对，并不稳定迁移到重建图和反事实图；当底层数据改变后，模型经常不能相应调整答案。这说明固定 benchmark 上的表现会高估模型的图表视觉推理能力。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读即可，预计 25–35 分钟。优先看 Figure 1 的 chart-question family 构造、chart-to-code reconstruction、自我修正循环、executable QA logic，以及指标定义。若关注 VLM 预训练评测，可以重点看 reconstruction accuracy 与 variant accuracy 的差距，因为这个差距直接反映模型对渲染变化和数据变化的鲁棒性。附录中的重建细节和人工验证规则也值得看，它们决定了反事实 benchmark 的可信度。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper targets a key confound in chart QA evaluation: a model may answer a fixed chart-question pair correctly by exploiting question patterns, priors, or memorized chart content, rather than by reading the visual evidence in the current chart.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is an evaluation framework rather than a new model. It turns a static chart-question-answer example into a chart-question family where the task logic is preserved, the underlying data is changed, and the answer is recomputed. This is useful for multimodal foundation model research because it separates visual grounding and numerical reasoning from shortcut use. It also provides a cleaner signal for chart understanding than single-instance accuracy.
summary_en.technical_approach: Chartographer reverse engineers an input chart into semantic data and executable plotting code. The semantic data captures values, labels, categories, and groups, while the rendering code captures visual encodings and layout. A VLM-led self-refinement loop re-renders the chart, compares it with the original, diagnoses reconstruction errors, and updates the data/code pair for up to five iterations. Human reviewers validate difficult cases. For accepted reconstructions, the system builds a seed-controlled generator that produces ten counterfactual chart variants while preserving the chart schema and visual style. Answers are produced by executable QA logic over the underlying data, and the original question is rewritten only when needed for coherence.
summary_en.experiments: The framework is applied to existing chart QA datasets and used to evaluate both proprietary and open-source VLMs. Each evaluation family contains the original chart, a base reconstruction with unchanged data, and counterfactual variants with changed data. The metrics include original accuracy, reconstruction accuracy, variant accuracy, sensitivity to changed visual evidence, and counterfactual generalizability. The main empirical finding is that success on original charts often fails to transfer to reconstructed or counterfactual charts. In many cases, models do not update their answers when the visual data changes, indicating that fixed chart QA benchmarks can overestimate grounded chart reasoning.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim in about 25–35 minutes. Focus on the chart-question family construction, the chart-to-code reconstruction pipeline, the self-refinement loop, executable QA generation, and the metric definitions. For VLM pretraining and evaluation, the most informative comparisons are between original accuracy, reconstruction accuracy, and variant accuracy. The appendix details on reconstruction validation and human review are worth checking because they determine whether the counterfactual variants are trustworthy.

recommendation.zh: 通过反事实生成来解耦 VLM 的视觉推理与背景知识捷径，评测思路很干净，对构建高质量多模态 benchmark 有参考价值。
recommendation.en: Decouples VLM visual reasoning from background knowledge shortcuts via counterfactual generation; the evaluation methodology is clean and valuable for constructing high-quality multimodal benchmarks.

paper.title: LocateAnything: Fast and High-Quality Vision-Language Grounding with Parallel Box Decoding
paper.abstract: Vision-language models (VLMs) commonly formulate visual grounding and detection as a coordinate-token generation problem, serializing each 2D box into multiple 1D tokens that are learned and decoded largely independently. This token-by-token decoding mismatches the coupled structure of box geometry and creates a practical inference bottleneck due to strictly sequential generation. We introduce LocateAnything, a unified generative grounding and detection framework based on Parallel Box Decoding (

summary.core_problem: VLM 用 next-token 方式生成坐标时，把一个 2D box 序列化成多个 token，导致两类问题：几何耦合被打散（精度与一致性受损），以及严格自回归带来推理延迟与吞吐瓶颈。论文要解决的是“既快又稳”的生成式 grounding/detection 解码。
summary.importance: 对预训练研究的直接影响中等偏低，但对“tokenization/输出表示如何决定训练目标与推理效率”很具体：它把 MTP（multi-token prediction）从通用 token 流的并行预测，改成与结构单元对齐的 block 预测，属于一种输出空间的结构化建模。对做多模态统一 LM、坐标/布局/GUI grounding、以及希望把检测纳入生成式范式的人，这类 block-aligned 目标比单纯加速解码（如 speculative）更贴近建模问题本身。
summary.technical_approach:
核心是 Parallel Box Decoding (PBD)：
1) 结构单元对齐：训练时把一个 box（或 point）视为原子单元，在一个并行步骤里联合预测 (x1,y1,x2,y2)，而不是把坐标拆成 1D token 串逐个生成。这样显式建模 box 内部强耦合，避免通用 MTP/随机 mask 造成“跨 box 边界的错误相关”。
2) 训练目标：同时兼容 NTP（自回归逐 token）与 block-level MTP（逐 box 并行），用 joint training 让模型既能并行出结果，也保留必要时回退到稳定的自回归能力。
3) 推理三模式：Fast（全并行 box 预测，最大吞吐）、Slow（传统 NTP，最大稳定）、Hybrid（默认 Fast，检测到格式/一致性违规时，对问题 block 局部回退 NTP 重解码）。Hybrid 的关键在于“只修坏块”，避免全局回退导致的最坏时延。
从系统角度，它把 grounding 的输出从“token 序列”提升为“结构化块序列”，并把可靠性控制做成可配置策略。
summary.experiments: 从引言可确认的量化结论只有：最高约 2.5× 解码吞吐提升，同时提升定位质量；评测覆盖 layout grounding、long-tail detection、GUI grounding。你提供的全文片段未包含实验表格与设置，无法可靠给出：具体基座（如 Qwen2.5-VL/InternVL3 等哪一个）、训练数据规模、mAP/IoU/pointing accuracy 的提升幅度、Hybrid 触发率与最坏时延、以及 PBD 对不同 box 数量/分辨率的 scaling 行为。若补充实验章节，建议重点抽取：Fast vs Slow vs Hybrid 的速度-精度曲线、以及“跨 box 边界 spurious correlation”在消融中的定量证据。
summary.reading_guide:
泛读建议（约 25–35 分钟）：
- 先看 Fig.1/2（坐标序列化的问题与 spurious correlation 示例），建立它为什么不满足几何结构。
- 方法部分重点读：PBD 的输出格式、block 的定义（box/point）、joint training 如何把 NTP 与 MTP 对齐。
- 直接跳到 Hybrid 的“不可靠检测”规则与局部回退机制，这是落地时最关键的工程细节。
- 实验部分优先看速度-精度曲线与消融：PBD vs 逐 token、Hybrid 的触发策略、以及不同任务（GUI/layout/long-tail）的一致性。

summary_en.core_problem: Generative grounding/detection in VLMs typically serializes a 2D box into multiple 1D tokens and decodes them autoregressively, which (i) breaks the strong geometric coupling within a box and (ii) creates a strict sequential decoding bottleneck. The paper targets a speed–quality trade-off that is acceptable for interactive/embodied use.
summary_en.importance: Moderate relevance to foundation-model training: the main contribution is not a new pretraining recipe, but a concrete demonstration that output representation (tokenization of geometry) and training objective alignment can simultaneously improve accuracy and inference throughput. For multimodal LMs that must emit structured outputs (boxes, points, layouts, UI elements), block-aligned prediction is a more modeling-native lever than purely decoding-time accelerations.
summary_en.technical_approach:
LocateAnything introduces Parallel Box Decoding (PBD):
1) Box-aligned blocks: treat each bounding box (or point) as an atomic unit and predict the full coordinate tuple (x1, y1, x2, y2) in one parallel step, instead of token-by-token coordinate generation.
2) Joint training: align autoregressive next-token prediction (NTP) with block-level multi-token prediction (MTP), so the model can operate in both regimes.
3) On-demand inference: three modes—Fast (parallel box decoding), Slow (fully autoregressive for robustness), and Hybrid (default Fast, but detect unreliable blocks—format/consistency violations—and locally fall back to NTP only for those blocks). The design goal is to keep most of the throughput gains while avoiding worst-case failures.
Conceptually, it upgrades the output space from a flat token stream to structured blocks and couples it with a reliability-aware decoding policy.
summary_en.experiments: From the provided excerpt, the only concrete number is up to ~2.5× higher decoding throughput while improving localization quality; evaluations include layout grounding, long-tail detection, and GUI grounding. The excerpt does not include the experimental section, so I cannot report exact datasets, base models, training scale, mAP/IoU gains, Hybrid fallback rates, or latency distributions. With the full results, the most important evidence to extract would be: (i) speed–accuracy curves across Fast/Slow/Hybrid, (ii) ablations showing reduced cross-box spurious correlations, and (iii) scaling behavior with number of boxes and image resolution.
summary_en.reading_guide:
Skim plan (25–35 minutes):
- Start with the motivating figures (coordinate serialization and spurious correlations) to understand why generic MTP is a mismatch.
- In the method, focus on the exact block definition and how PBD is trained alongside NTP.
- Read the Hybrid reliability checks and localized fallback logic; this is the key production-facing detail.
- In experiments, prioritize speed–accuracy plots and ablations comparing PBD vs token-level decoding across GUI/layout/long-tail settings.

recommendation.zh: 挑战了 VLM 中主流的自回归坐标 token 化范式，提出的并行解码（作为原子单元）对多模态统一表示和输出头设计有启发，值得看其架构设计。
recommendation.en: Challenges the mainstream autoregressive coordinate tokenization paradigm in VLMs; the proposed parallel decoding (as atomic units) offers insights for unified multimodal representation and output head design, making its architecture worth reviewing.

paper.title: Real Images, Worse Judgments: Evaluating Vision-Language Models on Concreteness and Imagery
paper.abstract: Visual inputs are often assumed to improve language understanding in multimodal models. We examine this assumption by asking whether vision-language models (VLMs) can distinguish useful visual evidence from incidental image context in lexical judgments. We use human concreteness and imagery ratings because they span words with varying expected visual relevance, from abstract and low-imagery words to concrete and high-imagery words. We find that real-image contexts do not yield consistent gains a

summary.core_problem: 论文检验一个很具体的问题：VLM 在做词汇层面的 concreteness 和 imagery 判断时，能否把图像当作可选证据，而不是把任意真实图片都当成目标词属性的直接依据。任务要求判断的是“词”本身，不是图片内容；因此真实图片在很多情况下只是干扰上下文。
summary.importance: 这篇工作的价值不在于提出新模型，而在于给 VLM 预训练和指令微调暴露了一个训练信号问题：多模态模型未必学会了“视觉证据何时相关”。如果加入真实图像反而降低与人类词汇判断的一致性，说明视觉条件化会改变语言表征和决策路径。对基座研究的启发是，图文预训练不能只优化图像-文本对齐和问答准确率，还需要加入 relevance gating、反事实图像、无关图像鲁棒性等训练或评测信号。
summary.technical_approach: 方法是控制目标词和文本任务不变，只改变视觉上下文。作者比较无图输入、白图、随机噪声图，以及从 ImageNet 和 Wikimedia Commons 检索到的真实图片。模型被要求按原始人类评分量表给单词打分：concreteness 使用 MT40k 的 1–5 分，imagery 使用 CP2004B 的 1–7 分。评估模型包括文本模型 LLaMA 2、Mistral、Qwen2.5，以及 VLM LLaVA 1.5、InternVL3、Pixtral、Qwen2.5-VL、Gemma 3，且均为 instruction-tuned。作者还使用 probing、canonical correlation analysis 和 attribution case study 分析真实图片如何引起表征偏移，并测试一个推理时 prompting 干预，让模型更明确地区分词汇判断和图片内容。
summary.experiments: 实验包含 2,082 个 MT40k 单词和 2,108 个 CP2004B 单词；每个任务使用 5 个 prompt 模板并对可解析数值预测取平均，用 RMSE 衡量模型预测与人类评分的一致性。主要结果是：真实图片上下文没有带来稳定收益，很多情况下会提高 RMSE；负面影响在抽象词和低 imagery 词上更明显，因为这些词本来就不应该由某张图片决定。白图和噪声图用于区分“有视觉输入”与“真实图片语义内容”的影响。作者还做了匹配的人类实验，发现人类评分者在同样的检索图片条件下没有出现类似退化，说明退化主要来自模型对视觉上下文的使用方式。推理时提示模型关注词本身可以缓解部分退化，但不能完全消除。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读即可，预计 20–30 分钟。优先看实验设置中视觉条件的构造方式、按抽象/具体和 low/high imagery 分组的 RMSE 表格，以及 representation analysis 部分。最值得看的是作者如何把“真实图片可能有帮助”转化成“真实图片是否被错误当作证据”的反事实式评测。若关注 VLM 预训练，可重点看 probing、CCA 和 attribution 案例，它们比总分更能说明视觉 token 对语言判断路径的扰动。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper asks whether VLMs can treat visual input as conditional evidence rather than as a default source of truth. The task is lexical: rate the concreteness or imageability of a word.
