A retrieved real image is often incidental, especially for abstract or low-imageability words, and should not determine the rating.
summary_en.importance: The main contribution is diagnostic. It shows that multimodal conditioning can degrade a language judgment that should remain stable under irrelevant visual context. For pretraining, this points to a missing signal in common image-text objectives: models learn to use images, but not reliably when to ignore them. This has direct implications for multimodal data design, counterfactual negative examples, and relevance-aware visual grounding objectives.
summary_en.technical_approach: The study holds the target word and instruction fixed while varying the visual context: no image, a white image, random noise, and real images retrieved from ImageNet or Wikimedia Commons. Models are asked to produce numeric ratings on the original human scales: 1–5 for concreteness in MT40k and 1–7 for imagery in CP2004B. The evaluated models include instruction-tuned text-only LLaMA 2, Mistral, and Qwen2.5, plus LLaVA 1.5, InternVL3, Pixtral, Qwen2.5-VL, and Gemma 3. The analysis combines RMSE against human ratings with probing, canonical correlation analysis, attribution examples, and a simple prompting intervention that tells the model to focus on the word rather than the image.
summary_en.experiments: The evaluation uses 2,082 single-word entries from MT40k and 2,108 from CP2004B. Five prompt templates are used per task, and parsed numeric predictions are averaged to reduce template variance. Real-image contexts do not produce consistent gains and often worsen alignment with human ratings. The degradation is strongest for abstract and low-imageability words, where the image is least relevant to the requested judgment. White and noise controls help separate the effect of visual input from the semantic content of natural images. A matched human study does not show the same degradation, suggesting that the failure is model-specific rather than an unavoidable ambiguity in the task. Prompting can reduce some of the harm, but it is not a complete fix.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim in about 20–30 minutes. Focus on the visual-context construction, the RMSE breakdowns by abstract/concrete and low/high imagery groups, and the representation analysis. The most useful part for multimodal pretraining is the framing: irrelevant real images are used as a controlled test of whether the model can gate visual evidence. The CCA, probing, and attribution sections are more informative than aggregate accuracy because they show how visual context shifts language-side representations.

recommendation.zh: 揭示了 VLM 在处理图文输入时，视觉信息可能成为干扰项（尤其是抽象概念），对多模态预训练中图文对齐 loss 的设计有启发，值得看 probing 分析部分。
recommendation.en: Reveals that visual information can act as a distractor in VLMs (especially for abstract concepts), offering insights for designing image-text alignment losses in multimodal pretraining; the probing analysis is worth reading.

paper.title: Which Pretraining Paradigm Better Serves Spatial Intelligence? An Empirical Comparison of Vision-Language and Video Generation Models
paper.abstract: Spatial intelligence requires visual representations that capture both semantic objects and geometric structure in the physical world. To support this, two major pre-training schemes are now widely used as foundation backbones: Vision-Language Models (VLMs), which use language supervision to align visual observations with semantic concepts, and Video Generation Models (VGMs), which learn from temporally evolving visual worlds. However, it still remains unclear which pre-training scheme provides

summary.core_problem: 比较视觉语言模型和视频生成模型两类预训练范式，哪一种冻结表示更适合作为空间智能任务的表示基础。
summary.importance: 贡献是预训练表示分析，而不是新模型训练方法。它把 VLM 的语言监督和 VGM 的时序生成监督放在同一 frozen-feature probing 框架下比较，对理解多模态预训练信号的取舍有参考价值。
summary.technical_approach: 作者使用轻量 probe，在冻结 backbone 上评估三类空间智能能力：语义标注、实例分组和 3D 几何预测。通过固定下游探针容量，尽量把差异归因到预训练表示本身，而不是下游训练能力。
summary.experiments: 实验覆盖 VLM 和 VGM 两个模型家族，在语义、实例和几何三个轴上进行对比。摘要给出的主要发现是两类表示存在互补性：VLM 更偏语义对象信息，VGM 更可能编码时序和几何结构。摘要未给出具体模型列表、参数量和数值提升。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper compares whether vision-language models or video generation models provide better frozen representations for spatial intelligence.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is representation analysis rather than a new training method. It places language-supervised VLMs and temporally trained video generation models under the same frozen-feature probing setup, offering a useful signal about pretraining objective trade-offs.
summary_en.technical_approach: The authors use lightweight probes on frozen backbones and evaluate three axes of spatial intelligence: semantic tagging, instance grouping, and 3D geometry prediction. By controlling the probe, the comparison aims to attribute differences to pretrained representations rather than downstream capacity.
summary_en.experiments: The experiments compare VLM and VGM model families across semantic, instance-level, and geometric tasks. The abstract reports a complementary pattern: VLMs encode stronger semantic object information, while VGMs appear more favorable for temporal and geometric structure. Exact model lists, parameter counts, and numbers are not provided in the abstract.

recommendation.zh: 只看 frozen-probe 设计和互补性结论；它更像表示诊断，不足以直接改动多模态预训练 recipe。
recommendation.en: Skim the frozen-probe setup and complementarity result; it is representation diagnostics, not enough to change a pretraining recipe.

paper.title: Your CLIP has 164 dimensions of noise: Exploring the embeddings covariance eigenspectrum of contrastively pretrained vision-language transformers
paper.abstract: Contrastively pre-trained Vision-Language Models (VLMs) serve as powerful feature extractors. Yet, their shared latent spaces are prone to structural anomalies and act as repositories for non-semantic, multi-modal noise. To address this phenomenon, we employ spectral decomposition of covariance matrices to decompose the VLM latent space into a multi-modal semantic signal component and a shared noise subspace. We observe that this noise geometry exhibits strong subgroup invariance across distinct

summary.core_problem: 对比预训练的视觉-语言模型（VLMs）的共享隐空间中，部分维度会发生“维度坍缩”（dimensional collapse），成为存储非语义、跨模态噪声的容器，影响表征质量。
summary.importance: 揭示了现代 VLMs 隐空间中噪声维度的几何结构和跨数据集不变性，为理解 VLM 表征机制提供了新视角，并证明了剪枝这些噪声维度可以无损甚至提升下游任务性能。
summary.technical_approach: 采用协方差矩阵的谱分解方法，将 VLM 隐空间分解为多模态语义信号子空间和共享噪声子空间。通过计算不同模态（图像、文本）和平均协方差矩阵的特征值，利用肘部法则确定噪声阈值。引入均方余弦子空间角（mSCSA）度量，量化高维噪声空间中子空间的重叠程度，验证噪声维度的全局性和不变性。
summary.experiments: 在 LAION-2B 和 ImageNet 数据集上分析了 CLIP 和 SigLIP 等模型。结果表明，噪声维度对应的特征值在不同数据子集（如 ImageNet 不同类别）上表现出高度一致性（mSCSA 接近 1.0）。剪枝这些共享噪声维度（通常是特征值最小的维度）对下游任务性能无害，部分情况下甚至有提升。
summary.reading_guide: 建议重点阅读 Methodology 部分关于噪声阈值确定和 mSCSA 度量的定义，以及 Experiments 中验证噪声维度全局性的实验设计。预计阅读时间 15 分钟。

summary_en.core_problem: In the shared latent space of contrastively pre-trained Vision-Language Models (VLMs), certain dimensions undergo 'dimensional collapse', acting as repositories for non-semantic, cross-modal noise and degrading representation quality.
summary_en.importance: This work reveals the geometric structure and cross-dataset invariance of noise dimensions in modern VLM latent spaces, offering new mechanistic insights into VLM representations. It demonstrates that pruning these noise dimensions is harmless and can even improve downstream task performance.
summary_en.technical_approach: The authors employ spectral decomposition of covariance matrices to separate the VLM latent space into a multi-modal semantic signal subspace and a shared noise subspace. By analyzing the eigenvalues of image, text, and average covariance matrices, they use the elbow method to determine a noise threshold. They introduce the Mean Squared Cosine of Subspace Angles (mSCSA) metric to quantify subspace overlap in high-dimensional noisy spaces, verifying the global nature and invariance of noise dimensions.
summary_en.experiments: Analysis of models like CLIP and SigLIP on LAION-2B and ImageNet datasets shows that the eigenvalues corresponding to noise dimensions exhibit high consistency across different data subsets (e.g., different ImageNet classes), with mSCSA approaching 1.0. Pruning these shared noise dimensions (typically those with the smallest eigenvalues) does not harm downstream performance and sometimes improves it.
summary_en.reading_guide: Focus on the Methodology section for the determination of the noise threshold and the definition of the mSCSA metric, as well as the experimental design verifying the global nature of noise dimensions in the Experiments section. Estimated reading time: 15 minutes.

recommendation.zh: 做VLM预训练表征对齐的研究员可重点看§3的谱分解方法和噪声维度定量结果，可用于优化预训练对齐目标
recommendation.en: Researchers working on VLM pretraining alignment can refer to §3 spectral decomposition method and noise dimension quantification results to optimize alignment objectives

paper.title: Training Long-Context Vision-Language Models Effectively with Generalization Beyond 128K Context
paper.abstract: Long-context modeling is becoming a core capability of modern large vision-language models (LVLMs), enabling sustained context management across long-document understanding, video analysis, and multi-turn tool use in agentic workflows. Yet practical training recipes remain insufficiently explored, particularly for designing and balancing long-context data mixtures. In this work, we present a systematic study of long-context continued pre-training for LVLMs, extending a 7B model from 32K to 128K

summary.core_problem: 这项工作研究 LVLM 长上下文继续预训练的实际配方：如何把一个 32K 上下文的 7B 视觉语言模型扩展到 128K，并让能力泛化到 256K / 512K，而不是只在目标长度附近记住位置模式。重点问题不是 RoPE 缩放本身，而是长文档数据应该怎么合成、任务怎么选、长度分布怎么配、是否需要混入短上下文数据。
summary.importance: 对预训练研究的价值很直接：它把 long-context LVLM 的瓶颈从“位置编码能不能外推”转向“长上下文训练信号是否教会模型检索关键信息”。论文给出几条可操作的结论。长文档 VQA 明显优于 OCR transcription；均衡长度分布优于只堆 128K 附近的 target-length 数据；retrieval-heavy 的任务混合更有效，但需要少量 reasoning 数据保持任务多样性；纯 long-document VQA 基本保留短上下文能力，因此不一定像 LLM LongPT 那样强依赖短数据混合。这些结论对多模态长上下文预训练、文档智能模型、长视频模型和 agentic workflow 的上下文管理都有参考价值。
summary.technical_approach: 实验基座是 Qwen2.5-VL-7B，原始上下文为 32K。论文用 Dynamic-NTK 启发式把 mRoPE base frequency 从 1×10^6 调到 4×10^6，最大序列长度设为 131,072 tokens，全局 batch 为 4M tokens，每个 LongPT run 使用固定 5B token 预算。数据侧先构建超过 150 万个 PDF 文档的池子，覆盖论文、书籍、技术手册，以及工程、医学、社会科学、生物等领域。训练时选择 32 到 50 页的文档，并渲染成页面图像；在 Qwen2.5-VL 的 2×2 pixel unshuffle 设置下，这些文档形成约 32K 到 128K 的多模态序列。为避免评测污染，使用 PDF 内容的 SHA-256 hash 做过滤。任务侧构造五类长文档任务，归为两组：long-document VQA 和 OCR transcription。主要发现是，VQA 格式比纯 OCR 更适合 LongPT，因为它同时提供 instruction-formatted supervision、跨页检索、信息抽取、数值推理和复杂版面理解信号。最终配方训练得到 MMProLong，并在 Qwen3-VL 上进一步验证可迁移性。
summary.experiments: 核心训练规模是 7B 基座、5B token LongPT、128K 最大训练长度、4M token 全局 batch。主要结果是，MMProLong 在 64K 和 128K 的长文档 VQA 上提升 7.1%；在没有额外训练或适配的情况下，仍能在 256K 和 512K 上保持强性能，并相对基线超过 20%。能力还迁移到更广的多模态长上下文任务，包括网页 needle-in-a-haystack 的 MM-NIAH、长上下文压缩 VTCBench，以及长视频理解 benchmark。消融给出三点关键实验洞察：第一，balanced length distribution 比集中在 128K 附近的 target-length-focused 数据更好，说明模型需要学习不同长度和位置上的关键信息检索，而不是只适配一个窗口长度。第二，长上下文训练的主要瓶颈仍是 key-information retrieval，因此 retrieval-heavy mixture 优于偏 OCR 或偏复杂 reasoning 的配方。第三，纯 long-document VQA 对短上下文能力损伤很小，这与部分 LLM 长上下文继续预训练经验不同，原因可能是 VQA 数据本身保持了指令格式和任务多样性。
summary.reading_guide: 建议精读数据构造和消融部分。优先看 long-document VQA 与 OCR transcription 的对比，因为它决定了长上下文多模态训练信号应当是“问答式任务监督”还是“逐字转录监督”。然后看长度分布实验，重点关注 balanced distribution 为什么能带来 256K / 512K 外推。再看 task mixture 消融，尤其是 retrieval-heavy 与 reasoning 数据比例的取舍。实验设置中的 mRoPE base frequency、5B token budget、4M token batch、PDF 页面数选择也值得记录，这些是复现实验配方的关键超参。预计精读需要 1 到 1.5 小时；如果只泛读，20 到 30 分钟看 Introduction、Experimental Setup、Data Curation 和三组 ablation 结论即可。
summary.authors_note: 输入材料未给出完整作者与机构信息。工作基于 Qwen2.5-VL-7B 和 Qwen3-VL 做实验验证。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper studies the practical recipe for long-context continued pretraining of large vision-language models. The target is to extend a 7B LVLM from 32K to 128K context and obtain generalization to 256K and 512K without additional adaptation. The central question is not only how to scale positional encoding, but how to design long-document data, task formats, length distributions, and short-context mixing.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is useful for pretraining because it reframes long-context LVLM training as a data-mixture problem. The main bottleneck is key-information retrieval over long multimodal sequences, not simple OCR coverage. The paper provides several actionable findings: long-document VQA is much more effective than OCR transcription; balanced sequence-length distributions outperform data concentrated near the 128K target length; retrieval-heavy mixtures work best when paired with a modest amount of reasoning data; and pure long-document VQA largely preserves short-context performance, reducing the need for explicit short-context mixing. These findings are relevant to document-native LVLMs, long-video models, and agent workflows that rely on sustained multimodal context.
summary_en.technical_approach: The study uses Qwen2.5-VL-7B as the base model and extends its context window from 32K to 128K. Following a Dynamic-NTK heuristic, the mRoPE base frequency is increased from 1×10^6 to 4×10^6. Each LongPT run uses a fixed 5B-token budget, a maximum sequence length of 131,072 tokens, and a global batch size of 4M tokens. On the data side, the authors build a pool of more than 1.5 million PDF documents spanning papers, books, technical manuals, and domains such as engineering, medicine, social sciences, and biology. Documents with 32 to 50 pages are selected and rendered into page images. With the 2×2 pixel unshuffle in the Qwen2.5-VL backbone, these documents produce multimodal sequences from roughly 32K to 128K tokens. Potential evaluation contamination is filtered using SHA-256 hashes of PDF content. Five long-document training tasks are synthesized and grouped into long-document VQA and OCR transcription. The final recipe emphasizes VQA-style supervision because it provides instruction formatting, information extraction, cross-page retrieval, numerical reasoning, and layout understanding signals. The resulting model is named MMProLong, and the recipe is also validated on Qwen3-VL.
summary_en.experiments: The main training setup uses a 7B base model, 5B tokens of continued pretraining, 128K maximum training length, and a 4M-token global batch. MMProLong improves long-document VQA performance by 7.1% at 64K and 128K. Without additional training or adaptation, it maintains strong performance at 256K and 512K and exceeds baselines by more than 20%. The gains transfer to broader multimodal long-context tasks, including webpage-based needle-in-a-haystack on MM-NIAH, long-context compression on VTCBench, and long-video understanding benchmarks. The ablations are the most informative part. Balanced length distributions outperform target-length-focused data, indicating that the model should learn retrieval across many lengths and positions instead of specializing to the training-window boundary. Retrieval-heavy task mixtures are preferred because key-information retrieval remains the dominant weakness. A small amount of reasoning data helps preserve task diversity. Pure long-document VQA has limited negative impact on short-context capability, likely because the data remains instruction-formatted and diverse.
summary_en.reading_guide: Focus first on the data curation and ablation sections. The most important comparison is long-document VQA versus OCR transcription, because it determines what kind of supervision actually improves long-context LVLMs. Then read the sequence-length distribution experiments, especially the evidence that balanced lengths support 256K and 512K extrapolation. The task-mixture ablations are also important, particularly the trade-off between retrieval-heavy data and reasoning data. The experimental setup details are worth recording: mRoPE base frequency scaling, 5B-token budget, 4M-token global batch, 131K maximum sequence length, and the 32-to-50-page PDF selection rule. A careful read should take about 60 to 90 minutes; a quick technical skim can focus on the introduction, experimental setup, data curation, and three main ablation findings.
summary_en.authors_note: The provided material does not include the full author or institution list. The experiments are built around Qwen2.5-VL-7B and are further validated on Qwen3-VL.

recommendation.zh: 字节和港科大关于 VLM 长上下文训练的扎实实证工作，明确指出了 VQA 数据优于 OCR 以及长度分布平衡的重要性，对做多模态长文本的同学极具参考价值。
recommendation.en: Solid empirical work from ByteDance and HKUST on VLM long-context training, clearly pointing out the superiority of VQA data over OCR and the importance of balanced length distribution. Highly valuable for researchers working on multimodal long context.

paper.title: 3D Primitives are a Spatial Language for VLMs
paper.abstract: Vision-language models (VLMs) exhibit a striking paradox: they can generate executable code that reconstructs a 3D scene from geometric primitives with correct object counts, classes, and approximate positions, yet the same models fail at simpler spatial questions on the same image. We show that 3D geometric primitives (cubes, spheres, cylinders, expressed in executable code) serve as a powerful intermediate representation for spatial understanding, and exploit this through three contributions.

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作研究 VLM 的空间理解为何在自然语言 QA 中表现差，但在生成 3D primitive 场景代码时能显露出更好的结构化空间信息。
summary.importance: 对预训练研究的启发在于，代码形式的 3D primitive 可能是一种有效的空间中间表示。它把形状、尺度、位置和方向放进可执行结构里，比直接用自然语言回答更接近模型在代码数据中学到的表示。对 native multimodal pretraining 来说，这提示空间能力不只取决于视觉 encoder 或图文对齐，也取决于输出通道和训练语料里是否存在可复用的结构化空间 token。
summary.technical_approach: 作者提出 SpatialBabel，用同一批场景同时评估 3D scene-code reconstruction 和 spatial QA。primitive split 包含 1,000 个程序生成的 Blender 场景，每个场景有 3 到 20 个几何体，形状包括 cube、sphere、cylinder、cone、torus、pyramid，并控制遮挡以减少感知歧义；Hypersim split 用于更接近真实照片的室内场景验证。评估覆盖六种 scene-code language，并测试 14 个 VLM。方法上有两个关键设计：Code-CoT 先让模型生成 3D primitive reconstruction code，再基于自己的 reconstruction 回答空间问题；S3-FT 则解析模型自己生成的 Three.js 代码，构造成多任务空间标注数据，用于无人工标签、无 teacher model 的 self-supervised spatial fine-tuning。
summary.experiments: SpatialBabel 的设置包括 512×512 单视角渲染、primitive 场景复杂度从 3 个物体到 20 个物体、Hypersim 405 个场景并评估其中 200 个。实验显示，不同 VLM 对不同 scene-code language 的适应差异明显；在 primitive spatial QA 上，Code-CoT 能提高一部分中等能力 frontier VLM 的表现；在真实照片 CV-Bench-3D 上，具备较强代码能力的 VLM 也能从这种 code-mediated reasoning 中获益。S3-FT 在仅使用 primitive images 构造训练数据的情况下，可以迁移到真实照片 benchmark，并在五个 base VLM 上显示可迁移性。给出的内容没有包含具体准确率表和提升幅度。
summary.reading_guide: 建议泛读，预计 20 到 30 分钟。优先看 Introduction 和 Figure 1，理解同一模型在 QA 与 scene-code generation 上的矛盾；再看 SpatialBabel 的数据构造和评估协议，确认它如何减少感知噪声；最后看 Code-CoT 与 S3-FT 的实验表。对基座预训练研究，重点不是空间 QA 分数，而是 3D primitive code 作为空间表示和训练信号的作用。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper asks why VLMs often fail direct natural-language spatial QA while being able to generate executable 3D primitive scene code that contains more accurate object counts, categories, and approximate positions.
summary_en.importance: The useful pretraining signal is representational. 3D primitive code acts like a structured spatial language: it packages shape, scale, orientation, and position into a format that many VLMs have likely seen through code training. This matters for multimodal pretraining because spatial competence may depend not only on visual encoders and image-text alignment losses, but also on whether the training mixture contains structured output channels that make spatial variables explicit.
summary_en.technical_approach: The work introduces SpatialBabel, a benchmark pairing primitive-based 3D reconstruction with spatial QA. The primitive split has 1,000 procedurally generated Blender scenes with 3–20 objects, controlled colors, simple shapes, and reduced occlusion, so errors are less likely to come from object recognition ambiguity. The Hypersim split adds photo-realistic indoor scenes for transfer evaluation. Fourteen VLMs are evaluated across six scene-code languages. The proposed Code-CoT pipeline first asks the model to reconstruct the scene as executable primitive code, then answers questions conditioned on that reconstruction. S3-FT parses a model’s own Three.js reconstructions into structured spatial annotations and fine-tunes on the resulting multi-task data, without human labels or a separate teacher model.
summary_en.experiments: The benchmark uses 512×512 single-view renders, five primitive-scene complexity tiers, and a Hypersim setting with 405 scenes, of which 200 are evaluated. Results show strong dependence on the target scene-code language and model-specific reconstruction patterns. Code-CoT improves primitive-scene spatial QA for some mid-tier frontier models and also helps on real-photo CV-Bench-3D when the model has sufficient coding capability. S3-FT trained from primitive images transfers to real-photo benchmarks and is reported across five base VLMs. Exact accuracy numbers and deltas are not present in the provided content.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim in about 20–30 minutes. Focus on the motivating contradiction in the introduction, the SpatialBabel construction, the table comparing scene-code languages across models, and the Code-CoT and S3-FT results. For pretraining researchers, the main point is not the benchmark score itself, but the evidence that executable 3D primitive code can expose and train spatial structure more effectively than direct natural-language QA.

recommendation.zh: 将3D代码作为VLM空间推理的中间语言（Code-CoT），揭示了模态翻译（图像->代码）对激发推理能力的价值，对多模态对齐和CoT设计有启发。
recommendation.en: Using 3D code as an intermediate language for VLM spatial reasoning (Code-CoT) reveals the value of modality translation (image->code) in eliciting reasoning capabilities, inspiring multimodal alignment and CoT design.

paper.title: Revealing Interpretable Failure Modes of VLMs
paper.abstract: Vision-Language Models (VLMs) are increasingly used in safety-critical applications because of their broad reasoning capabilities and ability to generalize with minimal task-specific engineering. Despite these advantages, they can exhibit catastrophic failures in specific real-world situations, constituting failure modes.   We introduce REVELIO, a framework for systematically uncovering interpretable failure modes in VLMs. We define a failure mode as a composition of interpretable, domain-releva

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作解决的不是“VLM 会不会出错”这个泛问题，而是更具体的一层：如何在黑盒条件下，从一个指数级组合空间里，系统找出“可解释、可复现、贴近真实场景”的失败模式。作者把 failure mode 定义为一组领域概念的合取，例如“近距离行人 + 特定障碍物 + 恶劣天气”，并要求模型在这类场景分布上持续犯错，而不是只在某张图上偶发失误。这个定义刻意避开了像素级对抗攻击那种不自然扰动，也不同于静态 benchmark 只能被动测预设样例。核心难点有三个：概念要能落到真实场景生成上；概念组合空间是离散且带物理约束的；很多目标 VLM 是闭源，只能做黑盒评估。
summary.importance: 对基座研究本身，它不是新的预训练方法，但对 VLM 预训练和评测接口有直接启发。第一，它把“失败”从单点样本提升到“概念分布上的系统脆弱性”，这比平均 benchmark 分数更接近训练时真正该修补的缺口。第二，它强调场景图级语义而不是像素扰动，给数据构造、困难样本挖掘、持续预训练和安全对齐提供了更可操作的监督单位。第三，它证明即便在黑盒模型上，也能用有限预算找到远多于随机搜索的高价值失败模式，这说明现有 VLM 的错误并不只是长尾噪声，而是有结构的感知盲点。对做预训练的人，最有价值的地方在于：这种 failure mode 可以反过来定义 curriculum、数据重采样和 targeted continued pretraining 的对象。
summary.technical_approach:
方法上，Revelio 的关键选择是把搜索空间从连续像素空间换成离散语义空间。作者先用 scene graph 来表示图像场景，节点是实体，边是关系，属性描述实体状态；领域概念被定义成 scene graph 的子图模式，例如“行人在车前方且距离近”“存在 barrier 且天气为雨天”。这些概念不是只做标签，而是进一步映射到场景分布：通过 Scenic 这样的场景描述语言，把概念约束编译成仿真器中的可采样 scenario distribution，再由 CARLA 等渲染引擎生成图像。这样评估的对象不是单个实例，而是满足该概念组合的一簇真实可渲染场景。

在搜索层面，作者把问题表述为带兼容性约束的黑盒组合优化。给定一个概念集合，系统从对应场景分布采样若干场景，查询 VLM 在固定任务 prompt 下的行为，估计 failure rate。目标是在预算有限时找到多个高 failure rate 的概念组合，而不是只找一个最坏点。为此设计了两类搜索器。第一类是 diversity-aware beam search：它沿着概念组合逐层扩展，但不仅按当前失败率打分，还显式鼓励结果多样性，避免 beam 全部坍缩到同一类近邻模式，适合快速勾勒 failure landscape。第二类是基于 Gaussian Process 的全局搜索，用 Thompson Sampling 在离散组合空间上做 exploration/exploitation 平衡。GP 负责对未评估组合的失败率做后验建模，Thompson sampling 负责在不确定但可能高风险的区域继续试探。由于概念之间存在物理不兼容，搜索过程中还要满足约束过滤，避免生成不可实现的场景组合。

从系统设计看，这套框架有几个值得注意的点。其一，它是黑盒友好的，不依赖梯度、内部激活或 token 级 logprob，因此可以直接测闭源 VLM。其二，它把“可解释性”前置到搜索对象本身，而不是事后再做 attribution。其三，它是可迁移的：换领域时主要替换概念 taxonomy 和渲染器接口，而不是重写整套方法。
summary.experiments:
实验覆盖了至少两个安全相关场景：自动驾驶和室内机器人。定性结果里，作者展示了几类很具体的脆弱性。自动驾驶场景中，VLM 在空间 grounding 上有明显问题，例如面对近距离行人时给出错误的 stop/continue 决策；同时对附近 barrier 等危险元素经常视而不见。室内机器人场景中，则出现另一种模式：模型过度保守，导致性能受损，同时对尖锐物体等风险源识别不足。这一点很重要，因为它说明 failure mode 不只是一边倒的“冒进”，也可能是“过度谨慎但仍不安全”。

定量上，论文最核心的结果是：在相同查询预算下，Revelio 平均能比无引导随机搜索多发现 3 到 5 倍的 failure modes。这个数字说明搜索器确实在利用结构，而不是单纯多试几次。文中还比较了两种搜索策略的角色分工：beam search 更适合快速找到一批高风险模式并覆盖不同区域；GP + Thompson sampling 在预算继续增加时更有利于全局探索和挖掘随机法难碰到的组合。作者还强调 failure mode 的评估是基于场景分布上的一致失败，而不是单样本命中，因此结果比常见 adversarial case study 更稳。

从消融角度，值得注意的不是某个模块带来几点提升，而是几个设计选择共同支撑了“真实且可解释”的目标：如果不用概念级搜索而退回随机场景采样，发现效率明显下降；如果不用多样性约束，搜索结果容易集中在少数相似模式；如果不通过场景分布估计 failure，而只看个别样本，得到的模式稳定性会差很多。摘要里没有给出更细的样本数、模型名和每个 benchmark 的绝对错误率，全文阅读时应重点核对这些表格和附录设置。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读建议是先抓定义，再看搜索器，最后看案例。优先看 Introduction 和方法部分里对 failure mode 的形式化定义，尤其是“概念子图 → 场景分布 → 黑盒 failure rate 估计”这条链路，这是整篇文章真正的新意。然后看两种搜索算法的设计动机：为什么 beam search 里要加 diversity，为什么还需要 GP/Thompson sampling 这种更全局的策略。实验部分建议重点看自动驾驶案例，因为那里最能体现 spatial grounding 的系统性缺陷；再看室内机器人案例，理解作者为什么把“过度保守”也视为 failure mode。若时间有限，预计 20–30 分钟可以完成有效泛读；若要判断它能否用于数据闭环，需再看附录里概念兼容性约束、采样预算和 failure 统计置信度的细节。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper tackles a specific problem in VLM evaluation: how to systematically uncover realistic, interpretable, and repeatable failure modes under black-box access. Instead of asking whether a VLM fails on isolated examples, it defines a failure mode as a conjunction of domain concepts—such as pedestrian proximity, barrier type, and weather condition—under which the model fails consistently over a scenario distribution. This is a different target from static benchmarks, which only test predefined cases, and from adversarial attacks, which often leave the natural data manifold. The hard part is that the search space is exponentially large, concept combinations must remain physically compatible, and many target VLMs are closed-source.
summary_en.importance: This is not a pretraining method, but it is relevant to foundation-model research because it reframes evaluation in a way that can feed back into data and training. The main contribution is moving from sample-level errors to distribution-level semantic failure modes. That matters for VLM pretraining because these modes are much closer to actionable training units: they can define targeted data collection, hard-example mining, curriculum design, and continued pretraining objectives. The paper also shows that many VLM failures are structured rather than random long-tail noise. If a black-box search can repeatedly surface the same semantic blind spots, then those blind spots are likely tied to representation and training data gaps, not just unlucky prompts.
summary_en.technical_approach:
Revelio shifts the search space from continuous pixels to discrete semantics. Images are abstracted as scene graphs with entities, relations, and attributes. Domain concepts are defined as subgraph patterns, for example a pedestrian in front of the ego vehicle at close range, or a barrier co-occurring with rainy weather. These concepts are not used merely as annotations. They are compiled into scenario distributions through a scene specification layer, using Scenic and a renderer such as CARLA. As a result, the unit of evaluation is not a single rendered image but a family of physically plausible scenes satisfying the same semantic constraints.

The search problem is formulated as black-box constrained combinatorial optimization. For any candidate concept set, the framework samples scenarios from the corresponding distribution, queries the VLM with a task prompt, and estimates a failure rate. The objective is to discover multiple high-risk concept combinations under a limited query budget. To do that, the paper introduces two search procedures. The first is a diversity-aware beam search. It expands concept combinations greedily, but the scoring is not based on failure rate alone; it also encourages diversity so that the beam does not collapse onto near-duplicate modes. This makes it useful for rapidly mapping the failure landscape. The second is a Gaussian-process global search with Thompson sampling. The GP models uncertainty over untested concept combinations, and Thompson sampling balances exploitation of known risky regions with exploration of uncertain but promising ones. Physical compatibility constraints are enforced throughout, so the search does not waste budget on impossible scene combinations.

A notable design choice is that interpretability is built into the search object itself. The method does not first find arbitrary failures and then try to explain them post hoc. It searches directly over human-readable semantic factors. Another important point is that the framework is black-box by construction: it does not rely on gradients, hidden states, or token-level likelihoods, which makes it usable for frontier closed-source VLMs.
summary_en.experiments:
The experiments cover at least two safety-relevant domains: autonomous driving and indoor robotics. Qualitatively, the paper surfaces several concrete failure patterns. In driving scenarios, VLMs show brittle spatial grounding, including incorrect stop-versus-continue decisions around nearby pedestrians. They also miss hazardous elements such as barriers even when those elements should be central to the decision. In indoor robotics, the dominant pattern is different: the models can become excessively cautious, hurting task performance, while still failing to properly account for sharp or dangerous objects. That distinction matters because it shows the framework is not only finding reckless behavior; it also captures maladaptive over-caution.

The main quantitative result is that Revelio discovers on average 3–5 times more failure modes than unguided random search under the same budget. That is the key evidence that the search procedures exploit semantic structure rather than merely sampling more. The paper also positions the two search strategies differently: diversity-aware beam search is better for quickly surfacing a broad set of high-risk modes, while GP-based Thompson sampling is more useful for global exploration as the budget grows. Another important experimental choice is that failures are measured over scenario distributions, not single examples, which makes the discovered modes more stable than one-off adversarial cases.

The abstract does not expose all low-level numbers such as exact model names, sample counts per concept set, or absolute failure rates on each benchmark. Those details need to be checked in the full tables and appendix. Still, the central empirical message is clear: realistic semantic search is substantially more efficient than random search for uncovering systematic VLM vulnerabilities.
summary_en.reading_guide: For a skim, start with the formal definition of a failure mode and the pipeline from concept subgraphs to scenario distributions. That is the conceptual core of the paper. Then read the sections on the two search algorithms and focus on why both are needed: beam search for fast local discovery with coverage, GP plus Thompson sampling for broader exploration under uncertainty. In the experiments, prioritize the autonomous-driving case studies because they make the spatial-grounding failures easy to understand. Then look at the indoor-robotics examples to see how the framework captures over-cautious behavior as a failure mode rather than a benign conservative bias. If the goal is to assess relevance for training, spend extra time on the appendix details around compatibility constraints, sampling budgets, and how failure rates are estimated. A useful skim should take about 20–30 minutes.

recommendation.zh: VLM失败模式挖掘的实用搜索方案，做多模态预训练消融或缺陷分析时可以借鉴，重点看方法部分的搜索策略即可
recommendation.en: Practical search scheme for VLM failure mode discovery; reference the search strategy for multimodal pretraining ablation or defect analysis, focus on the search strategy in the method section.

paper.title: Sparse Autoencoders as Plug-and-Play Firewalls for Adversarial Attack Detection in VLMs
paper.abstract: Vision-language models (VLMs) have advanced rapidly and are increasingly deployed in real-world applications, especially with the rise of agent-based systems. However, their safety has received relatively limited attention. Even the latest proprietary and open-weight VLMs remain highly vulnerable to adversarial attacks, leaving downstream applications exposed to significant risks. In this work, we propose a novel and lightweight adversarial attack detection framework based on sparse autoencoders

summary.core_problem: 视觉语言模型（VLMs）容易受到对抗性攻击，如何轻量级且可靠地检测输入图像是否被对抗性扰动？
summary.importance: 提出了一种基于稀疏自编码器（SAE）的即插即用对抗攻击检测框架，利用 SAE 提取的稀疏特征来识别攻击信号，为 VLM 的安全性提供了一种新的防御思路。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 SAEgis 框架：将 SAE 模块插入预训练的 VLM 中，使用标准的重建目标进行训练。研究发现，学习到的稀疏潜在特征自然地捕获了与攻击相关的信号。利用这些特征，可以训练一个分类器来判断输入图像是否被对抗性扰动。
summary.experiments: 在域内、跨域和跨攻击设置下进行了广泛实验，证明 SAEgis 取得了强大的检测性能，尤其是在检测未见过的攻击类型时表现出色。
summary.authors_note: Magellan Technology Research Institute (MTRI) 和早稻田大学合作。

summary_en.core_problem: Vision-language models (VLMs) are vulnerable to adversarial attacks; how can we lightweightly and reliably detect whether an input image has been adversarially perturbed?
summary_en.importance: Proposes a plug-and-play adversarial attack detection framework based on Sparse Autoencoders (SAEs), utilizing sparse features extracted by SAEs to identify attack signals, offering a new defense perspective for VLM safety.
summary_en.technical_approach: Proposes the SAEgis framework: inserting an SAE module into a pretrained VLM and training it with standard reconstruction objectives. The study found that the learned sparse latent features naturally capture attack-relevant signals. Using these features, a classifier can be trained to determine if an input image has been adversarially perturbed.
summary_en.experiments: Extensive experiments across in-domain, cross-domain, and cross-attack settings demonstrate that SAEgis achieves strong detection performance, particularly excelling in detecting unseen attack types.
summary_en.authors_note: Collaboration between Magellan Technology Research Institute (MTRI) and Waseda University.

recommendation.zh: 将 SAE 用于 VLM 对抗攻击检测的应用型工作，证明了 SAE 特征对异常信号的敏感性，对做机制分析和安全防御的同学有一定参考价值。
recommendation.en: An application of SAEs for VLM adversarial attack detection, demonstrating the sensitivity of SAE features to anomalous signals; holds some reference value for those working on mechanistic interpretability and safety defenses.

paper.title: Structured Role-Aware Policy Optimization for Multimodal Reasoning
paper.abstract: Reinforcement learning from verifiable rewards (RLVR), especially with Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO), has shown strong potential for improving the reasoning capabilities of large vision-language models (LVLMs). However, in multimodal reasoning, final-answer rewards are typically assigned at the sequence level and do not distinguish the functional roles of different tokens, making it difficult to determine whether a correct answer is supported by task-relevant visual evidence. In this

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作处理多模态 RLVR 中的信用分配问题。常规 GRPO 只根据最终答案给整段输出同一个序列级奖励，但多模态推理通常包含两个功能不同的阶段：先从图像中抽取相关证据，再基于证据推理答案。只看最终答案会把“看对图”和“推对理”混在一起，模型可能依靠语言先验或数据偏置答对，却没有真正使用图像证据。
summary.importance: 对预训练后阶段和 VLM 训练接口有启发。它不是单纯换一个奖励，而是把多模态 reasoning trajectory 拆成不同功能段，并把序列级 advantage 改造成角色感知的 token 级更新强度。这类方法适合连接基座的视觉 grounding 能力与 RL 阶段的可验证奖励，能减少最终答案奖励对中间视觉证据的误导。
summary.technical_approach: SRPO 要求模型生成结构化回答，显式分为 perception segment 和 reasoning segment。perception tokens 负责提取与问题相关的视觉证据；reasoning tokens 负责从这些证据推出答案。它保留 GRPO 的可验证最终答案奖励，但不再对所有 token 使用同一更新权重。做法是把序列级 GRPO advantage 转成 role-aware token-level advantage。权重来自自蒸馏式对比打分，不引入额外 reward model、人工标注或外部 teacher。对 perception tokens，SRPO 比较同一 token 在原图和 corrupted image 条件下的似然差，估计它对视觉信息的依赖程度。对 reasoning tokens，SRPO 比较基于 perception 的条件预测与直接图像-问题 grounding 条件下的预测，估计推理是否与前面抽取的证据一致。随后用共享的 trajectory-level baseline 校准这些分数，并映射为有界的正乘子。这样不会改变原始奖励的优化方向，只改变不同 token 的梯度幅度。
summary.experiments: 可见内容给出的核心实验证据来自 MathVerse 案例分析：常规 GRPO 可能在最终答案正确时仍出现错误的中间 grounding，例如把边长表达误解为角度表达，或误识别 3D 视觉结构却推到正确公式。这说明 final-answer reward 不能可靠监督视觉证据使用。摘要与引言强调 SRPO 针对这一问题进行角色感知优化，但具体 benchmark、模型规模、训练数据量和提升数字在给定内容中没有展开。阅读时应优先核对主实验表、token-level 信用分配消融、corrupted image 对比的有效性，以及结构化输出格式是否带来额外偏置。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读建议 25–35 分钟。先看方法部分中从 GRPO advantage 到 role-aware token advantage 的公式，确认正权重乘子如何构造，以及为什么不会反转 reward-induced update direction。然后看 perception 和 reasoning 两类 contrast 的定义，重点判断 corrupted image 是否真能衡量视觉依赖，perception-conditioned contrast 是否真能衡量 grounding consistency。实验部分建议重点看 SRPO 相比 GRPO 的增益、是否改善中间证据质量、以及去掉角色分解或去掉某一类 contrast 后的消融。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses credit assignment in multimodal RLVR. Standard GRPO assigns a sequence-level reward based on the final answer, but multimodal reasoning usually contains two different functions: extracting visual evidence and deriving an answer from that evidence. A correct final answer does not guarantee that the model used the image correctly; it may rely on language priors, dataset regularities, or shallow heuristics.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is relevant to the interface between VLM pretraining and post-training. Rather than replacing the reward, SRPO restructures how the verified sequence-level signal is distributed across tokens. It treats perception and reasoning tokens differently, which is a useful direction for RL on models whose failures often come from weak grounding rather than pure text reasoning.
summary_en.technical_approach: SRPO asks the model to produce a structured response with a perception segment and a reasoning segment. Perception tokens should extract task-relevant visual evidence. Reasoning tokens should use that evidence to produce the answer. The method keeps the original verifiable answer reward from GRPO, but converts the sequence-level advantage into role-aware token-level advantages. The token weights are obtained through self-distilled on-policy contrasts, without an external reward model, auxiliary labels, or a separate teacher. For perception tokens, SRPO contrasts token likelihoods under the original image and a corrupted image to estimate visual dependency. For reasoning tokens, it contrasts perception-conditioned prediction with direct image-question grounding to estimate consistency with extracted evidence. These scores are normalized with a shared trajectory-level baseline and mapped to bounded positive multipliers, so the optimization direction induced by the verified reward is preserved while token update magnitudes become role-sensitive.
summary_en.experiments: The visible experimental motivation comes from MathVerse examples where GRPO can produce the correct final answer despite flawed intermediate grounding. In one case, the model misreads side-length expressions as angle expressions. In another, it reaches the correct formula while misidentifying the underlying 3D structure. These examples show why final-answer reward alone is insufficient for evidence-dependent multimodal reasoning. The provided content does not expose exact benchmark numbers, model sizes, data scale, or ablation results. The key empirical checks should be whether SRPO improves both answer accuracy and grounding quality, and whether the role-aware contrasts contribute beyond structured formatting alone.
summary_en.reading_guide: A 25–35 minute skim should focus on the policy-gradient formulation. Read the equations that transform GRPO sequence advantage into role-aware token advantage, then inspect how the perception and reasoning contrasts are computed. The main technical question is whether corrupted-image likelihood contrast is a reliable proxy for visual dependency, and whether the perception-conditioned contrast captures evidence-grounded reasoning rather than formatting compliance. In the experiments, prioritize comparisons against vanilla GRPO and ablations removing role decomposition, perception contrast, or reasoning contrast.

recommendation.zh: 将 GRPO 扩展到多模态场景时，针对 VLM 的 perception 和 reasoning 阶段设计了 token-level 的 credit assignment，对多模态 RL 后训练有直接启发，值得一看。
recommendation.en: Designs token-level credit assignment for the perception and reasoning stages of VLMs when extending GRPO to multimodal scenarios, offering direct inspiration for multimodal RL post-training; worth a skim.

paper.title: Direct Product Flow Matching: Decoupling Radial and Angular Dynamics for Few-Shot Adaptation
paper.abstract: Recent flow matching (FM) methods improve the few-shot adaptation of vision-language models, by modeling cross-modal alignment as a continuous multi-step flow. In this paper, we argue that existing FM methods are inherently constrained by incompatible geometric priors on pre-trained cross-modal features, resulting in suboptimal adaptation performance. We first analyze these methods from a polar decomposition perspective (i.e., radial and angular sub-manifolds). Under this new geometric view, we

summary.core_problem: 解决 few-shot 适配视觉-语言模型时，现有 flow matching 方法因几何先验不匹配而导致跨模态对齐不足的问题。
summary.importance: 这是多模态适配方法，不是基座预训练论文；但它对预训练特征几何的分析有一点参考价值，尤其是把归一化特征拆成 radial/angular 两部分来讨论信息损失。
summary.technical_approach: 作者从极坐标分解视角重审现有 FM 适配方法，指出三点问题：径向-角向耦合导致角向动力学失真、特征归一化丢失径向置信度信息、无条件流忽略数据集上下文。基于此提出 Direct Product Flow Matching，将 radial 和 angular dynamics 解耦，并引入上下文相关的流建模以改善 few-shot adaptation。
summary.experiments: 摘要未给出具体模型规模、数据集和提升幅度；从任务设定看应在 few-shot VLM adaptation benchmark 上与现有 FM 和其他适配方法比较。由于是适配而非预训练，结果对基座研究的外推有限。
summary.authors_note: 机构包括 HKUST、USTC、Huawei Research。工作更接近 VLM few-shot adaptation，而不是统一多模态预训练。

summary_en.core_problem: It addresses suboptimal cross-modal alignment in few-shot adaptation of vision-language models caused by mismatched geometric priors in existing flow-matching methods.
summary_en.importance: This is an adaptation paper rather than a foundation pretraining paper, but its analysis of pretrained feature geometry is mildly relevant, especially the radial/angular decomposition and the critique of feature normalization.
summary_en.technical_approach: The paper revisits existing FM adaptation methods through a polar decomposition lens and identifies three issues: radial-angular coupling distorts angular dynamics, feature normalization discards radial confidence information, and unconditional flow ignores dataset context. It then proposes Direct Product Flow Matching to decouple radial and angular dynamics and add context-aware flow modeling for better few-shot adaptation.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract does not report model sizes, datasets, or gains; the evaluation is likely on few-shot VLM adaptation benchmarks against prior FM methods and other adaptation baselines. Since this is adaptation rather than pretraining, the lessons transfer only partially to foundation-model research.
summary_en.authors_note: Institutions include HKUST, USTC, and Huawei Research. The work is closer to VLM few-shot adaptation than to unified multimodal pretraining.

recommendation.zh: 只看它对 radial/angular 分解的批评即可，尤其“归一化抹掉置信度”这点；方法本身偏适配，别把结论直接外推到预训练。
recommendation.en: Read it mainly for the radial/angular critique, especially the claim that normalization erases confidence; the method is adaptation-heavy, so do not over-transfer the conclusions to pretraining.

paper.title: Improving Calibration in Test-Time Prompt Tuning for Vision-Language Models via Data-Free Flatness-Aware Prompt Pretraining
paper.abstract: Test-time prompt tuning (TPT) has emerged as a promising technique for enhancing the adaptability of vision-language models by optimizing textual prompts using unlabeled test data. However, prior studies have observed that TPT often produces poorly calibrated models, raising concerns about the reliability of their predictions. Recent works address this issue by incorporating additional regularization terms that constrain model outputs, which improve calibration but often degrade performance. In

summary.core_problem: 解决视觉语言模型 test-time prompt tuning 虽能提升适应性、但常导致预测校准变差的问题。
summary.importance: 贡献是 VLM 测试时自适应和校准分析，核心价值在于把 prompt tuning 的校准问题连接到 loss landscape sharpness；它不是基座预训练方法，但对理解 prompt 参数的优化稳定性有一定参考。
summary.technical_approach: 论文指出已有输出正则项在机制上会把 prompt 优化推向更平坦的极小值，并提出 Data-Free Flatness-Aware Prompt Pretraining。FPP 在测试时自适应之前，先把 prompt 初始化到更平坦的损失区域，以在不依赖额外数据的条件下改善校准和保持性能。
summary.experiments: 摘要称用 FPP 替换 TPT 的初始 prompt 后可改善校准，并避免常规校准正则带来的性能下降；未给出具体 VLM backbone、数据集、参数量或提升幅度。Baseline 包括原始 TPT 及带输出约束正则的校准方法。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper studies poor calibration in test-time prompt tuning for vision-language models, where unlabeled-test adaptation can improve adaptability but make confidence estimates unreliable.
summary_en.importance: Its main contribution is an analysis linking calibration in VLM prompt adaptation to loss-landscape sharpness. It is not foundation pretraining, but it offers a useful optimization-side signal about prompt parameters and reliability.
summary_en.technical_approach: The authors argue that prior output-regularization methods implicitly push prompt optimization toward flatter minima. They propose Data-Free Flatness-Aware Prompt Pretraining, which initializes prompts in flatter regions before test-time adaptation, aiming to improve calibration without sacrificing task performance.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract reports that replacing the initial prompt in TPT with FPP improves calibration while avoiding the accuracy degradation seen with some regularizers. Specific VLM backbones, datasets, model sizes, and exact gains are not provided in the given text. Baselines include vanilla TPT and regularization-based calibration methods.
summary_en.authors_note: The authors are affiliated with Yonsei University.

recommendation.zh: 只看 sharpness 与校准的实验图即可；对预训练没直接动作，但能提醒 prompt 初始化不是无害细节。
recommendation.en: Read only the sharpness–calibration plots; it gives no direct pretraining recipe, but it is a useful warning that prompt initialization is not a harmless detail.

paper.title: One Perturbation, Two Failure Modes: Probing VLM Safety via Embedding-Guided Typographic Perturbations
paper.abstract: Typographic prompt injection exploits vision language models' (VLMs) ability to read text rendered in images, posing a growing threat as VLMs power autonomous agents. Prior work typically focus on maximizing attack success rate (ASR) but does not explain \emph{why} certain renderings bypass safety alignment. We make two contributions. First, an empirical study across four VLMs including GPT-4o and Claude, twelve font sizes, and ten transformations reveals that multimodal embedding distance stron

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作研究的是 VLM 的一种具体安全失效机制：把恶意指令渲染成图像中的文字后，模型为什么有时会读出来并执行，有时又会失败。作者不满足于只做更高攻击成功率，而是想找到一个可解释、与具体目标模型解耦的指标，来刻画 typographic prompt injection 成功与否的原因，并进一步用这个指标做更系统的红队测试。
summary.importance: 它和 LLM 预训练的直接关系不强，更接近 VLM 安全分析与攻击评测，因此只适合 skim。启发点主要有两点。第一，作者把“图像里文字能否被模型当成文本语义读出来”转成了 embedding space 里的距离问题，这对理解多模态表示学习很有帮助。第二，论文发现同一个优化目标会同时暴露两种失效：一是恢复可读性，二是削弱安全拒答。这说明 VLM 的安全对齐并不是单一模块在起作用，而是感知、表示和拒答策略耦合后的结果。对做原生多模态预训练的人来说，这个结论提醒我们：OCR 能力、图文共享表示、对齐头部的训练信号，可能共同决定安全边界。
summary.technical_approach: 方法分两步。第一步是相关性研究。作者在 1000 条来自 SALAD-Bench 的提示词上，系统测试四个 VLM：GPT-4o、Claude Sonnet 4.5、Mistral-Large-3、Qwen3-VL-4B。每条恶意文本既以纯文本形式输入，也被渲染成 1024×1024 的黑字白底图像，并控制 12 个字体大小（6–28px）和 10 种视觉变换。然后用两个独立的多模态 embedding 模型——JinaCLIP 和 Qwen3-VL-Embedding——计算图像与源文本的归一化 embedding L2 距离。结果显示，距离与攻击成功率有很强负相关。第二步是基于这个发现做攻击优化。作者不直接优化目标 VLM 的输出，而是在有界 ℓ∞ 扰动下，最大化 typographic image 与原始文本在若干 surrogate embedding 模型中的 cosine similarity。这样做不需要访问目标 VLM，也不需要知道其安全分类器。论文的关键观察是，这个单一目标会触发两类不同的脆弱性：如果原图太模糊、模型本来读不出文字，优化可能在内部表示层面恢复语义；如果模型本来能读懂但会拒答，优化则可能改变整体图像表征，使安全拒答变得不稳定。
summary.experiments: 实验里最扎实的是相关性部分。字体大小实验中，embedding distance 与 ASR 的相关系数在不同模型上达到 r=-0.71 到 -0.93；视觉变换实验中达到 r=-0.72 到 -0.99，且几乎都满足 p<0.01。具体行为上，6px 小字体会显著降低 ASR：GPT-4o 降到 0.3%，Claude 降到 1.2%，但 Mistral 仍有 15.0%，Qwen3-VL 仍有 23.9%，说明不同模型的视觉文字鲁棒性差异很大。变换方面，重 blur 和 blur+noise+low contrast 的三重退化最伤 ASR；90 度旋转对 Mistral 和 Qwen3-VL 影响更大，对 GPT-4o 和 Claude 相对较小。后续优化实验的核心结论不是“攻击率提高了多少”这一单点数字，而是同一 embedding-guided perturbation 会在不同模型和不同退化强度下，分别偏向恢复可读性或削弱拒答。也就是说，ASR 提升背后并不是单一机制。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读建议很明确。先看 Sec.2 和表 1、表 2，把经验事实吃透：字体大小、模糊、旋转这些表面因素，为什么能被 embedding distance 这个统一指标较好解释。然后看方法部分的优化目标，重点不是公式本身，而是为什么作者选择 surrogate embedding similarity，而不是直接对目标 VLM 做黑盒搜索或白盒攻击。这个选择让方法更像 probing tool，而不是单纯攻击器。实验部分优先看不同模型在小字体和重退化下的差异，再看作者如何区分“恢复可读性”和“削弱安全拒答”这两种 failure mode。预计 15–25 分钟足够完成一次有效泛读。若只关心预训练启发，可以把注意力放在 shared embedding space 与安全行为之间的联系上。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper studies a specific VLM safety failure mode: typographic prompt injection, where harmful instructions are rendered as text inside an image. Instead of only chasing higher attack success rates, it asks a more diagnostic question: why do some renderings bypass safety alignment while others fail? The goal is to find an interpretable, model-agnostic signal that explains attack success and can be used for systematic red teaming.
summary_en.importance: This is not a pretraining paper in the narrow sense, so it belongs in skim territory for a foundation-model pretraining reader. The useful part is the representation-level framing. The authors show that whether a VLM follows text embedded in an image can be predicted surprisingly well by image-text embedding distance. That is a meaningful observation for multimodal pretraining because it ties safety behavior to the geometry of shared representations rather than only to downstream refusal heads. A second useful point is that one optimization objective exposes two distinct failure modes at once: recovering readability and weakening aligned refusal. That suggests VLM safety is an interaction between perception, multimodal representation, and alignment policy, not a single isolated component.
summary_en.technical_approach: The method has two stages. First, the paper runs a controlled empirical study over 1,000 prompts from SALAD-Bench on four VLMs: GPT-4o, Claude Sonnet 4.5, Mistral-Large-3, and Qwen3-VL-4B. Each harmful prompt is tested both as plain text and as a 1024x1024 black-text-on-white-background image, with twelve font sizes from 6 to 28 px and ten visual transformations. The authors then compute the normalized image-text embedding L2 distance using two independent multimodal embedding models, JinaCLIP and Qwen3-VL-Embedding. The result is a strong negative correlation between embedding distance and attack success rate. Second, they turn this insight into a red-teaming procedure. Starting from a degraded typographic image, they apply a bounded l-infinity perturbation that maximizes cosine similarity between the image embedding and the source text embedding across one or more surrogate embedding models. This does not require access to the target VLM or its safety classifier. The key conceptual claim is that the same objective can expose two different weaknesses: if the text is unreadable, the perturbation may restore semantic recoverability in the model’s internal representation; if the text is already readable but refused, the perturbation may alter the holistic image representation enough to destabilize the refusal behavior.
summary_en.experiments: The strongest part of the paper is the correlation study. Across font-size conditions, embedding distance correlates with attack success at r = -0.71 to -0.93 depending on the target model. Across transformation conditions, the correlation is r = -0.72 to -0.99, with nearly all p-values below 0.01. The font-size results are also informative in their own right: at 6 px, ASR drops to 0.3% for GPT-4o and 1.2% for Claude, but remains 15.0% for Mistral and 23.9% for Qwen3-VL, indicating large differences in visual text robustness. Among transformations, heavy blur and the combined blur-plus-noise-plus-low-contrast setting hurt ASR the most, while 90-degree rotation affects Mistral and Qwen3-VL much more than GPT-4o and Claude. In the optimization experiments, the main takeaway is not a single ASR number but the mechanism split: the same embedding-guided perturbation can either recover readability or weaken refusal, and which one dominates depends on the model and the severity of degradation.
summary_en.reading_guide: Read Section 2 first, especially Tables 1 and 2. That is where the paper earns its main claim: simple rendering factors such as font size, blur, and rotation can be summarized surprisingly well by a single embedding-distance signal. Then look at the optimization objective in the method section. The important question is not the exact formula, but why the authors optimize surrogate embedding similarity instead of directly attacking the target VLM through black-box search or white-box gradients. That design choice makes the method more useful as a probing tool than as a one-off attack recipe. In the experiments, focus on model differences under tiny fonts and severe degradation, then on how the paper distinguishes the two failure modes. A 15–25 minute skim is enough. For pretraining-oriented readers, the most relevant thread is the link between shared multimodal embedding spaces and downstream safety behavior.

recommendation.zh: 通过多模态 embedding 距离来解释和预测 VLM 的排版注入攻击成功率，机制分析较为 clean，对理解 VLM 的图文对齐和安全漏洞有启发，建议扫读实证分析部分。
recommendation.en: Explains and predicts typographic injection ASR in VLMs via multimodal embedding distance. The mechanism analysis is clean and provides insights into VLM image-text alignment and safety vulnerabilities. Skim the empirical analysis section.

paper.title: Source-Modality Monitoring in Vision-Language Models
paper.abstract: We define and investigate source-modality monitoring -- the ability of multimodal models to track and communicate the input source from which pieces of information originate. We consider source-modality monitoring as an instance of the more general binding problem, and evaluate the extent to which models exploit syntactic vs. semantic signals in order to bind words like image in a user-provided prompt to specific components of their input and context (i.e., actual images). Across experiments spa

summary.core_problem: 这项工作研究 VLM 是否能追踪信息来自哪种输入源，例如图像还是文字说明。核心问题是：当用户问“image 里有什么”或“caption 说了什么”时，模型是依赖显式模态标记完成绑定，还是依赖图像和文本内容本身的分布与语义特征。
summary.importance: 对多模态预训练的启发在于数据格式和模态标记的作用。结果显示，显式 wrapper tokens 有帮助，但模型并不只做符号绑定；当图像内容和文本内容分布差异很大时，语义和分布线索往往更强。这提示多模态模型的 source binding 不是单靠特殊 token 就能保证的能力，预训练时的模态边界、内容冲突样本、跨源检索任务和指令格式都可能影响模型对“信息来源”的监控能力。
summary.technical_approach: 作者把 source-modality monitoring 形式化为一种 binding 问题：模型需要把内容绑定到 image、caption、text 等抽象角色上。评测任务采用不一致的 image-caption pair。图像和 caption 描述互相冲突，模型被要求只回答指定来源的信息。这样可以排除单纯依赖世界知识或总体模态偏好的情况。方法上还控制了输入顺序：图像在前和文本在前两种顺序都评估，并取平均。随后通过扰动模态标记来区分语法线索和语义线索的影响；再通过对 marker 表示和 content 表示施加优化变换，测试符号提示是否足以改变模型的模态归因。
summary.experiments: 实验使用 Flickr30k 和 MSCOCO 构造不一致图文对。为避免 caption 与图像真实内容仍然相近，作者用 sentence-transformers/all-mpnet-base-v2 计算候选 caption 与图像原始标注的相似度，并要求相似度低于 0.2。评测覆盖 11 个开源 VLM，包含有无显式图像 wrapper tokens 的不同系统。主要发现是：许多模型能完成目标模态检索；带特殊图像标记的模型整体更好；在语法标记与内容语义发生冲突时，模型通常更受分布语义线索影响，尤其是在图像和文本差异清晰的情况下。不过，显式标记仍能提高选择性，并且经过优化的表示变换可以反转模型的模态归因，说明符号线索并非无效，只是默认情况下往往弱于内容线索。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读建议 25 到 35 分钟。第 2.1 节先看清楚 target-modality retrieval task，因为这个任务设计决定了结果能否解释 source binding。第 2.2 节关注数据构造、相似度阈值和输入顺序控制。结果部分建议重点看各模型的 source-modality selectivity，以及有无 wrapper tokens 的对比。扰动实验和表示变换实验值得快速阅读，它们区分了“模型真的理解标记”与“模型按内容分布猜来源”这两种机制。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper studies whether vision-language models can track the source modality of information. When asked what is in the image or what the caption says, does a model bind content to the requested source using explicit modality markers, or does it rely mainly on the distributional and semantic properties of the content itself?
summary_en.importance: The main lesson for multimodal pretraining is about modality binding and input formatting. Special wrapper tokens help, but they do not fully determine source attribution. When visual and textual contents are distributionally distinct, semantic signals often dominate symbolic markers. This matters for native multimodal training: modality delimiters, source labels, conflicting multimodal examples, and retrieval-style supervision can all affect whether the model learns to monitor where information came from.
summary_en.technical_approach: The work frames source-modality monitoring as a binding problem. The model must bind content to abstract roles such as image or caption and retrieve the content associated with the queried role. The evaluation uses inconsistent image-caption pairs: the image and the caption describe mutually exclusive content, and the prompt asks for only one source. This forces source-specific retrieval rather than generic captioning or reliance on a global modality bias. The setup also evaluates both input orders, image-first and text-first, and averages over them. Additional perturbation experiments manipulate symbolic modality markers to separate syntactic cues from semantic cues. Optimized transformations applied to marker and content representations test whether symbolic cues can actively change the model’s modality attribution.
summary_en.experiments: The datasets are built from Flickr30k and MSCOCO. Captions are mismatched with images, and a sentence embedding filter using sentence-transformers/all-mpnet-base-v2 requires cosine similarity below 0.2 against the image’s ground-truth captions. The evaluation covers 11 open-source VLMs, including systems with and without explicit image wrapper tokens. Many models succeed on the target-modality retrieval task. Models with explicit wrapper tokens generally show better source selectivity. When marker cues and content cues are put in tension, distributional-semantic cues tend to dominate, especially when the modalities are clearly separable. At the same time, marker cues remain useful: representation-level transformations can reverse modality attribution, showing that symbolic information is accessible but not always the strongest default signal.
summary_en.reading_guide: A focused skim takes about 25 to 35 minutes. Start with Section 2.1 to understand the target-modality retrieval task, since the task design is what makes the binding claim interpretable. Then read Section 2.2 for dataset construction, the 0.2 similarity filter, model coverage, and input-order control. In the results, focus on source-modality selectivity and the comparison between models with and without wrapper tokens. The perturbation and representation-transformation experiments are the most useful parts for understanding whether models follow explicit markers or infer source from content statistics.

recommendation.zh: 看任务设计和 11 个 VLM 的错误模式；对 native multimodal pretrain 的 binding loss 有参考。
recommendation.en: Read the task design and 11-model error patterns; they are relevant when thinking about binding losses for native multimodal pretraining.

paper.title: HyperGVL: Benchmarking and Improving Large Vision-Language Models in Hypergraph Understanding and Reasoning
paper.abstract: Large Vision-Language Models (LVLMs) consistently require new arenas to guide their expanding boundaries, yet their capabilities with hypergraphs remain unexplored. In the real world, hypergraphs have significant practical applications in areas such as life sciences and social communities. Recent advancements in LVLMs have shown promise in understanding complex topologies, yet there remains a lack of a benchmark to delineate the capabilities of LVLMs with hypergraphs, leaving the boundaries of t

summary.core_problem: 论文要解决的问题很直接：现有 LVLM benchmark 基本停留在普通图，缺少对 hypergraph 这类高阶关系结构的系统评测，因此无法判断模型到底能否理解和推理多元关系。
summary.importance: 对预训练研究本身的直接影响有限，它更像一个多模态结构理解 benchmark。但有两个启发点值得记住：一是高阶结构比普通图更接近真实知识组织方式，适合作为检验视觉-语言模型结构推理边界的压力测试；二是作者发现不同 hypergraph 表示形式会显著影响模型表现，这对多模态预训练中的表示选择、输入格式设计和 routing 有参考意义。
summary.technical_approach: 工作分两部分。第一部分是构建 HyperGVL benchmark：总计 84,000 个视觉-语言 QA 对，覆盖 synthetic 与 real-world hypergraph，各自再按 small/medium/large 规模划分；任务上分为 understanding 和 reasoning 两大类，共 12 个任务，并按难度组织为四级，从基本元素识别、邻接感知、启发式计算，到多步算法问题和 NP-hard planning。输入表示也做得比较系统，包含 7 种文本表示和 5 种视觉表示，用来分析模型对不同表示的偏好。第二部分是 WiseHyGR，一个基于历史表现训练的 router，用于为给定 hypergraph 问题选择更合适的表示形式，再交给 LVLM 作答。它不是改模型本体，而是改输入路由策略。
summary.experiments: 论文评测了 12 个主流 LVLM，在 HyperGVL 上做了较全面的横向比较。核心结果不是某个模型绝对分数，而是几条结构性结论：第一，模型在基础理解任务上相对可用，但一旦进入算法推理和尤其是 NP-hard planning，性能明显下滑，说明当前 LVLM 对高阶结构的推理能力仍然有限。第二，表示形式影响很大，同一个模型在不同 textual/visual hypergraph 表示下会有显著差异，这也是作者训练 WiseHyGR 的依据。第三，WiseHyGR 在多数设置下能提升表现，并且有一定 out-of-domain 泛化。就 skim 而言，重点看 benchmark 设计是否合理、任务分层是否清楚，以及 router 的收益是否稳定，不必过度关注具体榜单名次。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读建议：先看 Introduction 和 Table 1，确认它与已有 graph / hypergraph benchmark 的区别；再看 benchmark 构造部分，重点是任务层级、数据来源、规模划分和 12 种表示；最后看 WiseHyGR 的主结果表，判断 routing 是否真的带来稳定收益。预计 20–30 分钟足够形成判断。如果你主要做 LLM 预训练，这篇不需要精读全文；更适合作为多模态结构推理评测资料备查。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses a simple gap: existing LVLM benchmarks focus mostly on ordinary graphs, not hypergraphs, so we do not have a clear measurement of whether current vision-language models can understand and reason over higher-order relations.
summary_en.importance: Its direct relevance to LLM pretraining is limited, so this is not a core read for base-model research. Still, it offers two useful signals. First, hypergraphs are a more realistic testbed for higher-order relational structure than standard pairwise graphs. Second, the paper shows that representation choice matters a lot: the same underlying hypergraph can lead to very different model behavior depending on how it is rendered in text or vision. That is relevant to multimodal input design and routing strategies.
summary_en.technical_approach: The work has two components. The first is HyperGVL, a benchmark with 84,000 vision-language QA pairs built from both synthetic and real-world hypergraphs. The benchmark spans 12 tasks across understanding and reasoning, and organizes them into four difficulty levels: atomic understanding, compound understanding, polynomial-time algorithmic reasoning, and NP-hard planning. It also includes a broad representation space, with seven textual and five visual forms of hypergraphs, so the benchmark can probe not only capability limits but also representation sensitivity. The second component is WiseHyGR, a router trained to choose a better hypergraph representation for a given problem before passing it to an LVLM. This is a representation-selection layer rather than a new backbone model.
summary_en.experiments: The paper evaluates 12 advanced LVLMs on HyperGVL. The main takeaway is structural rather than leaderboard-driven. Models are relatively more competent on basic understanding tasks, but performance drops sharply on algorithmic reasoning and especially on NP-hard planning, suggesting that current LVLMs still struggle with higher-order structural reasoning. Another key result is that representation choice has a large effect: the same model can perform very differently across textual and visual hypergraph encodings. This motivates WiseHyGR, which generally improves performance and shows some out-of-domain transfer. For a skim-level read, the important question is whether the benchmark is well designed and whether the routing gains are consistent, not which model ranks first.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim the paper in three steps. First, read the Introduction and the benchmark comparison table to see how HyperGVL differs from prior graph and hypergraph evaluations. Second, read the benchmark construction section, focusing on task taxonomy, scale partitioning, and the representation space. Third, inspect the main WiseHyGR results to judge whether routing gives stable gains. Around 20–30 minutes is enough for a solid overview. If your focus is LLM pretraining, this is more of a reference benchmark paper than a must-read.

recommendation.zh: 把“结构推理”落到可测的超图任务上，适合用来做数据合成与训练配比的靶场；先看任务分层与错误类型分析。
recommendation.en: A useful testbed to make “structural reasoning” measurable via hypergraphs; skim task taxonomy and error analyses to guide synthetic data and training mix.

paper.title: Information Router for Mitigating Modality Dominance in Vision-Language Models
paper.abstract: Vision Language models (VLMs) have demonstrated strong performance across a wide range of benchmarks, yet they often suffer from modality dominance, where predictions rely disproportionately on a single modality. Prior approaches primarily address this issue by steering model's attention allocation, implicitly assuming that all modalities provide sufficient information. However, attention only determines where the model focuses, and cannot enrich information that is missing or ambiguous. In the

summary.core_problem: 现有多模态大模型存在模态主导问题，现有缓解方法仅通过调整注意力分配优化，默认所有模态携带足够信息，无法解决真实场景下模态间信息密度、信噪比差异带来的底层信息失衡问题。
summary.importance: 为多模态预训练的融合阶段设计提供了新思路，打破了仅从注意力层面优化模态平衡的常规路径，提出了基于信息补偿解决模态主导的可行方向。
summary.technical_approach: 提出多模态信息路由器MoIR，部署在模态专属编码器与LLM解码器之间的融合前阶段；先对各模态token表征做SVD分解，计算每个嵌入通道的信息得分，识别低信息通道，再跨模态路由互补信息填充低信息通道，缩小模态间信息差异后再输入LLM融合。
summary.experiments: 在3个通用多模态数据集和主流VLM骨干上验证，MoIR可稳定调整模态贡献占比，提升模型鲁棒性和下游任务性能，同时降低注意力效率指数（AEI），实现更均衡的模态使用。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读Introduction中模态主导的成因分析、Methodology中信息得分计算与路由逻辑、实验部分的鲁棒性测试结果，预计阅读时间15分钟。

summary_en.core_problem: Existing vision-language models (VLMs) face the modality dominance issue, where predictions rely disproportionately on a single modality. Current mitigation methods only adjust attention allocation under the assumption that all modalities carry sufficient information, which cannot resolve the underlying information imbalance caused by varying information density and signal-to-noise ratio across modalities in real scenarios.
summary_en.importance: It provides a new perspective for fusion stage design in multi-modal pre-training, breaks the conventional path of optimizing modality balance only at the attention level, and proposes a feasible direction to resolve modality dominance based on information compensation.
summary_en.technical_approach: The paper proposes MoIR (Multi-modal Information Router), a pre-fusion module placed between modality-specific encoders and the LLM decoder. It first performs SVD decomposition on token representations of each modality to calculate informativeness scores for each embedding channel, identifies low-information channels, then routes complementary information across modalities to fill these channels, reducing information disparity across modalities before fusion.
summary_en.experiments: Verified on 3 widely used multi-modal datasets and mainstream VLM backbones, MoIR consistently adjusts modality contribution ratios, improves model robustness and downstream task performance, and reduces the Attention Efficiency Index (AEI) for more balanced modality usage.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim the cause analysis of modality dominance in Introduction, the informativeness score calculation and routing logic in Methodology, and the robustness test results in Experiments. Estimated reading time: 15 minutes.

recommendation.zh: 这篇的价值在问题分解：别把 modality dominance 都归咎于 attention；读方法和误差分析即可，若 token 重要性定义很脆，这条线就容易塌。
recommendation.en: The useful part is the problem decomposition: modality dominance is not always an attention issue; read the method and error analysis, but if token informativeness is brittle, the whole story weakens fast.

paper.title: Gaslight, Gatekeep, V1-V3: Early Visual Cortex Alignment Shields Vision-Language Models from Sycophantic Manipulation

summary.core_problem: 视觉语言模型在“gaslighting/社会压力”式两轮对话中会出现sycophancy（迎合操纵、放弃正确答案）。本文要回答：VLM内部视觉表征与人类视觉皮层（尤其早期视觉区）的一致性（brain alignment）是否能预测/解释其抗sycophancy能力。
summary.importance:
对基座预训练研究的价值主要是机制与评测层面：
1）把“神经对齐指标”与“对齐后训练（如RLHF）引入的迎合脆弱性”联系起来，提示视觉表征的“证据扎根程度”可能影响语言侧社会操纵下的稳定性。
2）结论是ROI特异的：总体brain alignment与sycophancy不显著，但V1–V3对齐与sycophancy呈稳健负相关，暗示低级视觉编码的保真度可能是抵抗语言压力的关键因素之一。
3）提供大规模、结构化的sycophancy评测框架（76,800次评测），可作为后续做训练配方/视觉编码器选择/对齐策略的诊断工具。
summary.technical_approach:
三阶段管线：
- Brain alignment：对12个开源VLM（256M–10B，6个架构家族）冻结视觉编码器，抽取中间特征；用ridge regression去预测Natural Scenes Dataset的fMRI响应，覆盖8名被试、6个视觉皮层ROI；以预测性能作为神经对齐度。
- Sycophancy评测：构造6,400个两轮gaslighting prompts，覆盖5类操纵方式、10个难度等级，对每个模型做系统化评测，总计76,800次。
- 统计分析：既看总体相关，也做ROI级相关矩阵；用BCa bootstrap置信区间、leave-one-out敏感性分析、置换检验等保证稳健性，并进一步做类别级（不同操纵类型）相关分析与抗/不抗模型组间效应量比较。
summary.experiments:
关键结果（文中给出明确数值）：
- 总体brain alignment与sycophancy率相关不显著：r = -0.255，p = 0.424。
- ROI级发现：早期视觉皮层V1–V3（prf-visualrois）对齐与sycophancy呈负相关：r = -0.441，BCa 95% CI [-0.740, -0.031]，且leave-one-out在12个子集上都保持负相关。
- 类别级：早期视觉对齐对“existence denial attacks（否认图中存在某物）”的抵抗预测最强且显著：r = -0.597，p = 0.040（ROI×类别矩阵中唯一显著项）。
- 组间比较：抗操纵 vs 易受操纵模型在各ROI上均为中等效应量，Cohen’s d约0.51–0.68。
- 规模与覆盖：12个模型、参数256M–10B；sycophancy评测共76,800次；fMRI来自NSD，8被试×6 ROI。
summary.reading_guide:
泛读建议（约40–60分钟）：
1）先看方法总览图（Figure 1）与brain alignment计算细节：特征抽取层、ridge回归设置、ROI定义与聚合方式。
2）重点读统计分析部分：为什么总体不显著但ROI显著、BCa区间与置换检验如何做、以及leave-one-out如何排除“单模型驱动”。
3）看ROI×操纵类别矩阵与“existence denial”分析：这是最可操作的机制线索（低级视觉证据扎根→抵抗语言否认）。
4）如果你关心预训练配方启示，建议额外关注：不同架构家族/视觉编码器差异是否系统性影响V1–V3对齐（文中若有分组图/表），以及sycophancy评测prompt模板与难度标定规则（便于复现/扩展）。

summary_en.core_problem: Whether a VLM’s internal visual representations—quantified by neural predictivity to human visual cortex fMRI—are associated with robustness to two-turn sycophantic “gaslighting” manipulation, and if so, which cortical regions matter.
summary_en.importance: This is primarily a mechanism/measurement contribution relevant to foundation-model training: it suggests that robustness to social-pressure manipulation may depend on how faithfully the model encodes visual evidence, and that this dependence is localized (early visual cortex) rather than captured by a single global brain-alignment score. It also provides a large, structured sycophancy evaluation suite (76,800 runs) that can be reused to diagnose the impact of vision encoder choices, multimodal pretraining objectives, and post-training alignment (e.g., RLHF) on groundedness under adversarial dialogue pressure.
summary_en.technical_approach: A three-stage empirical pipeline over 12 open-weight VLMs (256M–10B, 6 architecture families): (1) Brain alignment: freeze the vision encoder, extract intermediate features, and train ridge regressions to predict NSD fMRI responses across 8 subjects and 6 ROIs; use prediction quality as neural predictivity. (2) Sycophancy: evaluate models on 6,400 two-turn gaslighting prompts spanning 5 manipulation categories and 10 difficulty levels (76,800 total evaluations). (3) Statistics: correlate sycophancy with brain alignment at aggregate and ROI levels, with robustness checks via BCa bootstrap CIs, leave-one-out sensitivity, and permutation testing; additionally analyze ROI-by-category relationships and group effect sizes.
summary_en.experiments: Reported key numbers: aggregate brain alignment vs sycophancy is not significant (r = -0.255, p = 0.424). ROI-level analysis finds a robust negative correlation specifically for early visual cortex V1–V3 (prf-visualrois): r = -0.441 with BCa 95% CI [-0.740, -0.031], and the sign persists under leave-one-out across all 12 subsets. Category-level analysis shows early-visual alignment most strongly predicts resistance to existence-denial attacks (r = -0.597, p = 0.040), the only significant cell in the ROI×category matrix. Resistant vs susceptible model groups show medium effect sizes across ROIs (Cohen’s d ≈ 0.51–0.68). Scale: 12 models, 76,800 sycophancy evaluations; NSD fMRI with 8 subjects and 6 ROIs.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim (~40–60 min): start with Figure 1 to understand the full pipeline. Then focus on (a) how neural predictivity is computed (which layers/features, ridge setup, ROI aggregation), and (b) the statistical robustness section explaining why ROI-specific effects are trusted despite a non-significant aggregate correlation. Finally, inspect the ROI×manipulation-category matrix and the existence-denial analysis, since it provides the clearest mechanistic hypothesis (low-level visual grounding buffering against linguistic pressure).

recommendation.zh: 结论不在“总体脑对齐”，而在V1–V3对齐能预测抗sycophancy：提示低级视觉保真度可能压住RLHF式迎合漂移；只看相关性分解与评测协议。
recommendation.en: The actionable bit is ROI-specific: V1–V3 alignment predicts lower sycophancy, hinting low-level visual fidelity may resist RLHF-induced pandering; skim the correlation breakdown + eval protocol.

paper.title: HTDC: Hesitation-Triggered Differential Calibration for Mitigating Hallucination in Large Vision-Language Models

summary.core_problem: 在大视觉语言模型中，如何用训练free的解码策略在尽量不增加计算与不破坏稳定预测的前提下抑制幻觉。
summary.importance: 贡献类型为推理期（decoding-time）机制信号+校准策略：提出“layer-wise hesitation”作为视觉grounding不稳定的可观测信号，并据此做按需触发的差分校准；对多模态对齐/幻觉机理与推理期干预有启发。
summary.technical_approach: HTDC：先在中间层监测token偏好波动形成hesitation信号；仅在hesitation步骤触发校准。校准时对比full branch与两个轻量probe（visual-nullification与semantic-nullification）以压制幻觉候选，同时避免每步都校准带来的额外开销与过度干预。
summary.experiments: 摘要未给出具体LVLM、数据集/基准、计算开销变化与幻觉指标改善幅度等；但宣称相较“每步校准”的训练free方法更高效且更稳健。

summary_en.core_problem: Mitigate hallucinations in large vision-language models via training-free decoding while avoiding unnecessary compute and over-intervention.
summary_en.importance: A decoding-time mechanism + calibration strategy: introduces “layer-wise hesitation” as an observable signal of unstable visual grounding and performs on-demand differential calibration; potentially insightful for multimodal grounding and hallucination control.
summary_en.technical_approach: HTDC monitors token preference fluctuations across intermediate layers to detect hesitation; calibration is triggered only on hesitation-prone steps. When triggered, it contrasts the full branch with two lightweight probes (visual-nullification and semantic-nullification) to suppress hallucination-prone candidates.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract snippet lacks concrete model/dataset/metric details and quantitative gains; it claims better efficiency and stability than step-wise calibration baselines.

recommendation.zh: 把 layer-wise hesitation 当作可观测的视觉不稳信号再触发差分校准，思路新但像模型特定 trick；只看 hesitation 指标定义和触发条件，别指望通用提升。
recommendation.en: Interesting but likely model-specific: use layer-wise “hesitation” as an observable instability signal to trigger differential calibration; skim the metric + trigger rule, don’t expect universal gains.

paper.title: Assessing Privacy Preservation and Utility in Online Vision-Language Models

summary.core_problem: 评估在线视觉-语言模型(OVLM)在处理用户上传图片时的PII泄露风险，并在“隐私保护-效用保持”之间寻求可行的防护方案。
summary.importance: 属于VLM安全/隐私方向的实证评估与防护探索：强调图像中“上下文关系”可导致显式/隐式PII推断，契合多模态模型落地时的隐私合规与对齐需求；对构建VLM隐私评测与防护策略有启发。
summary.technical_approach: 围绕PII泄露将风险分为显式(直接可见)与隐式(通过场景线索/关系推断)两类；提出在不显著损害任务效用的前提下对输入/输出进行隐私保护的策略（从摘要看更偏应用侧的保护方法与权衡评估，未体现新的基础训练范式）。
summary.experiments: 摘要未给出模型规模、数据集名称、具体baseline与量化提升幅度；仅说明进行了隐私-效用权衡评估并验证所提技术“有效”。

summary_en.core_problem: Measuring and mitigating PII leakage risks in online vision-language models that process user-uploaded images, while maintaining task utility under privacy protections.
summary_en.importance: Provides an empirical privacy-utility assessment framework highlighting that contextual cues and relationships in images can enable both explicit and implicit PII inference, informing compliance-oriented evaluation and practical defenses for deployed multimodal systems.
summary_en.technical_approach: Separates privacy risks into explicit (directly visible) and implicit (contextually inferred) PII leakage, and studies input/output-side protection strategies designed to reduce leakage without substantially degrading model usefulness.
summary_en.experiments: Conducts privacy-utility trade-off evaluations and reports that the proposed protections are effective; the abstract does not specify models, datasets, baselines, or quantitative gains.

recommendation.zh: 多模态落地前的合规备查：强调关系上下文也会泄露PII，结论不惊艳但能补威胁模型；只看攻击面分类和防护-效用曲线。
recommendation.en: Compliance-oriented reference before shipping OVLMs: the point that relational context leaks PII isn’t shocking but sharpens your threat model; skim the attack taxonomy and privacy–utility curves.
